articles.title: 3zPz
articles.summary: Leader of the guild Historical [UEZ]. He took it out of Concordia into Ordo Malleus, posted the thread that declared Concordia disbanded in November 2015, and a month later founded Vesta from what remained.

articles.title: 99loulou999
articles.summary: Member of The Dark Phoenix [TNI] who wrote the earliest surviving use of the alliance name Goose, on 19 January 2021, and gave the fullest first-hand account of the Rays desert war a month later.

infobox.label: Known for
infobox.value: First written use of the name [[goose|Goose]] (19 Jan 2021)

articles.body:
On 19 January 2021, 99loulou999 asked [[the-forum-megalist|the megalist]] for an update: "TNR (TNI and TNA) are part of Goose, idk if we already have an editor tho"{{cite:thread-278112-p04|p4 #71, 19 Jan 2021}}. It is the earliest recorded use of the name [[goose|Goose]] anywhere in the written record — the anti-[[artemis|Artemis]] coalition had been described a month earlier as "a currently unnamed group"{{cite:thread-279337|post #1, 18 Dec 2020}}. Lev98bug of Eden added his guild the same morning{{cite:thread-278112-p04|p4 #72, 19 Jan 2021}}, and Sg_Voltage answered both: "Just want to drop in and say that I'm a huge fan of the name."{{cite:thread-278112-p04|p4 #73, 19 Jan 2021}}

A month later, on 20 February 2021, he wrote the longest surviving account of the multi-guild raid on Rays' desert holdings, in the thread "The Issue With 1.20 Guild Wars"{{cite:thread-286375|post #2, 20 Feb 2021}}. Against the claim that attack prices were broken, he replied that the poster was "overshadowing the fact that every guild in artemis except probably 4 were warring the whole desert/savanah/rymek area currently held by Rays, so its normal that after 5h of constant warring the 'pity price'... rose up"{{cite:thread-286375|post #2, 20 Feb 2021}}. On the defenders' position: "Rays HQ kept getting taken because they couldn't war againts 10+ guilds"{{cite:thread-286375|post #2, 20 Feb 2021}}. On his own guild's logistics: "Speaking from experience in TNI during the Rays raid: our smallest attack timer without counting the 10 minutes cooldown was 8 minutes" — the best in the alliance, since no other headquarters sat closer to the desert{{cite:thread-286375|post #2, 20 Feb 2021}}. He classed "TNI and CXZ" as "two guilds I would consider medium sized"{{cite:thread-286375|post #2, 20 Feb 2021}}.

articles.title: Adonis
articles.summary: Adonis was a community alliance founded around May 2022 by the leaders of Titans Valor and Empire of Sindria as Hestia declined — 'a space for those of us who are still active to hang together.' Joined by Avicia within weeks, it outlived the war alliances around it, still hosting community events in early 2024.
articles.body:
## History
Adonis was founded in May 2022 as the successor to the declining Hestia{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol1|vol. 1, 8 May 2022}}; [[Avicia]] had joined by 12 June 2022{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol3|vol. 3, 12 Jun 2022}}. The alliance ran community events through the era of [[Cucumber Company]], [[smtn elf]] and the [[Avocado Aquarium]] — its member guilds passing through those war blocs while Adonis held the social layer, exactly as Hestia had spanned the war blocs before it.

Adonis was still running community events in February 2024{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol12|vol. 12, 20 Feb 2024}}, and in March 2024 ran a joint Discord server with the guild The Farplane, whose membership in Adonis was never recorded{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol13|vol. 13, 22 Mar 2024}}. Nothing later is on record; no dissolution was ever recorded.

## Membership
The end date marks the alliance's last recorded activity, not a dissolution.

{{alliance:Adonis}}

## Legacy
Adonis carried the community-alliance tradition of [[Hestia]] and [[Niflheim]] into the mid-2020s. While the war alliances of 2022–2023 collapsed or faded within a season or two, Adonis was still hosting events nearly two years after its founding{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol13|vol. 13, 22 Mar 2024}} — the last community alliance on record.

articles.title: Aequitas
articles.summary: Wynncraft guild founded in late 2019 and led by FrozenGalaxy; a Goose guild, co-founder of Khaos, and member of Cucumber Company and smtn elf. Defender in the Long Raid of 2024, belligerent in the largest recorded war (against Avicia, 2025), and driven to zero territories in the ongoing 2026 war with Sequoia.
articles.leadImageCaption: Aequitas's guild emblem: a pair of golden scales lit from behind on a dark ground, the guild name beneath.

articles.title: Aequitas-Avicia war
articles.summary: The largest Wynncraft guild war ever recorded: Aequitas against Avicia, 3 November to 21 December 2025, with 15,710 territory exchanges and a weekly peak of 4,736. It was over by Christmas.

infobox.label: Scale
infobox.value: 15,710 territory exchanges; weekly peak 4,736 — the largest war on record

articles.body:
{{map:2025-11-03|The map when the war began}}

{{war-chart:Aequitas|Avicia|2025-10-19|2026-01-03}}

## Background

Like every war of [[private-diplomacy-era|the private-diplomacy era]], it has no written record: no declaration, no named cause, no published sides beyond the two principals{{cite:territory-exchanges|no written declaration, cause or sides survive for this war}}. By late 2025 even the forum's guild-politics venue was gone — the official Discord's #guild-politics channel had been renamed #guild-community that October, and a guild founder writing that October recalled a time when alliances "were formed, enemies were negotiated with, all behind closed doors"{{cite:thread-322643|post #1, IceResistance, 2 Oct 2025}}.

## Course of the war

The war between [[Aequitas]] and [[Avicia]] ran from 3 November to 21 December 2025{{cite:chronicle-records|Aequitas-Avicia war}}. Its seven weeks produced 15,710 territory exchanges, with a weekly peak of 4,736 — more than any other recorded conflict, surpassing the multi-year bloc wars of 2021–22 in raw volume{{cite:territory-exchanges|exchange totals and weekly peak, 3 Nov – 21 Dec 2025}}. Which side prevailed is not recorded; the war was over by Christmas.

## Aftermath

No settlement is recorded. Within a year Aequitas was at war again — [[aequitas-sequoia-war|against Sequoia]], the conflict still running as of September 2026{{cite:territory-exchanges|Aequitas-Sequoia exchanges from the week of 24 Aug 2026}}.

articles.title: Aequitas-Sequoia war
articles.summary: The current war of the Wynncraft territory map: after a one-week clash in August 2025 and spring 2026 skirmishes, full war between Aequitas and Sequoia erupted in the week of 24 August 2026, with 7,488 territory exchanges in its first week. Ongoing as of September 2026.
articles.body:
{{map:2026-08-24|The map when full war erupted}}

{{war-chart:Aequitas|Sequoia|2026-08-09|2026-09-16}}

## Background

The two guilds had clashed before: a one-week fight in August 2025, then renewed skirmishes through spring 2026{{cite:territory-exchanges|Aequitas-Sequoia clashes, Aug 2025 and spring 2026}}. Sequoia entered the war as the dominant guild of the era, winner of seven consecutive [[guild-seasons|guild seasons]] from mid-2024{{cite:wynncraft-wiki-gg-wiki-guild-seasons|Seasons 19–25, 24 Jun 2024 – 20 Jul 2025}} and survivor of [[avicia-sequoia-war|its 2023 war with Avicia]]; Aequitas came off [[aequitas-avicia-war|the largest war in the territory record]] the previous winter, and before that [[the-long-raid|the Long Raid siege]] of 2024.

As with every conflict of [[private-diplomacy-era|the private-diplomacy era]], no cause or declaration was ever published{{cite:chronicle-records|Aequitas-Sequoia war}}.

## Course of the war

The opening week was among the most violent ever recorded: 7,488 territory exchanges{{cite:territory-exchanges|weekly capture volumes, week of 24 Aug 2026}}. On 3 September 2026 Aequitas held 21 territories{{cite:api-wynncraft-com-v3-guild-aequitas|territory count, captured 3 Sep 2026}}; how far the guild fell during the opening week is not recorded.

## Aftermath

The war has no aftermath yet. As with every conflict of the era, the alliances behind it are undocumented.

articles.title: Aesir Pact

articles.title: Alliance Alliance
articles.summary: Alliance Alliance ("Double AA") was the breakaway war alliance of February 2018: five guilds that split from the Coalition over a proposed division of the province of Wynn, joined by Fantasy and Necronomicon. It held most of the map in the days after the split, lost it to the newly formed Federation on 21 February, retook it for three days in early March, and was reduced to a single territory on 19–20 March 2018.
articles.body:
## History

### Formation
On 17 February 2018 (16 February in some accounts){{cite:thread-265297|post #1, community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ)}}, [[HackForums]], [[Paladins United]], House of Sentinels, [[Emorians]] and Kangronomicon left the Coalition — also called "The 1st Coalition" — over map disputes.{{cite:community-guild-timeline}} Together with [[Fantasy]] and Necronomicon they formed Alliance Alliance and declared war on their former alliance, beginning the [[coalition-civil-war|Coalition Civil War]].{{cite:community-guild-timeline}} (The seventh guild, spelled "Necromonicon" in some records, was Necronomicon, a guild active on the map through 2018.){{cite:territory-exchanges|territory_exchanges map-data analysis}}

[[drew1011|Drew1011]], the Coalition leader who published the disputed map, wrote that the alliance had divided Gavel but never Wynn, that a vote to divide Wynn was called by AscendedKitten of [[imperial|Imperial]] and passed, and that "within an hour of announcing the map, on February 16th, 2018, five guilds left Coalition. Hax, PUN, Snt, Fuq, and Emorians [ERN] left and made their own alliance combined with Fux and Feq."{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 17, composed 11 Jul 2018}} He added that the new bloc "attacked the rest of the Coalition, and had the map before the night was over"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 17, composed 11 Jul 2018}}. Alliance Alliance held 337 of 376 territories on 17 February, against [[the-federation|the Federation]]'s 28{{cite:territory-exchanges|337 of 376 territories, 17 Feb 2018}}.

![The proposed division of the province of Wynn, drawn over a territory map in coloured regions, from the ninth redraw of the Coalition's plan. Drew1011 identified its announcement on 16 February 2018 as the cause of the split.](/images/chronicles/storytime/57-Map9Wynn2_-_Copy.webp){{cite:drew1011-storytime|working map "Map9Wynn2", part 17}}

Whether the departing guilds tried to settle the dispute before leaving is contested. Drew1011 wrote that they did not — "there were no straightforward and direct attempts to solve the issues beforehand" — while noting that others had claimed the opposite; he described the contacts he received as offhand remarks rather than negotiations.{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 17, composed 11 Jul 2018}} No account by any of the departing guilds survives.

### The Coalition Civil War
The war set Alliance Alliance against the Coalition remnant, which had merged with War Syndicate's remains into the new Federation. The Federation struck first and hardest: three days after forming, it attacked member guild HackForums' 111 territories and [[the-wipe-of-hackforums|wiped them to zero]] in under 12 hours, ending HackForums as a territorial power.{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}} The war's first engagement was an attack on [[emorians|Emorians]]' Llevigar territories, opened by Snowythewolf of Hall of Fame on 17 February; Emorians was bankrupt within two days{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 17, composed 30 Aug 2018}}. Drew1011 dated [[viaire|Viaire]]'s move of [[fantasy|Fantasy]] out of Alliance Alliance and into the Federation — mid-battle, in exchange for keeping his canyon territories — to 18 February, a month earlier than the guild's recorded membership boundary{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 17, composed 30 Aug 2018}}{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}.

The bloc's one recorded counter-offensive came a fortnight later, after a Wynncraft mob update took effect on 1 March 2018: Alliance Alliance attacked Gavel from midnight "using broken defenses that the vast majority of players were unable to overcome", held the initiative for several days, and lost the map again by 5 March{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 17, composed 30 Aug 2018}}. The Federation's founder called it the only break in the bloc's map control, "~3 days in March"{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}. Alliance Alliance held 308 of 383 territories on 3 March against the Federation's 43, and 236 on 4 March, before the Federation recovered to roughly 300 territories from 6 March{{cite:territory-exchanges|Alliance Alliance 308 of 383 territories, 3 Mar 2018}}.

The alliance then came apart guild by guild: Paladins United asked to join the Federation on 7 March and was admitted; House of Sentinels left Alliance Alliance on 12 March, briefly considered joining the Federation and instead returned to neutrality; and Kangronomicon largely stopped warring{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 17, composed 30 Aug 2018}}.

### The end date
The bloc's member stints closed on 19–20 March 2018. Alliance Alliance fell from 72 territories to one on 19 March, while the Federation reached 380 of 383 territories, or 99%, on 20 March{{cite:territory-exchanges|Alliance Alliance from 72 territories to one, 19–20 Mar 2018}}. No formal dissolution was ever recorded; Fantasy, Paladins United and Emorians appear on the Federation's rolls from the same date.{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}

The Federation had taken the map earlier, on 21 February 2018, when it held 356 of 383 territories{{cite:territory-exchanges|356 of 383 territories, 21 Feb 2018}}. The 20 March date sometimes given for the Federation taking map control{{cite:community-guild-timeline}} marks the end of the war rather than the change of map control. Drew1011 dated the bloc's end as a fighting force earlier still, to the week of 7–12 March, when Paladins United joined the Federation and House of Sentinels returned to neutrality{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 17, composed 30 Aug 2018}}; it went on holding territory in reduced numbers, around 75, until 19 March{{cite:territory-exchanges|Alliance Alliance holdings, 6–18 Mar 2018}}.

## Membership
{{alliance:Alliance Alliance}}

## Legacy
Alliance Alliance existed for barely a month, but its split ended the Coalition and provoked the merger that created the Federation, the alliance that dominated the rest of 2018 (the [[federation-era|Federation era]]). One participant, Slayne, later tied the Federation's creation directly to it: "I created Fed because I (along with some others) created Double AA."{{cite:thread-237070-p03|p3 #45, 14 Nov 2018}} Two of its seven guilds — Paladins United and Fantasy — were inside the Federation before the month was out.{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 17, composed 30 Aug 2018}}

articles.title: Arenos
articles.summary: Paladin A'renos organised Ordo Malleus in November 2015 and founded the Emperium of Wynn in April 2017, opening and keeping the forum thread of each. He officiated the Emperium's Emperator election.
articles.body:
## [[ordo-malleus|Ordo Malleus]]

The alliance thread "-= Ordo Malleus =-" was opened by Paladin A'renos on 6 November 2015 and ran to 296 replies before it was locked, its last post falling on 10 March 2016{{cite:forums-wynncraft-com-forums-guilds-72-prefix-id-82-order-post-date-direction-asc|complete census of Alliance-prefixed threads, page 1}}. A'renos was then a chief of Kangronomicon; he recruited the member guilds and created the alliance's leader chat{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L148–190, composed 22 Feb 2018}}. Within weeks, [[drew1011|Drew1011]] canvassed the other leaders and secured agreement to move alliance business to a new chat excluding A'renos, citing A'renos's manner toward them{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L186–190}}.

A'renos afterwards left Kangronomicon and bought the guild WynnTheory [WTh], admitted to Ordo Malleus on 3 February 2016 over Drew1011's objection{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L366–370}} and on the alliance's roster that 20 February{{cite:thread-109350|post #11, Drew1011, 20 Feb 2016}}. A'renos left Wynncraft after the alliance collapsed on 9 March 2016 and did not reappear for about a year, returning through an Ordo Malleus reunion Discord in early 2017; at Drew1011's request there, the deleted Ordo thread was restored{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L462, L692–695}}.

## The Emperium of Wynn

On 7 May 2017 A'renos opened the thread of the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]], describing it as "a Dynamic alliance that was formed on the 21st of April with the goal of uniting guilds of all levels and experience"{{cite:thread-188024|post #1, 7 May 2017}}. He kept the thread, defined its offices{{cite:thread-188024-p05|post #82, 16 Jun 2017, quoting the opening post}} and ran its monthly member awards{{cite:thread-188024-p03|post #60, 22 May 2017}}.

![Discord announcement by A'renos: "the time has come for the alliance to elect the @Emperator... If you would like to vote for @Nitrogen2Oxygen Please vote [N]. If you would rather vote for @Drew1011 Please vote [D]". The reaction tallies below read D = 30 and N = 31. The message's date was never recorded.](/images/chronicles/storytime/37-image.webp)

His departure was noted by another member on 4 September 2017 — "Such a sad time. Arenos leaves, Josh leaves and now my bot gets hecked"{{cite:thread-188024-p08|p8 #149, Nitrogen2Oxygen, 4 Sep 2017}} — though he returned on 17 October 2017 to write "bumity bump bump lets get this back up", one of the thread's last two posts{{cite:thread-188024-p08|p8 #154, 17 Oct 2017}}.

articles.title: Arkada
articles.summary: Titans Valor's Aedile and "chief negotiator", and author of a near-contemporaneous memoir of the Luna-Terra war of 2019.

infobox.label: Known for
infobox.value: The "Inside Myself" memoir of the [[luna-terra-war|Luna-Terra war]] (Sep 2019)

articles.body:
Arkada (forum name Leonhart_Arkada) was a member of [[titans-valor|Titans Valor]] [ANO], the guild founded by [[IceResistance]], and carried the forum title Aedile - "chief negotiator"{{cite:thread-252647|post #1, 20 Jul 2019}}.

In July 2019 he authored "An Argument Against The Current Monopoly On Territory", describing [[Luna]] as "the four most powerful guilds on Wynn" and comparing its dominance to the [[the-federation|Federation]]'s{{cite:thread-252647|post #1, 20 Jul 2019}}; [[drew1011|Drew1011]] replied with the era's standard defense of mega-alliance cycles{{cite:thread-252647|post #15, 29 Jul 2019}}.

Around 14 September 2019, with the [[luna-terra-war|Luna-Terra war]] still in motion, he published "Inside Myself - Recent Wynncraft Guild History" on Wattpad under the alias A_Challenger_Arrives - a near-contemporaneous memoir, written as events unfolded rather than years later{{cite:wattpad-com-784189853-inside-myself-recent-wynncraft-guild-history|c. 14 Sep 2019}}. It records that [[Valkyrie]] was "now calling themselves the Luna alliance"; that [[Terra]] formed from multiple small alliances merging "nearly 15 guilds", including The Ascendancy in which Titans Valor fought; that Terra's weekend raid conquered all Luna territories except [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]]' within six hours; and that Luna's organized counter-raid of 14 September failed{{cite:wattpad-com-784189853-inside-myself-recent-wynncraft-guild-history|c. 14 Sep 2019}}. As a participant's memoir it is partisan by nature, but its closeness to the events makes it the era's most valuable single narrative source.

articles.title: Artemis
articles.summary: Artemis was the dominant war alliance of the 2020 territory map, founded on 30 October 2019 by Imperial, Paladins United and Caeruleum Order. Its roster transformed almost completely across 2020 — by December both surviving founders were on the opposing side — and it collapsed on 11 May 2021 together with its rival Goose.

articles.title: The Artemis-Goose era
articles.summary: From the disbanding of DiamondDeities in January 2020 to the Great Collapse of 11 May 2021: Artemis held the map, its own founders drifted into the opposition that became Goose, and both alliances died on the same day. It is also the era in which the community began writing its own record down.
articles.body:
{{map:2021-02-01|The map at the height of the Goose-Artemis war}}

The Artemis-Goose era opens with the last aftershock of 2019 - [[Nitrogen2Oxygen]] disbanding [[DiamondDeities]] on 8 January 2020, which ended [[Horologium]] and birthed Lux Nova{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}} - and closes with the only day on which both major alliances died at once.

## Artemis transformed

[[Artemis]], founded on 30 October 2019 by [[Imperial]], [[Paladins United]] and Caeruleum Order{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}, became the era's map holder - but not with its founding roster. By March 2020 [[Kingdom Foxes]] was a member and [[ShadowFall]] held a leadership seat{{cite:thread-263975-p02|p2 #36, GoulartJJ, 9 Mar 2020}}; by December 2020 a megalist post described Artemis as 'the war alliance made up of all the current massive land holding guilds', including [[Titans Valor]]{{cite:thread-278112|p1 #10, Pally, 2 Dec 2020}} - while founders Paladins United and Imperial had drifted out and appear on the opposing side. The exact join and leave dates of this transformation were never documented.

## The chroniclers

Almost everything known about this era's alliances was written by a handful of identifiable people, and their guild affiliations matter to how the claims should be weighed. [[the-forum-megalist|The megalist]] itself was created and maintained by [[sg-voltage|Sg_Voltage]], whose own guild is unknown - a neutral registrar{{cite:thread-278112-wb20210704|post #1, capture of 4 Jul 2021}}. The December 2020 account of [[Hestia]] and Artemis was posted by [[paladinsorcerer|Pally]] of Titans Valor, a member of both{{cite:thread-278112|p1 #10, Pally, 2 Dec 2020}}. The 'Guild Moderators' thread that names the anti-Artemis coalition was written by Sheepn of Diablo [DXI], a coalition guild{{cite:thread-279337|post #1, Sheepn, 18 Dec 2020}}. The first written use of the name [[Goose]] came from 99loulou999 of The Dark Phoenix [TNI], with Eden's Lev98bug confirming his own guild's membership half an hour later{{cite:thread-278112-p04|p4 #71-73, 19 Jan 2021}}. The 1 February 2021 side-switch report is [[urbymine]]'s, a former Chief of [[Avicia]]{{cite:thread-278112-p04|p4 #76, urbymine, 1 Feb 2021}}. The only [[Niflheim]] roster ever posted was written by HungHung of Avicia{{cite:thread-278112-p08|p8 #146, HungHung, 7 Jul 2021}}. A two-part illustrated roster of Goose was drawn by [[drasalia|Drasalia]] of ChinaNumberOne{{cite:thread-289196|post #1, 30 Mar 2021}}{{cite:thread-289556|post #1, 6 Apr 2021}}. Every one of these writers was reporting on a bloc they belonged to, except Sg_Voltage.

## The social layer

Alongside the war blocs ran an unusually rich community-alliance layer: [[Hestia]] (formed ~mid-2020: Titans Valor, Empire of Sindria, Lux Nova, Paladins United, later Emorians and HackForums){{cite:thread-278112-p07|p7 #140, Pally, 6 Jun 2021}}, [[Niflheim]] (Avicia, IceBlue Team, ShadowFall, TheNoLifes){{cite:thread-278112-p08|p8 #146, HungHung, 7 Jul 2021}}, the [[Empire of Nemract]] (a political union of [[The Simple Ones]] and Mystic Woods from 17 August 2020, complete with an empress and court titles){{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}, and the perennial [[Valkyrie]].

## The rise of Goose

In December 2020 an 'unnamed group of anti-Artemis guilds' - [[Avicia]], [[Emorians]], [[Eden]], Ultra Violet, Diablo, Bovemists, The Dark Phoenix, and ex-founders Paladins United and Imperial among them - erupted against the map holder{{cite:thread-279337|post #1, Sheepn, 18 Dec 2020}}: 913 territory exchanges that month, after months of skirmishing{{cite:territory-exchanges|December 2020 territory exchange volume}}. By 19 January 2021 the coalition carried the name [[Goose]]{{cite:thread-278112-p04|p4 #71-73, 19 Jan 2021}}. It grew through spring: 'BNU(IBT), SHY and TNL are all goose now', urbymine recorded on 1 February 2021{{cite:thread-278112-p04|p4 #76, urbymine, 1 Feb 2021}} - ShadowFall switching sides from Artemis leadership - and by late March it had absorbed the future [[Khaos]] core ([[Aequitas]], WheresTheFinish, ChinaNumberOne, Fuzzy Spiders, Eden){{cite:thread-289196|post #1, 30 Mar 2021}}. Goose took map control as the [[goose-artemis-war|Goose-Artemis war]] ground on{{cite:territory-exchanges|Goose-Artemis war volumes, spring 2021}}.

The new arrivals were not all new guilds. Aequitas had existed since November 2019{{cite:api-wynncraft-com-v3-guild-aequitas|creation date 24 Nov 2019, retrieved 2 Sep 2026}} but only became publicly visible in this window: FrozenGalaxy opened its recruitment thread on 3 January 2021{{cite:thread-280525|post #1, thread created 3 Jan 2021}}, added it to the megalist a fortnight later{{cite:thread-278112-p04|p4 #66, FrozenGalaxy, 17 Jan 2021}}, and by 30 March it was one of the twelve guilds in Drasalia's fanart roster{{cite:thread-289196|post #1, 30 Mar 2021}}.

Mid-era, the game itself changed: version 1.20 'Gavel Reborn' (20 January 2021){{cite:thread-281822|post #1, 20 Jan 2021}} rebuilt [[territory-warfare|territory warfare]] around war towers and a guild resource economy, and introduced the in-game ally system{{cite:thread-277744|post #1, 'Guilds & Wars' sections, 23 Nov 2020}} (see [[the-diplomacy-update|The Diplomacy update]]). During the February 2021 argument over the rework, Eden members described crawling through Emorians territory held at medium and high defence{{cite:thread-286375|post #10, Plymouth, 20 Feb 2021}}.

## Profession Heaven's neutrality

On 25 January 2021 the warring blocs jointly granted [[Profession Heaven]] neutral status as a public profession-XP guild, protected by both Goose and Artemis and given Silent Expanse territory{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}} - a protection honoured by successor alliances for over five years. The guild had been founded five days earlier by [[crokee|Crokee]]{{cite:api-wynncraft-com-v3-guild-profession-20heaven|creation date 20 Jan 2021, retrieved 2 Sep 2026}}{{cite:thread-285237|post #1, Crokee}}; who brokered the pact was never recorded.

## The Great Collapse

On 11 May 2021 Goose and Artemis both collapsed on the same day - [[the-great-collapse|the Great Collapse]]. Thirteen guilds, including [[The Aquarium]], formed [[Valhalla]]; nine formed [[Khaos]]{{cite:thread-278112-p07|p7 #134-137, 25 May 2021}}; and the [[the-realignment-era|realignment era]] began with the two new blocs already at war.

articles.title: Astrafteri Affinity
articles.summary: The Astrafteri Affinity, written Astrafterí Affinity and shortened to Astra, was a Wynncraft alliance of 2016 founded by coralialia. It mixed small guilds with large ones, took in HackForums during that guild's expulsion from Ordo Malleus, and decayed through the summer of 2016.

infobox.label: Members named
infobox.value: [[hackforums|HackForums]], [[blacklisted|Blacklisted]], The Sebbelonien Plebs, Cats and Turtles, Dragons Arise, Holders of LE

articles.body:
## Founding

coralialia, posting as qqcora, wrote in June 2016: "refer to the alliance i created, astraffinity, which is a combination of many small guilds and big guilds, including hax"{{cite:thread-130386-p02|post #30, 9 Jun 2016, quoting coralialia}}. [[drew1011|Drew1011]], her guild leader at the time, wrote that she founded it after leaving Holders of LE, "to rival Ordo, as she had begun to hate both Arenos and Kru"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L352–353, composed 26 Feb 2018}}, and placed the founding in about January 2016. No reason for its creation was recorded at the time.

By 11 February 2016 [[hackforums|HackForums]]' recruitment thread listed "Astrafterí-affinity" under **Alliances** in its opening post{{cite:thread-109319|post #13, 11 Feb 2016, quoting the HackForums opening post}}. The alliance's own thread, "✯ Astrafterí Affinity ✯", was posted on 3 April 2016 — by LordMuttonChops, not by coralialia — and drew 14 replies before being locked{{cite:forums-wynncraft-com-forums-guilds-72-prefix-id-82-order-post-date-direction-asc|complete census of Alliance-prefixed threads, page 1}}.

## Membership and character

The Sebbelonien Plebs, [[blacklisted|Blacklisted]], Cats and Turtles and Dragons Arise were members{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L352–359}}. Drew1011 wrote that he joined Holders of LE to it in March 2016 as a hedge while [[valkyrie|Valkyrie]] membership was being negotiated{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L466}}. Its founder put its size at "over 10 guilds, and every single one of them would back hax up if anyone tried to do something like this" — a claim made in the middle of an argument on an anti-HackForums thread{{cite:thread-130386-p02|post #30, 9 Jun 2016, quoting coralialia}}. Later that month she distinguished it from the informal understanding then holding the map: told by an UltimateXeons member that "our alliance with Hax and Lir" was letting three guilds keep their territory, she replied that this was "a mutual land agreement" and pointed him at the Astrafteri thread as "the actual alliance"{{cite:thread-133666|post #16, qqcora, 28 Jun 2016}}.

## HackForums and the alliance's end

In Drew1011's account, HackForums' rise ran through the alliance: "In Astra their power grew exponentially. They no longer had a massive list of allies that they could not attack, and had much more freedom in wars." As the alliance's guilds went inactive, "Astra eventually died, but Hax remained. They stayed in an alliance with [[libertas|Libertas]], and divided all of Wynn amongst themselves and a few others such as [[blacklisted|Blacklisted]]"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L508–512}}. He gave no dates for any of it{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L518}}.

On one point the contemporaneous record differs from his sequence. He places HackForums' move into Astra after the collapse of [[ordo-malleus|Ordo Malleus]] on 9 March 2016; the HackForums opening post already listed the alliance on 11 February 2016{{cite:thread-109319|post #13, 11 Feb 2016}}, during the weeks the same account says HackForums was expelled from Ordo{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L333–342}}. The alliance's last recorded activity was the closure of its thread; the final post is dated 14 September 2016{{cite:forums-wynncraft-com-forums-guilds-72-prefix-id-82-order-post-date-direction-asc|complete census of Alliance-prefixed threads, page 1}}.

articles.title: Aurelion
articles.summary: Aurelion was a four-guild community alliance formed in February 2017 around House of Sentinels, with Hippies of Snuggles, The Dark Phoenix and Dragons Arise joining over the following fortnight. It ran its own Discord and last appears in April 2017; no war activity is recorded for it.
articles.body:
Aurelion is the only [[early-guild-era|early guild era]] alliance whose membership timeline is recorded to the day.

## History

House of Sentinels, founded on 2 July 2016 and describing itself as "a place of respite for those who need it", named itself "a member guild of Aurelion, a community alliance", with a dated join for each member{{cite:thread-135191|post #1, as last revised 29 Apr 2017}}:

| Guild | Joined |
|---|---|
| House of Sentinels | 14 Feb 2017 |
| Hippies of Snuggles | 15 Feb 2017 |
| The Dark Phoenix | 26 Feb 2017 |
| Dragons Arise | 27 Feb 2017 |

The alliance ran a Discord server open enough that outsiders used it as a point of contact: an applicant to House of Sentinels wrote on 30 April 2017 that "when I went on the Aurelion Discord, I asked if I could claim refugee status and someone told me to apply"{{cite:thread-187152|post #20, 30 Apr 2017}} — the last mention of Aurelion anywhere, and a sign it was still operating that spring.

House of Sentinels' 2017 council was Pyrias, Pretzule, wrxryuu, [[killerfish|Killerfish]], ChaChaChaChino and 01100110111;{{cite:thread-135191|post #1, as last revised 29 Apr 2017}} by 30 April 2017 Pretzule led it and it had begun "focusing on warring with other guilds and maintaining territory";{{cite:thread-187152|post #1, Pretzule}} and it went on to become one of the four founding guilds of the [[coalition|Coalition]] in October 2017.{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}

## Membership

The four guilds above are the complete known membership. No founding announcement was ever posted, and who led the alliance was never recorded.

## Legacy

Aurelion left no record of warring, no dissolution notice and no successor. Its interest lies in what it says about the road to the Coalition: seven months before that alliance was founded, its future core guild was already the anchor of a small community bloc with its own Discord, recruiting refugees from collapsing guilds. Dragons Arise belonged in the same period to another community alliance, Lux Imperius{{cite:thread-109350|post #1, "Old alliances" section}} — an illustration of how loosely these 2016-17 community pacts overlapped.
articles.leadImageCaption: Guild emblem of House of Sentinels, the guild Aurelion was built around: an orange phoenix rising above the words 'House of Sentin.

articles.title: AurumKitsune
articles.summary: "Queen of the Phoenixes" who founded KingdomPhoenixes in September 2017, a month before it joined the Coalition's founding circle, and later established the Federation's two-thirds-majority voting rule.
articles.body:
AurumKitsune founded the guild KingdomPhoenixes [PHX], announcing it on the forums on 24 September 2017 under the title "Queen of the Phoenixes"{{cite:thread-204381|post #1 (OP); thread opened 24 Sep 2017}}. The guild was "officially established" on 23 September 2017 - "We arose from the ashes of a dead guild, and re-birthed the spark that was missing!"{{cite:thread-204381|post #9, 24 Sep 2017}} - with Whimsy and Thundderr as its first chiefs{{cite:thread-204381|post #1 (OP)}}. One month later KingdomPhoenixes stood among the founder guilds of the [[Coalition]] (created October 2017), making AurumKitsune's brand-new guild part of the founding circle alongside [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]], Gilded Sparrows and House of Sentinels{{cite:thread-265297|post #1, community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ)}}.

Her larger legacy came in the [[the-federation|Federation]] (2018). [[drew1011|Drew1011]]'s "Federation Tribute" credits AurumKitsune with building the alliance's Discord infrastructure and with establishing its two-thirds-majority voting rule - the governance mechanism by which the alliance that held the whole map made its decisions{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}. Her own reply in the tribute thread added: "I still can not believe that I made the logo for fed a meme and it was never changed. Deus Vult!"{{cite:thread-237070-p03|p3 #43, 14 Nov 2018}}

articles.title: Avicia
articles.summary: Wynncraft guild founded in 2018 by birdiefly209. The last guild standing when Luna wiped the map in 2019's alliance wars, a member of Goose, Niflheim, Valhalla, Vanir, Cucumber Company, Adonis and smtn elf, half of the Avocado Aquarium pact, and a belligerent in the largest war ever recorded, against Aequitas in 2025.
articles.leadImageCaption: Avicia's guild banner: a white outlined bird in flight at upper left on a mottled deep-blue ground.

articles.title: Avicia-Sequoia war
articles.summary: Avicia's war with the young Sequoia: skirmishes through spring 2023, a main eruption from 30 October to 20 November 2023 peaking at 1,454 territory exchanges per week, and a second round in January 2024.
articles.body:
The Avicia-Sequoia war was fought between [[Avicia]], a veteran of every major bloc since 2019, and [[Sequoia]], a guild barely a year old — founded 14 October 2022{{cite:api-wynncraft-com-v3-guild-sequoia|guild creation date, 14 Oct 2022}} — whose rise it did nothing to stop.

{{map:2023-10-30|The map when the main eruption began}}

{{war-chart:Avicia|Sequoia|2023-10-15|2024-02-13}}

## Background

The war belongs to [[private-diplomacy-era|the private-diplomacy era]]: it was never declared, never discussed on the forums, and its cause was never named{{cite:territory-exchanges|no written record of this war exists}}. Skirmishing between the two guilds is visible through spring 2023{{cite:territory-exchanges|Avicia-Sequoia skirmishing, spring 2023}}, while Avicia was still in [[smtn elf]] and then in the [[Avocado Aquarium]] pact.

## Course of the war

The main eruption ran from 30 October to 20 November 2023, peaking at 1,454 territory exchanges per week. A second round followed in January 2024{{cite:territory-exchanges|war windows and weekly peak, 30 Oct – 20 Nov 2023 and Jan 2024}}{{cite:chronicle-records|Avicia-Sequoia war}}. Which side held the advantage is not known.

## Aftermath

Sequoia's rise continued regardless of the war: from mid-2024 it won seven consecutive [[guild-seasons|guild seasons]]{{cite:wynncraft-wiki-gg-wiki-guild-seasons|Seasons 19–25, 24 Jun 2024 – 20 Jul 2025}}. Sequoia and [[Aequitas]] would later fight the decade's closing wars, including [[aequitas-sequoia-war|the ongoing war of 2026]]; Avicia went on to fight [[aequitas-avicia-war|the largest war ever recorded]] in late 2025.

articles.title: Avocado Aquarium
articles.summary: Avocado Aquarium was the two-guild war pact of Avicia and The Aquarium after they quit smtn elf in June 2023, waging a sniping and claim-taking campaign against their former allies into early 2024. The pair ran shared infrastructure including the joint subguild Avoquarium [HQs]; the pact's name was never written down while it existed.

articles.title: bitesizedbee4
articles.summary: The Titans Valor member who wrote and signed the first six volumes of the guild's newsletter, Titan Times, between May and October 2022 - the volumes that date Cucumber Company's formation and its rename to Smtn else.
articles.body:
bitesizedbee4, credited in the newsletter as Bee, signed volumes 1 to 6 of [[Titans Valor]]'s newsletter [[titan-times|Titan Times]], published between 8 May 2022{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol1|vol. 1, 8 May 2022, closing signature}} and 12 October 2022{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol6|vol. 6, 12 Oct 2022, closing signature}}, writing each of them alone. Volume 1's closing remarks describe the work as an inheritance rather than a founding - 'I was really unsure about taking over the Times on my own, and spent a lot of days putting it off because I didn't want to fall short of anyone's expectations'{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol1|vol. 1, 8 May 2022, closing remarks}} - though what preceded volume 1, if anything, is not recorded.

Volume 7 (16 December 2022) expanded the newsletter to a team of writers; Bee contributed the article 'Events: A Deeper Dive on Their Impacts', built on a member survey about in-game and guild-hosted events, and the volume closed 'Thank you Snazz, Geb, and Bee for writing this volume!'{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol7|vol. 7, 16 Dec 2022}}. The same volume lists bitesizedbee4 among members promoted to Sorcerer, noted as 'now Artificer'{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol7|vol. 7, 16 Dec 2022, promotions}}. She is still the narrating voice of the Ocean Trials explainer in volume 8 of 18 February 2023 - 'Hey Bee, what's Ocean Trials?'{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol8|vol. 8, 18 Feb 2023}} - after which the newsletter's bylines pass to other writers{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol10|vol. 10, 23 Apr 2023, bylines}}.

Her volumes are the principal dated record of the alliance politics of 2022. Volume 1 places the formation of [[Cucumber Company]] at the start of guild Season 5{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol1|vol. 1, 8 May 2022}}, and volume 6 records its archiving and rename to 'Smtn else' at the start of Season 8{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol6|vol. 6, 12 Oct 2022}} - see [[smtn elf]].

articles.title: Blacklisted
articles.summary: A pirate-themed war guild founded on 19 January 2016 under NeonRider and Naraka00, and the third partner of the bloc that held the territory map in 2016 and 2017 alongside HackForums and Libertas. It later warred in Luna, Cucumber Company and smtn elf, and is still registered today.
articles.leadImageCaption: Blacklisted's guild banner: the guild name in distressed black lettering over a parchment map.

articles.title: C0rupted
articles.summary: A Titans Valor member, a writer for the guild newsletter Titan Times from volume 12 (February 2024) to volume 21 (May 2026), and the lead developer of the rewrite of the guild's Discord bot, Valor.

infobox.label: Known for
infobox.value: [[titan-times|Titan Times]] writer, vols. 12-21; rewrite of the Valor Discord bot

articles.body:
C0rupted, a member of [[Titans Valor]] [ANO] and a developer on the guild's software, introduced himself in volume 12 of its newsletter [[titan-times|Titan Times]] (20 February 2024) as 'the new writer, C0rupted, taking up the mantle'{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol12|vol. 12, 20 Feb 2024}}, wrote volume 13{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol13|vol. 13, 22 Mar 2024}} and volume 14{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol14|vol. 14, 24 May 2024}}, and from volume 19 onward covered the Brilliance cabinet, the guild's technical team{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol19|vol. 19, 2 Aug 2025, Brilliance cabinet}}{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol21|vol. 21, 18 May 2026, Brilliance cabinet}}. He was still on the masthead in volume 21, the last published volume{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol21|vol. 21, 18 May 2026, masthead}}.

He overhauled the guild's Discord bot{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol14|vol. 14, 24 May 2024, Brilliance cabinet}}; the project, originally planned as a lightweight spin-off called Valor Lite, grew into a full rewrite 'with C0rupted leading the charge on the massive slash command overhaul', giving the bot a new command framework built on Discord's slash commands{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol20|vol. 20, 23 Nov 2025}}. By November 2025 he had 'officially become a Titan'{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol20|vol. 20, 23 Nov 2025, promotions}}.

![Example output of the -guild command on Titans Valor's Discord bot Valor, shown in Titan Times vol. 13 (22 March 2024): a guild's level, owner, member count, territory count, war count and creation date, above a list of the members online.](/images/chronicles/media/c0rupted-59a7fc93.webp){{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol13|vol. 13, 22 Mar 2024}}

He won the guild's Ocean Trials 'Champion of the Ocean' title for guild Season 24 with 1,360 wars, and placed second in Season 25 with 2,390{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol19|vol. 19, 2 Aug 2025, Seasons 24 and 25 Ocean Trials}}. He passed the guild's Strategist test twice, in May 2024 and again in August 2025{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol14|vol. 14, 24 May 2024, strategist promotions}}{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol19|vol. 19, 2 Aug 2025, strategist promotions}}; the repetition was never explained.

articles.title: Calluum
articles.summary: Owner of Titans Valor, which he joined in April 2021. Titan Times marked his two-year mark as leader in February 2024 and interviewed him in November 2025, where he described taking the role because 'no one else wanted it when pally was stepping down'.

infobox.label: Role
infobox.value: Owner; on the guild's Sage Council by May 2022

articles.body:
Calluum is the owner of [[titans-valor|Titans Valor]] [ANO]. He joined the guild on 4 April 2021 and held the owner slot as of September 2026, with roughly 671 billion guild XP contributed{{cite:api-wynncraft-com-v3-guild-titans-20valor|v3/guild response, retrieved 3 Sep 2026}}.

He sat at the Sage Council tier of the guild's new hierarchy in May 2022{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol1|vol. 1, 8 May 2022}}, and thereafter organised events and provided prizes — running the guild's Secret Santa in December 2022, for example{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol7|vol. 7, 16 Dec 2022}}. His name was also rendered 'Callum', sometimes within a single volume of [[titan-times|Titan Times]]{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol7|vol. 7, 16 Dec 2022}}; volume 20 warned readers not to confuse him with another member, 'Mayor callluuum'{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol20|vol. 20, 23 Nov 2025}}.

## Leadership of Titans Valor

Volume 12, of 20 February 2024, congratulated 'Calluum for hitting the two-year mark as our leader'{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol12|vol. 12, 20 Feb 2024}}, which would place the start of his tenure around February 2022. That sits awkwardly against the same newsletter's earlier record of the handover: volume 6, of 12 October 2022, still announced 'the long term hiatus of ANO's founder, IceResistance', and volume 9, of 25 March 2023, is the first to call [[iceresistance|IceResistance]] the guild's 'previous owner'{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol6|vol. 6, 12 Oct 2022}}{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol9|vol. 9, 25 Mar 2023}}. The two datings were never reconciled.

Interviewed for volume 20 on 23 November 2025 — introduced as 'our glorious leader Cal' — he described how he came to the role: 'No one else wanted it when pally was stepping down, so I realised I'd need to step up and take on the mantle.'{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol20|vol. 20, 23 Nov 2025}} The succession thus ran IceResistance, then a leader he called 'pally', then Calluum. Who 'pally' was is not known. [[paladinsorcerer|PaladinSorcerer]] posted as 'Pally' for Titans Valor in 2020 and 2021{{cite:thread-278112|post #10, 2 Dec 2020}}, but Titan Times volume 3, of 12 June 2022, lists him among recipients of the Veteran Medal, 'granted to distinguished former members of ANO'{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol3|vol. 3, 12 Jun 2022}}.

## Views

In the same interview he described the guild landscape as having deteriorated over his time in it: 'Everything was entirely different, guilds were entirely roleplay and prestige driven rather than materialistically like they are these days', and, asked whether the changes had been for better or worse, 'I would definitely say for worse. Guild changes have forced smaller communities out and pushed an incredibly stale narrative of large guilds dominating the entire map.' His proposed remedies were to make defending worth its effort, 'reduce guild member caps and the maximum number of defendable territories to prevent megaclaims', and reduce guild XP from guild raids{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol20|vol. 20, 23 Nov 2025}}. The complaint about large guilds monopolising the map is the same one the warring community raised against the [[gavel-reborn|1.20 rework]] in 2021.

He remained an active warrer as well as owner, placing third in Titans Valor's internal war leaderboard for [[guild-seasons|Season 28]] with 381 wars, and announcing a data-collection collaboration with the group Wynn Analytics{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol21|vol. 21, 18 May 2026}}.
