articles.title: Coalition
articles.summary: The Coalition was a Wynncraft war alliance founded in October 2017 by Kingdom Foxes, KingdomPhoenixes, Gilded Sparrows and House of Sentinels; planning began around 19 October. It destroyed War Syndicate in the Gavel Invasion, held all 349 territories by Christmas 2017, and shattered on 16 February 2018 over a proposed division of Wynn.

infobox.label: Founding guilds
infobox.value: [[Kingdom Foxes]] and KingdomPhoenixes (joint), then Gilded Sparrows, then House of Sentinels

infobox.label: Peak size
infobox.value: 14 guilds at the declaration of war, 21 Dec 2017

articles.body:
## History

### The founders
The Coalition never announced itself on the forums: no founding thread, roster or declaration was ever posted{{cite:archive-search-method|Wayback CDX sweep of forums.wynncraft.com thread slugs (19,659 URLs)}}. The guild subforum's run of Alliance-prefixed threads jumps straight from Amnesty (30 August 2017) and the Emperium of Wynn's second thread (4 September 2017) to Revolution (25 April 2018){{cite:forums-wynncraft-com-forums-guilds-72-prefix-id-82-order-post-date-direction-asc|complete census of Alliance-prefixed threads, page 1}}{{cite:forums-wynncraft-com-forums-guilds-72-page-2-prefix-id-82-order-post-date-directi|complete census of Alliance-prefixed threads, page 2}}{{cite:thread-202167|post #1, 30 Aug 2017}}{{cite:thread-224905|post #1, 25 Apr 2018}}. By late 2017 alliance diplomacy had moved to Discord, and the Coalition is the first major Wynncraft alliance with no forum existence at all. The founding is dated only to October 2017; no day was ever recorded{{cite:community-guild-timeline|Community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ), via Wynncraft forums thread 265297}}{{cite:community-guild-timeline}}.

[[drew1011|Drew1011]], one of the founders, placed the proposal "in mid October"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 13, composed 4 Mar 2018}} and, closing his account of the Gavel Invasion on 25 December 2017, wrote that "67 days after the planning had begun, victory had been achieved"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 15, composed 20 May 2018}} — placing the start of planning at **about 19 October 2017**.

The four founders joined in order: "It was Fox and Phx that cofounded it, with Spr (the guild Fishie had made) being the third guild to join, and Snt being the fourth."{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 13, composed 4 Mar 2018}} Drew1011 gave the alliance's purpose as his own design: "From there we would grow our alliance with the sole purpose of bringing down War Syndicate."{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 13, composed 4 Mar 2018}}

![A Discord message from the KingdomPhoenixes parliament channel, forwarded to Drew1011, in which the guild's leader raises "a temporary alliance" with Kingdom Foxes "purely for the sake of elimination of BCr". Drew1011 presented this as the proposal that produced the Coalition.](/images/chronicles/storytime/41-image.webp){{cite:drew1011-storytime|the mid-October 2017 proposal screenshot, part 13}}

The four founding guilds can be described from their own threads, and two of them were barely older than the alliance:

- **KingdomPhoenixes** [Phx], led by [[aurumkitsune|AurumKitsune]] as "Queen of the Phoenixes", was "officially established" on 23 Sep 2017 — one month before the Coalition — and described itself as having "arose from the ashes of a dead guild"{{cite:thread-204381|post #1, 24 Sep 2017}}. It was a splinter of Kingdom Foxes{{cite:community-guild-timeline}} and had been a [[war-syndicate|War Syndicate]] member, leaving that bloc weeks before co-founding the Coalition{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 13, composed 4 Mar 2018}}.
- **Gilded Sparrows**, founded by [[killerfish|Killerfish]] and announced on 17 Nov 2017, was newer still: "Founded in the midst of autumn... although the guild itself is taking its first steps, its leader is not a novice at what he does."{{cite:thread-208566|post #1, 17 Nov 2017}} Its founding thread postdates the Coalition's founding by a month, though guilds routinely predated their threads. Drew1011 wrote that he did most of its warring on its owner's account because "Fishie was the only one in the guild"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 14, composed 22 Mar 2018}}.
- **House of Sentinels**, founded 2 Jul 2016 by Pyrias, was led by Pretzule from at least Apr 2017; that spring it turned deliberately toward warring — "Due to a few reasons our guild will also be focusing on warring with other guilds and maintaining territory"{{cite:thread-187152|post #1}} — after a year as a community guild in the [[aurelion|Aurelion]] alliance{{cite:thread-135191|post #1}}.
- **[[Kingdom Foxes]]** is the oldest of the four, founded in 2014 and a co-founder of [[Valkyrie]] in 2015 under [[lovelusting|LoveLusting]]{{cite:thread-89529|post #1}}. It was also a member of the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]] in the months before the Coalition formed{{cite:thread-202724|post #1, OP as last revised 17 Oct 2017}}; Drew1011, its Viceroy and the Emperium's Shadow Advisor, wrote that by mid-October, when the Coalition was proposed, "the Emperium was completely dead at that point"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 13, composed 4 Mar 2018}}.

The founders were one social circle before they were an alliance. Killerfish sat on House of Sentinels' council alongside Pyrias and Pretzule{{cite:thread-135191|post #1, as revised 29 Apr 2017}}, and had helped write the [[halcyon|Halcyon]] alliance thread that June alongside Drew1011{{cite:thread-130444|post #1, 8 Jun 2016}}; Drew1011 posted congratulations on both the KingdomPhoenixes and the Gilded Sparrows announcement threads{{cite:thread-208566|post #3, 17 Nov 2017}}.

### Rise to map dominance
The Coalition took control of the Wynn Province on 23 Nov 2017{{cite:community-guild-timeline}} — in Drew1011's words, the day "the Coalition first took control of every territory on the **Wynn mainland**", not of the whole map{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 14, composed 22 Mar 2018}}. A labelled map of that day shows the mainland held entirely by Coalition guilds, with only Titans Valor's island territories and one other guild's holdings outside it.

![The Wynncraft territory map of 23 November 2017, every mainland territory labelled with a Coalition guild — Kingdom Foxes, KingdomPhoenixes, Gilded Sparrows, Necronomicon, Hall of Fame, House of Sentinels, LE Flowers, Dishonored and Immortalish — with only island territories held by others. From Drew1011's storytime account.](/images/chronicles/storytime/44-image.webp){{cite:drew1011-storytime|map of 23 Nov 2017, part 14}}

He attributed the alliance's growth to War Syndicate's standing rule against attacking the province of Wynn: "the War Syndicate had given us over 100 territories on a silver platter... they divided Gavel amongst themselves, and we divided Wynn amongst ourselves"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 14, composed 22 Mar 2018}}. Three events immediately preceded the invasion: [[fantasy|Fantasy]]'s defection from War Syndicate to the Coalition{{cite:thread-227373|post #1, 21 Jul 2018}}, Fantasy's capture of Corkus from [[paladins-united|Paladins United]], and the revival of [[hackforums|HackForums]], whose owner Drew1011 wrote he had personally recruited on the understanding that Hax would help "deal with War Syndicate" once revived{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 14, composed 22 Mar 2018}}.

That December the Coalition destroyed [[war-syndicate|War Syndicate]] in a four-day campaign beginning 21 Dec 2017 — "they wiped ws off the map on Christmas day," as a participant on the losing side put it{{cite:thread-265297-p02|post #34, 14 Apr 2020}} — and held "all 349 territories on the map" by the end of 25 December{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 15, composed 20 May 2018}}. The day-by-day course of that campaign is set out on the [[war-syndicate|War Syndicate]] page. Another participant disputed the wipe, holding that the two blocs merged instead{{cite:thread-265297|post #16, 4 Apr 2020}}.

At the declaration of war on 21 December 2017 the alliance numbered fourteen guilds: DeathReapers [DxR], Dishonored [TOH], [[fantasy|Fantasy]] [Fux], [[hackforums|HackForums]] [Hax], Hall of Fame [HoF], Hippies of Snuggles [HOS], House of Sentinels [Snt], Immortalish [Smd], Kasai Shinrai [Two], [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]] [Fox], KingdomPhoenixes [Phx], LE Flowers [LEF], Necronomicon [Feq] and Serpentem Empire [SNK]{{cite:drew1011-storytime|roster at the declaration of war, part 14, composed 22 Mar 2018}}. [[paladins-united|Paladins United]] joined during the war — "the only addition to our roster during the war", negotiated with its owner Olinite and with [[slayne|Slayne]], "the one doing most of the warring for PUN", days after Coalition guilds had taken Corkus from them{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 15, composed 20 May 2018}} — and [[imperial|Imperial]] was admitted after it on a second vote{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 16, composed 20 May 2018}}.

### Dividing the map, and the split
Two internal fractures followed. Necronomicon and Hippies of Snuggles left during the post-war division of territory in late December 2017, over their allocations; Drew1011 disputed both guilds' grounds for leaving, and neither guild's side was ever recorded{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 16, composed 20 May 2018}}. On 11 January 2018 the alliance's Discord server was deleted; Drew1011 declined to give the cause{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 16, composed 20 May 2018}}.

The alliance's fatal defect, in its founder's own words, was that it had divided Gavel but not Wynn: "In Wynn, Coalition guilds could attack enemies, but not allies. (This oversight would come back to cause major problems for the alliance, and eventually be the main reason for its demise.)"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 16, composed 20 May 2018}} A proposal to divide Wynn was first made by Drew1011 and dropped; AscendedKitten of Imperial then re-proposed it and called a vote, which passed{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 17, composed 11 Jul 2018}}. A working map drawn during that exercise recorded the alliance's holdings guild by guild.

![A working map of Gavel from the February 2018 redivision, overlaid with a legend reading "Territory Counts (377/377)": HackForums 101, Paladins United 65, Kingdom Foxes 49, House of Sentinels 45, Hall of Fame 26, Kangronomicon 26, Holders of LE 19, Imperial 19, LE Flowers 19, Emorians 4, and four single-territory guilds. From Drew1011's storytime account.](/images/chronicles/storytime/56-Map9_-_Copy.webp){{cite:drew1011-storytime|working map "Map9" with territory-count legend, part 17}}

The final allocation ran: Hax ~64, PUN ~50, HoF 38, Fox 36, Snt 36, Imp 32, Fuq 25, Phx 24, LEF 20, HoL 19, ERN 17, SNK 9, Smd 3{{cite:drew1011-storytime|allocation list, part 17, composed 11 Jul 2018}}. No other pre-2019 Wynncraft alliance's per-guild allocation was ever recorded.

### The split
On 16–17 Feb 2018 (the community guild-timeline image dates the split to the 16th{{cite:community-guild-timeline|Community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ), via Wynncraft forums thread 265297}}, the Timeline document to the 17th{{cite:community-guild-timeline}}), five member guilds — [[HackForums]], [[Paladins United]], House of Sentinels, [[Emorians]] and Kangronomicon — left over map disputes and formed [[Alliance Alliance]] together with [[Fantasy]] and Necronomicon, declaring war on their former alliance and beginning the [[coalition-civil-war|Coalition Civil War]]{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}. The departures came within an hour of the allocation's announcement: "Hax, PUN, Snt, Fuq, and Emorians [ERN] left and made their own alliance combined with Fux and Feq. They attacked the rest of the Coalition, and had the map before the night was over."{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 17, composed 11 Jul 2018}}

Drew1011 disputed later claims that the departing guilds had tried to resolve the dispute first, writing that "there were no straightforward and direct attempts to solve the issues beforehand"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 17, composed 11 Jul 2018}}. The departing guilds' own account of that period was never recorded.

The Coalition remnant merged with War Syndicate's remains into the new [[the-federation|Federation]], ending the Coalition as an entity{{cite:thread-265297|post #16, 4 Apr 2020}}; the civil war itself ran until the Federation took control of the map on 20 Mar 2018{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}. A participant described the sequence: "When Coalition was taking its toll, Fux and SDU were offered to join a new alliance together, The Federation."{{cite:thread-227373|post #1, 21 Jul 2018}}

Even the genealogy was disputed among participants. One held that "Coa and WS merged... this was a creation of fed"{{cite:thread-265297|post #16, 4 Apr 2020}}, while [[slayne|Slayne]] wrote in 2018: "I created Fed because I (along with some others) created Double AA."{{cite:thread-237070-p03|post #45, 14 Nov 2018}}

### The record
The territory-exchange log begins in January 2018, after the Coalition formed; the guilds' real join dates were never recorded, and the membership of the five departing guilds rests on their documented February 2018 departures rather than on recorded joins{{cite:territory-exchanges|territory_exchanges map-data analysis}}. The alliance posted no founding thread, member list, takeover post, invasion thread or split thread. Most of its history — the planning date, the stated purpose, the rosters and the course of the split — rests on Drew1011's storytime account, written between March and July 2018 by a founder of the losing side of the split; beyond it and the community timeline, the Coalition's third-party trace is a handful of retrospective one-liners{{cite:thread-252647|post #5, 21 Jul 2019}}.

## Membership
{{alliance:Coalition}}

## Legacy
Both of the great blocs of 2018 descend from the Coalition: Alliance Alliance from its defectors, and the Federation from its remnant{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}. The Federation went on to hold the entire map for most of a year, defining the [[federation-era|Federation era]]{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}} — and the Coalition's brief, total dominance became the template every later map-holding alliance would be measured against; a 2019 poster listed it alongside "Federation, Hax & Co" as one of the recurring mega-alliances of Wynn's history{{cite:thread-252647|post #5, 21 Jul 2019}}. It was also the last major alliance of the [[early-guild-era|early guild era]] to leave no thread of its own: from 2018 onward the blocs announced themselves on the forums again{{cite:forums-wynncraft-com-forums-guilds-72-page-2-prefix-id-82-order-post-date-directi|complete census of Alliance-prefixed threads, page 2}}.

articles.title: Coalition Civil War
articles.summary: The February–March 2018 war between the Coalition and Alliance Alliance, the breakaway bloc formed by five of its member guilds. The newly formed Federation took the map on 21 February 2018 and ended the war on 19–20 March by reducing Alliance Alliance to a single territory.

infobox.label: Outcome
infobox.value: The [[the-federation|Federation]] took the map on 21 Feb 2018 and reduced [[Alliance Alliance]] to one territory on 19–20 Mar 2018; both belligerent alliances ceased to exist

articles.body:
The newly formed [[the-federation|Federation]] took control of the map on 21 February 2018{{cite:territory-exchanges|356 of 383 territories, 21 Feb 2018}}, and the war ended on 19–20 March, when Alliance Alliance was reduced from 72 territories to one{{cite:territory-exchanges|Alliance Alliance from 72 territories to one, 19–20 Mar 2018}}{{cite:community-guild-timeline|20 Mar 2018 entry}}, opening the [[federation-era|Federation era]].

{{map:2018-02-17|The map when the Coalition split}}

## Background

The Coalition was founded in October 2017 by [[Kingdom Foxes]], KingdomPhoenixes, Gilded Sparrows and House of Sentinels{{cite:community-guild-timeline|Oct 2017 entry}}. It took control of the Wynn Province on 23 November 2017, wiped War Syndicate on Christmas Day, and from then on held full dominance of the map{{cite:community-guild-timeline|23 Nov and 21–25 Dec 2017 entries}}.

## Course of the war

On 16–17 February 2018, five member guilds — [[HackForums]], [[Paladins United]], House of Sentinels, [[Emorians]] and Kangronomicon — left the Coalition over map disputes and formed Alliance Alliance together with [[Fantasy]] and Necronomicon, declaring war on their former alliance. (The community timeline image dates the split to 16 February{{cite:thread-265297|post #1, the community guild-timeline image}}; the Timeline document says 17 February{{cite:community-guild-timeline|17 Feb 2018 entry}}.)

The split ended the Coalition as an entity almost at once: its remnant merged with the remains of War Syndicate into a new alliance, the Federation, founded and led by [[Drew1011]]{{cite:thread-265297|post #16, Lego_DW, 4 Apr 2020}}{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}. Three days later the Federation destroyed HackForums' territorial holdings in a single half-day operation — see [[the-wipe-of-hackforums|The wipe of HackForums]].

Daily bloc holdings across the war{{cite:territory-exchanges|daily ownership reconstruction, 5 Feb – 10 Apr 2018}}:

| Date | Federation | Alliance Alliance | Territories on the map |
|---|---|---|---|
| 17 Feb | 28 | 337 | 376 |
| 19 Feb | 134 | 187 | 379 |
| 20 Feb | 272 | 38 | 383 |
| 21 Feb | 356 | 24 | 383 |
| 2 Mar | 164 | 157 | 383 |
| 3 Mar | 43 | 308 | 383 |
| 4 Mar | 114 | 236 | 383 |
| 19 Mar | 371 | 1 | 383 |
| 20 Mar | 380 | 2 | 383 |

Alliance Alliance held most of the map immediately after the split — 337 of 376 territories on 17 February against the Federation's 28{{cite:territory-exchanges|337 of 376 territories, 17 Feb 2018}}; the breakaway bloc "had the map before the night was over"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 17, composed 11 Jul 2018}}. The Federation reversed that within four days and took the map on 21 February, holding 356 of 383 territories, or 93%{{cite:territory-exchanges|356 of 383 territories, 21 Feb 2018}}.

Alliance Alliance retook most of the map for three days at the start of March. Federation holdings fell to 164 territories on 2 March and to 43, or 11%, on 3 March, with Alliance Alliance back at 308, before recovering to 114 on 4 March and to roughly 300 from 6 March{{cite:territory-exchanges|Federation 43 of 383 territories, 3 Mar 2018}}. The reversal followed a mob update that took effect on 1 March{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 17, composed 30 Aug 2018}}; it was the only interruption to the bloc's map control, "aside from ~3 days in March"{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}.

The war ended on 19–20 March 2018. Alliance Alliance fell from 72 territories to one on 19 March, and the Federation reached 380 of 383 territories, or 99%, on 20 March{{cite:territory-exchanges|Alliance Alliance from 72 territories to one, 19–20 Mar 2018}}. That was the elimination of the opposing bloc rather than the moment the Federation took the map, which had happened a month earlier{{cite:community-guild-timeline|20 Mar 2018 entry}}.

No war chart exists for this conflict: the fighting involved two multi-guild blocs rather than a single pair of guilds, and the exchange log begins only in January 2018{{cite:territory-exchanges|the exchange log begins in January 2018}}.

## Aftermath

With the war over, Alliance Alliance dissolved and several of its guilds — Fantasy, Paladins United and Emorians among them — joined the Federation{{cite:chronicle-records|Coalition, Alliance Alliance and Federation}}, which went on to hold the entire map for 8 months and 25 days{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}, until [[the-federation-dies|its death in November 2018]]. The Federation's genealogy remained disputed among veterans: Lego_DW later wrote that 'Coa and WS merged... this was a creation of fed'{{cite:thread-265297|post #16, Lego_DW, 4 Apr 2020}}, while Slayne claimed in 2018 to have created it via Alliance Alliance{{cite:thread-237070-p03|p3 #45, Slayne, 14 Nov 2018}}.

articles.title: CoCK collapses
articles.summary: The Council of Canyon Kingdoms collapsed on 23 Nov 2019 when The Ascendancy bloc departed, two days after Titans Valor and DiamondDeities left — ending the alliance formed from Terra's victorious core just ten weeks earlier.
articles.body:
The [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] — CCK, or CoCK — was formed on 15 Sep 2019 by the victorious core of [[Terra]]: [[Kingdom Foxes]], [[DiamondDeities]], [[Titans Valor]], [[The Simple Ones]], [[Fantasy]], Phantom Hearts and Empire of Sindria{{cite:community-guild-timeline|15 Sep 2019 entry}}. It outlived its parent by only three weeks.

## The collapse

The end came in stages. Kingdom Foxes left at the start of November, as [[terra-falls|Terra fell]]; Phantom Hearts had already abandoned the council in early October{{cite:community-guild-timeline|2 Nov 2019 and the undated Sep–Oct 2019 entries}}. On 21 Nov 2019 Titans Valor and DiamondDeities departed, and on 23 Nov the bloc known as The Ascendancy left, collapsing the alliance{{cite:community-guild-timeline|21 and 23 Nov 2019 entries}}.

The Ascendancy was created on 27 Apr 2019{{cite:thread-265297|post #1, the community guild-timeline image}} and departed on 23 Nov{{cite:community-guild-timeline|23 Nov 2019 entry}}; its roster was never recorded.

## Aftermath

The council's fragments regrouped within days: on 1 Dec 2019 DiamondDeities, Titans Valor and The Simple Ones formed [[Horologium]], while [[Imperial]], Paladins United and Caeruleum Order had already founded [[Artemis]] on 30 Oct{{cite:community-guild-timeline|30 Oct and 1 Dec 2019 entries}}. Horologium lasted five weeks before [[diamonddeities-disbanded|DiamondDeities' disbandment]] took it down; Artemis went on to dominate 2020.

articles.title: Concordia
articles.summary: Concordia was the Wynncraft war alliance of autumn 2015, founded by the guild Validus to break the hold of Kangronomicon and Nether's Ascent on the territory map. It peaked in October 2015, was answered by the creation of Ordo Malleus on 6 November, and was declared disbanded on a forum thread two days later.

infobox.label: Peak size
infobox.value: Not recorded; four guilds took part in the October 2015 assault

articles.body:
**Concordia** was a Wynncraft war alliance of the second half of 2015, founded by the guild [[validus|Validus]] under its leader Ezura and built out of guilds that resented the control of the territory map by [[kangronomicon|Kangronomicon]] and [[nethers-ascent|Nether's Ascent]]{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L86–87, L133–144}}. It is the alliance [[ordo-malleus|Ordo Malleus]] was created to defeat — "Ordo Malleus was created for the sole purpose of defeating Concordia"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L179}} — and the earliest war alliance whose history is known in any detail.

## The record

The narrative of Concordia comes almost entirely from one partisan account, written in February 2018 by [[drew1011|Drew1011]], who fought against the alliance. Only its end has independent documentation.

## History

### Formation and growth

Validus's chief [[tangler]] began recruiting [[holders-of-le|Holders of LE]] on 5 July 2015 with, in Drew1011's summary, "many plans to revolt against Fuq & TNA and bring them down from their role as the two guilds that controlled the map"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L82–87}}. Holders of LE joined — "After a very long and diplomatic conversation with him, we joined their alliance, Concordia", Drew1011 wrote in mid-2017{{cite:the-emperial-truth|Drew1011's Emperator application essay, mid-2017}} — then left in August 2015 for Kangronomicon, and Validus declared hostilities on 16 August{{cite:drew1011-storytime|forum post by tangler, dated 16 Aug 2015, reproduced as a screenshot at L96}}.

The alliance grew through the autumn. Drew1011 called its "growth and takedown of the remnants of Legio" "completely unprecedented and unexpected"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L143}} — Legio Praetoria being the March 2015 alliance of Kangronomicon, Nether's Ascent, [[imperial|Imperial]] and KnightOfValor, which had already collapsed in mid-2015{{cite:community-guild-timeline|2015}}. The only members known by name are Validus and Historical [UEZ], led by 3zPz{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L133, L200–201}}.

### The October 2015 assault

In October 2015 around four Concordia guilds, Validus the strongest among them, attacked Kangronomicon and Nether's Ascent simultaneously{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L119–126}}. Drew1011, then leading Holders of LE as a Kangronomicon ally, wrote that he warred alone for roughly four hours because the rest of his guild was unavailable, and that the attack was repelled{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L126–129}}. A territory map he reproduces as "the aftermath of the attack" shows Holders of LE and Kangronomicon holding most of the province with Validus reduced to two tiles{{cite:drew1011-storytime|territory map reproduced as a screenshot at L129}}.

A second map, from late September or early October 2015, shows the opposite: Validus and Travellers holding the overwhelming majority of the province, Kangronomicon absent from it entirely, and Nether's Ascent's eastern block untouched{{cite:drew1011-storytime|territory map reproduced as a screenshot at L145}}. The two images are undated in themselves; the captions are Drew1011's.

### Defeat and disbandment

Concordia was answered on 6 November 2015 by the creation of [[ordo-malleus|Ordo Malleus]], seven guilds under Paladin A'renos and Dar_Krusos{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L169–179}}{{cite:forums-wynncraft-com-forums-guilds-72-prefix-id-82-order-post-date-direction-asc|Alliance-prefix thread index}}. Drew1011 attributes its defeat to Ordo's territory-assignment system, under which each member guild was given specific territories to hold: "We attacked those territories and defended them religiously, and before long Concordia gave up on touching those territories"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L197–199}}.

Historical left Concordia for Ordo Malleus, and its leader 3zPz posted a thread titled "Concordia Disbanded" on 8 November 2015; it drew 27 replies and 4,049 views, was locked, and was last posted in by Ferne on 10 November 2015{{cite:forums-wynncraft-com-forums-guilds-72-prefix-id-82-order-post-date-direction-asc|Alliance-prefix thread index}}. Drew1011 places the thread "3 days after Ordo was created", which would be the 9th — one day later{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L203}}. The disbandment was contested: "although Ezura commented on the thread and said that it had not been disbanded, that was when most people began to consider the alliance dead"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L203–204}}.

## Membership

No roster of Concordia was ever published. Two member guilds are known by name — [[validus|Validus]], its founder, and Historical [UEZ] under 3zPz{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L133, L200–201}} — and [[holders-of-le|Holders of LE]] belonged briefly in mid-2015{{cite:the-emperial-truth|Drew1011's Emperator application essay, mid-2017}}. "Around 3-4" guilds took part in the October assault{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L125}}.

## Legacy

Concordia's direct successor was [[vesta|Vesta]], created on 10 December 2015 by 3zPz "from the remnants of Concordia" and dead within a month{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L289–311}}{{cite:forums-wynncraft-com-forums-guilds-72-prefix-id-82-order-post-date-direction-asc|Alliance-prefix thread index}}. Its larger legacy is Ordo Malleus, which outlived it by four months and set the pattern — assigned territories, a leader chat, admission by vote — that later war alliances of the [[early-guild-era|early guild era]] reused{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L197–199, L250–254}}. The community guild-timeline gives Concordia a single line: "Late 2015 — Concordia Wars began somewhere here"{{cite:community-guild-timeline|Community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ), via Wynncraft forums thread 265297}}.
articles.leadImageCaption: Wynncraft territory map reproduced in Drew1011's account as a view of the map in late September or early October 2015.

articles.title: Council of Canyon Kingdoms
articles.summary: The Council of Canyon Kingdoms (CCK or CoCK) was a Wynncraft war alliance of autumn 2019, formed on 15 Sep 2019 by seven guilds drawn from both sides of the war that had just ended. It collapsed on 23 Nov 2019 when The Ascendancy bloc departed, two days after Titans Valor and DiamondDeities left.

articles.title: Crokee
articles.summary: Founder of Profession Heaven, the profession-XP guild granted protected neutrality by both Goose and Artemis in January 2021, and the author of the rules that made that neutrality internal law.
articles.body:
Crokee founded [[profession-heaven|Profession Heaven]] [PROF], created on 20 January 2021 to hold the south-eastern Dernic profession territories and share their guild-XP boosts with any player who wanted them{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records: Profession Heaven created 20 Jan 2021}}. Five days after the guild's creation it was granted protected neutrality by both [[goose|Goose]] and [[artemis|Artemis]], then at war; no surviving public source names the brokers of that arrangement{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records: the 25 Jan 2021 Goose–Artemis protection pact (date only; brokers unrecorded)}}.

Crokee opened the guild's forum thread on 9 February 2021 and used it to write neutrality into the guild's own law. War members were required to "Keep the guild as neutral as possible towards all other guilds. No bias towards any guild", to fight only defensively — "You may NOT war to take any territory outside of SE, except for FFAs" — and to "Be able to communicate with other guilds while keeping an unbiased stance towards them"{{cite:thread-285237|post #1 (OP), thread opened 9 Feb 2021}}. Permanent members had to "agree to not have ANY affiliation with any prior major guild that held several territories over long periods of time. Meaning to resolve any potential conflicts of interest relating to other guilds", and were barred from cycling out into major guilds{{cite:thread-285237|post #1 (OP)}}.

The open-door mechanics were unusual: anyone could join as a temporary member with "no requirements... except to join the guild Discord", with no obligation to do anything guild-related, and the guild kept room for "a full server + 41 permanent members" of profession grinders{{cite:thread-285237|post #1 (OP)}}.

articles.title: Cucumber Company
articles.summary: Cucumber Company was the war alliance of the great 2022 realignment, merging the ex-Valhalla and ex-Khaos worlds into a fourteen-guild bloc formed for guild Season 5. Its roster, posted to the forum megalist on 26 June 2022, was the last public alliance roster ever; it was archived and renamed 'Smtn else' at the start of Season 8.
articles.body:
## History

### Formation
The exact formation date was never recorded. The war between [[Khaos]] and the ex-[[Valhalla]] guilds was still running in January 2022; by 8 May 2022 [[titan-times|Titan Times]] described “our first season being a part of the new Cucumber Company war alliance”{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol1|vol. 1, 8 May 2022}}, placing the founding around the start of guild Season 5 in spring 2022. The ex-Khaos and ex-Valhalla guilds stopped fighting each other and began trading territory as allies in May–June 2022.{{cite:territory-exchanges|territory_exchanges map-data analysis}}

### The last public roster
On 26 June 2022 a member (TherapueticLiz of Sins of Seedia) posted the full fourteen-guild roster to the [[the-forum-megalist|megalist]]: [[Aequitas]], [[Titans Valor]], [[Avicia]], Blacklisted, KongoBoys, Empire of Sindria, Gang of Fools, [[Kingdom Foxes]], The Clowns, Nefarious Ravens, Sins of Seedia, [[The Aquarium]], Wynn Legacy and [[Profession Heaven]].{{cite:thread-278112-p08|p8 #160, 26 Jun 2022}} Twelve days later the megalist's alliance section was deleted, and no public alliance roster was ever posted again.{{cite:thread-278112-p09|p9 #161, 7 Jul 2022}} Titans Valor's Discord bot consumed an alliance-claims feed built on Avicia's site code between April and December 2022, the two guilds sharing alliance infrastructure across this window.{{cite:github-com-titantimes-valor|repository commit history, Apr–Dec 2022}}

Membership shifted at the edges. IceBlue Team was a founding member that had left by 12 June 2022; Gang of Fools joined that same month;{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol3|vol. 3, 12 Jun 2022}} and Kingdom Foxes left around July 2022, when it entered sustained war with bloc guilds.{{cite:territory-exchanges|territory_exchanges map-data analysis}} Both Kingdom Foxes and Gang of Fools appear on the June roster yet fought bloc guilds in adjacent months.

### Rename
At the start of Season 8 (autumn 2022), “Cucumber was archived. The new alliance name is called Smtn else”, per Titan Times vol. 6 — the same issue that records Gang of Fools having “left and betrayed the alliance”.{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol6|vol. 6, 12 Oct 2022}} The bloc's history continues under [[smtn elf]].

## Membership
Joins are approximated to the Season 5 boundary; the roster is as of 26 June 2022.

{{alliance:Cucumber Company}}

## Legacy
Cucumber Company ended the two-bloc war era of 2021 by absorbing both sides, and its June 2022 roster post became a historical landmark by accident: the deletion of the megalist's alliance section twelve days later marks the start of the [[private-diplomacy-era|private-diplomacy era]]{{cite:thread-278112-p09|p9 #161, 7 Jul 2022}}, in which alliances ceased to be publicly recorded.

articles.title: Cucumber Company becomes Smtn else
articles.summary: At the start of Season 8 (autumn 2022) Cucumber Company was archived and renamed 'Smtn else' — as Gang of Fools left and Paladins United, The Simple Ones and TerraLune joined — then renamed 'smtn elf' for Christmas 2022 and never changed back.
articles.body:
At the start of guild Season 8, in the autumn of 2022, [[Cucumber Company]] — the fourteen-guild super-alliance of the 2022 realignment — changed its name. "Cucumber was archived. The new alliance name is called Smtn else," recorded Titans Valor's newsletter, the Titan Times, which also reported that Gang of Fools had "left and betrayed the alliance" and welcomed three new members: [[Paladins United]], [[The Simple Ones]] and TerraLune{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol6|vol. 6, 12 Oct 2022}}.

The transition came at the season boundary, around 25 September 2022{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}. The membership otherwise carried over: the change was a rename, not a reformation{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol6|vol. 6, 12 Oct 2022}}.

## The second rename

For Christmas 2022 "Smtn else" became "smtn elf" — and was never renamed back{{cite:cameron-oral-history|Cameron (TAq veteran) oral testimony, fact-checked against map data}}. By 17 February 2023 a forum post was calling [[smtn-elf|smtn elf]] "unquestionably the greatest super-alliance of 2023."{{cite:thread-306790|Wynncraft forums thread 306790, 17 Feb 2023}}

Under that accidental permanent name the alliance dominated the map into 2023, until [[The Avocado split]] and [[smtn-elf-fades-away|its quiet dissolution]] that summer.

articles.title: DiamondDeities
articles.summary: Federation-era guild formed in April 2018 as the renamed LE Flowers; Aesir Pact member, SOL and Terra belligerent, Council of Canyon Kingdoms member, and co-founder of Horologium. Disbanded by its leader Nitrogen2Oxygen on 8 Jan 2020, with most members regrouping as Lux Nova.
articles.body:
DiamondDeities [DDT] existed for under two years but touched six chronicled alliances.

## History

### Federation and Aesir (2018)

DiamondDeities emerged on 8 Apr 2018 when the [[the-federation|Federation]] guild LE Flowers was renamed.{{cite:territory-exchanges|territory_exchanges map-data analysis}} It served the Federation until the end,{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}} having been accepted into the [[Aesir Pact]] on 18 Jul 2018;{{cite:thread-227373-p02|p2 #24, 18 Jul 2018}} the Aesir guilds were the Federation's last defenders on 10-11 Nov 2018, quitting after 14 hours of constant warring.{{cite:thread-236962|post #17, 11 Nov 2018}}

### SOL and the wars of 2019

After the collapse, DiamondDeities appears to have joined [[SOL]], the war alliance born from the Federation's ashes; no roster of SOL was ever published.{{cite:territory-exchanges|territory_exchanges map-data analysis}} Its peace with [[Kingdom Foxes]] — the Treaty of Rodoroc — took effect on 2 Mar 2019,{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}} and in late 2018 it had made a deal to share Molten Heights with Fox.{{cite:thread-265297|post #1, the community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ)}} In March 2019 it held 15 territories.{{cite:pre2018-territory-snapshots|Wayback leaderboard capture, 3 Mar 2019}} That autumn it fought with [[Terra]] against [[Luna]] and joined the [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]], leaving on 21 Nov 2019, two days before the alliance collapsed.{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}

### Horologium and the end (1 Dec 2019 - 8 Jan 2020)

On 1 Dec 2019 DiamondDeities co-founded [[Horologium]] with [[Titans Valor]] and [[The Simple Ones]]. On 8 Jan 2020 [[nitrogen2oxygen|Nitrogen2Oxygen]] disbanded the guild, taking Horologium down with it; most remaining members regrouped as Lux Nova the next day.{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}} A single-member guild under the name, with a creation date of 8 Apr 2018, still existed in September 2026;{{cite:wynncraft-api|Wynncraft API v3/guild, retrieved 2 Sep 2026}} how it relates to the 2020 disbandment is not known.

## Alliances

- [[the-federation|Federation]] — Apr 2018 – 10-11 Nov 2018 (as DiamondDeities; LE Flowers before the rename)
- [[Aesir Pact]] — 18 Jul 2018 – 10-11 Nov 2018{{cite:thread-227373-p02|p2 #24, 18 Jul 2018}}
- [[SOL]] — late 2018 – about Jun 2019{{cite:territory-exchanges|territory_exchanges map-data analysis}}
- [[Terra]] — 30 Aug 2019 – 15 Sep 2019
- [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] — 15 Sep 2019 – 21 Nov 2019 (co-founder)
- [[Horologium]] — 1 Dec 2019 – 8 Jan 2020 (co-founder)

articles.title: DiamondDeities disbanded
articles.summary: Nitrogen2Oxygen dissolved DiamondDeities on 8 Jan 2020, taking the Horologium alliance down with it; most remaining members regrouped as Lux Nova the next day.
articles.body:
On 8 Jan 2020 [[nitrogen2oxygen|Nitrogen2Oxygen]] dissolved [[DiamondDeities]], one of the central guilds of the post-Federation era — and took [[Horologium]] down with it, the three-guild alliance de-facto dissolving the same day. Most remaining members regrouped as Lux Nova the next day{{cite:community-guild-timeline|8–9 Jan 2020 entries}}.

## The guild's arc

DiamondDeities packed its history into under two years. It began as LE Flowers, a founding-era member of [[The Federation]]{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}, and took the DiamondDeities name in the spring of 2018 — a rename confirmed by its abutting activity windows{{cite:territory-exchanges|the LE Flowers → DiamondDeities rename chain}}. On 18 Jul 2018 it was accepted into the [[Aesir Pact]]{{cite:thread-227373-p02|p2 #24, 18 Jul 2018}}, and its guilds were among the Federation's last defenders when [[the-federation-dies|the alliance fell]] that November{{cite:thread-236962|post #17, Ascended Kitten, 11 Nov 2018}}.

After the collapse it fought with [[sol|SOL]], signed the [[Treaty of Rodoroc]] with [[Kingdom Foxes]] (effective 2 Mar 2019), joined [[Terra]] for the [[Luna-Terra war]], and passed through the [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] into Horologium — five blocs in fourteen months{{cite:community-guild-timeline|Treaty of Rodoroc, Terra, CoCK and Horologium entries, 2019}}.

## Aftermath

Horologium's other members, [[Titans Valor]] and [[The Simple Ones]], were left allianceless as the map consolidated under [[Artemis]]. Lux Nova carried DiamondDeities' lineage onward, appearing later in [[Hestia]]{{cite:thread-278112|post #10, Pally, 2 Dec 2020}}, [[Valhalla]] and [[Vanir]]{{cite:community-guild-timeline|11 May and 28 Nov 2021 rosters}}.

It's not representative of them by any means", and "There's a lot more and I only did the ones that I was more familiar with so I'm sorry if your guild is not on here."{{cite:thread-289196|post #1, 30 Mar 2021}} They also carry incidental political detail — TheNoLifes described as "the ones that know more about guild politics"{{cite:thread-289196|post #1, 30 Mar 2021}}, Eden as "the big bois who own a whole lotta territory", and [[avicia|Avicia]]'s claims as "currently located in the Sky Islands"{{cite:thread-289556|post #1, 6 Apr 2021}}.

articles.title: Drew1011
articles.summary: Founder and unofficial leader of the Federation, owner of Holders of LE, leader of the Valkyrie alliance (2016-2018), Shadow Advisor of the Emperium of Wynn, King and then Viceroy of Kingdom Foxes, and the guild community's principal historian.

infobox.label: Guild(s)

infobox.value: [[ordo-malleus|Ordo Malleus]] founding member guild leader (2015-2016); Leader of [[Valkyrie]], 15 Oct 2016 - 10 Mar 2018; Shadow Advisor of the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]], from Sep 2017

articles.body:
Drew1011 founded and unofficially led the [[the-federation|Federation]]{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}, the dominant alliance of the [[federation-era|Federation era]], which held the entire territory map for 8 months and 25 days in 2018{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records: total Federation map control, 8 months 25 days}}.

## Guild and alliance career

He joined the guild Pirates of Wynn — otherwise unrecorded — in early January 2015, and returned from a hiatus in late May 2015 to join Holders of LE{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L13–16, composed 22 Feb 2018}}. He rose to co-leader and took ownership of the guild on 16 December 2015{{cite:forums-wynncraft-com-members-drew1011-2157|Drew1011's Wynncraft forum profile (member 2157): title chain with dates}}{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L312, composed 26 Feb 2018}}, and held it until 31 January 2018, when he passed it to Thundderr with the post "Make me proud."{{cite:thread-217600|post #2, Drew1011, 31 Jan 2018}}

From 6 November 2015 he sat in the leader chat of [[ordo-malleus|Ordo Malleus]] as one of its seven founding guild leaders, and in the senior chat its members called the "Shadow Government"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L169–178, L248–257, composed 22 Feb 2018}}. He withdrew Holders of LE from the alliance on 9 March 2016, the departure that ended it{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L454, composed 26 Feb 2018}}{{cite:community-guild-timeline|Mar 2016 entry}}, and later wrote: "many people began naming me as its destroyer. Did I truly deserve that title? To this day I'm still not sure."{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L457, composed 26 Feb 2018}}

Holders of LE joined [[Valkyrie]] on 18 March 2016{{cite:community-guild-timeline|Mar 2016 entry}}, left on 5 June 2016 to co-found the [[halcyon|Halcyon]] Alliance with Yamipanda's ToastedPandas{{cite:thread-130444|post #1, 8 Jun 2016}}, and rejoined on 3 September 2016{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L554, composed 26 Feb 2018}}. His leadership of Valkyrie was taken rather than inherited: by his own account he drafted the messages by which the other guild leaders asked Yuno F Gasai to stand down in the autumn of 2016, Yuno withdrew [[Imperial]] and deleted the alliance thread, and Drew1011 reposted it with permission on 15 October 2016{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L562–580, composed 26 Feb 2018}}{{cite:thread-159734|post #1 (OP); thread opened 15 Oct 2016}}. He held "Leader of the Valkyrie Alliance" from that day until 10 March 2018{{cite:forums-wynncraft-com-members-drew1011-2157|Drew1011's Wynncraft forum profile (member 2157): title chain with dates}}. In [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]] he was "King of the Foxes" from the guild's revival as Foxton Legacy [Eon] on 24 November 2016{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L602–604, composed 26 Feb 2018}}, then stepped down on 7 February 2017 when [[lovelusting|LoveLusting]] resumed the throne, becoming "Viceroy of the Foxes"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L652, composed 26 Feb 2018}}{{cite:forums-wynncraft-com-members-drew1011-2157|Drew1011's Wynncraft forum profile (member 2157): title chain with dates}}.

## The Emperium and the one-day title

Drew1011 was the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]]'s **Shadow Advisor**, the post the alliance's thread defines as "the co-leader of the alliance"{{cite:thread-202724|post #7, Aya, 5 Sep 2017, quoting the opening post}}. He won it in a poll run by Emperator [[nitrogen2oxygen|Nitrogen2Oxygen]] on 31 August 2017, taking 19 votes to 5, 4 and 4 for Angry_will, Shy_Phoenix and Whimsicality, after Paladin A'renos left the post{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L797–798 and the accompanying screenshot, composed 26 Feb 2018}}, and the thread's opening post names him as Shadow Advisor from 5 September 2017 onward{{cite:thread-202724|post #7, Aya, 5 Sep 2017, quoting the opening post}}{{cite:thread-202724|post #1, as last edited 17 Oct 2017}}.

![The Emperium of Wynn's Shadow Advisor poll of 31 August 2017, run by Nitrogen2Oxygen: Drew1011 19 votes, Angry_will 5, Shy_Phoenix 4, Whimsicality 4. Screenshot from Drew1011's own account.](/images/chronicles/storytime/38-image.webp)

His profile also records "Emperator of the Emperium of Wynn (15 October 2017 — 16 October 2017)", and the one-day reign is unexplained{{cite:forums-wynncraft-com-members-drew1011-2157|Drew1011's Wynncraft forum profile (member 2157): title chain with dates}}. Three sources bear on it and no two agree. The profile claims the title; Drew1011's own narrative says he **ran for Emperator and lost**, 30 votes to 31, to Nitrogen2Oxygen, and never claims to have held the office{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L788–794, composed 26 Feb 2018}}; and the alliance's thread names Nitrogen2Oxygen as Emperator on 5 September 2017 and Angry_will as Emperator in the opening post as it was last edited on 17 October 2017, with Drew1011 as Shadow Advisor in both{{cite:thread-202724|post #7, Aya, 5 Sep 2017}}{{cite:thread-202724|post #1, as last edited 17 Oct 2017}}. No Emperator election was ever recorded on the forums. A succession between one Emperator's exit and another's installation, falling to the co-leader, would fit every date, but whether it happened is not known.

## The Coalition and the Federation

Drew1011 co-founded the [[Coalition]] with [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]] and KingdomPhoenixes in October 2017{{cite:community-guild-timeline|2017 entries}}{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L865–870, composed 4 Mar 2018}}. When the Federation formed in February 2018 from the Coalition's fracture and merger with the [[war-syndicate|War Syndicate]] remnant, he founded and led it (his profile: "Founder of the Federation", 16 Feb - 10 Nov 2018){{cite:forums-wynncraft-com-members-drew1011-2157|Drew1011's Wynncraft forum profile (member 2157): title chain with dates}} — though not without a rival claim: [[slayne|Slayne]] asserted a causal founder's role via [[alliance-alliance|Alliance Alliance]]'s creation{{cite:thread-237070-p03|p3 #45, 14 Nov 2018}}. Asked publicly in November 2018 how he had made three alliances in a year, he corrected the count to two{{cite:thread-236914|post #19, Drew1011, 10 Nov 2018}}.

Three days after [[the-federation-dies|the Federation's collapse]] on 10 November 2018, he posted the "Federation Tribute" - a full roster of its member guilds and the alliance's epitaph: "What killed Federation was... internal affairs."{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}

He also maintained on Discord "a massive ongoing written history of the guild community from May 2015 onwards"{{cite:thread-251543|post #6, 27 Jun 2019}}. That history, or a large part of it, survives as a serialised account posted between 22 February 2018 and 1 February 2021, covering January 2015 to June 2018 and beginning in May 2015 exactly as described{{cite:drew1011-storytime|composed 22 Feb 2018 – 1 Feb 2021}}. He worked from a written timeline of his own and, for the 2015-2016 chapters, from the [[ordo-malleus|Ordo Malleus]] forum thread, which he had asked Paladin A'renos to have restored: "many of the dates and minor events during the Ordo parts of this story would have been educated guesses without it."{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L695, composed 26 Feb 2018}} He is a participant in nearly everything the document narrates and set out his own standard for it — "I strive to tell a factually accurate story… If you ask others who were here, they might give a completely different perspective."{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L393–397, composed 26 Feb 2018}} It is the single largest source for the [[early-guild-era|early guild era]].

![The portrait Drew1011 used as his own chapter header in the account, matching the Discord avatar visible in its other screenshots.](/images/chronicles/storytime/60-image0.webp)

articles.title: Emorians and Avicia revolt
articles.summary: On 29 Aug 2019, after a leadership dispute, Emorians and Avicia left Luna and declared war on Imperial, spiralling into a large war over Gavel. Terra formed in the chaos, and within three weeks Luna had lost the map and collapsed.
articles.body:
## Background

[[Luna]] had [[luna-gains-full-map-control|held the entire map]] since 17 Jul 2019, when [[Avicia]] joined as the last guild standing outside it{{cite:community-guild-timeline|17 Jul 2019 entry}}. The alliance's unity did not survive the calm that followed.

## The revolt

On 29 Aug 2019, after a leadership dispute, [[Emorians]] and Avicia left Luna and declared war on [[Imperial]], Luna's core guild. The fighting spiralled into a large war over Gavel{{cite:community-guild-timeline|29 Aug 2019 entry}}{{cite:territory-exchanges|Emorians and Avicia exchanges against Imperial, Aug–Sep 2019}}. ThisIsMurica was kicked from Luna the next day for sending fighters to the rebels' side, and on 30 Aug [[Terra]] formed in the chaos, gathering Luna's enemies into a bloc{{cite:community-guild-timeline|30 Aug 2019 entries}}.

{{war-chart:Emorians|Imperial|2019-08-14|2019-10-03}}

{{map:2019-08-29|The map when the revolt began}}

## Aftermath

The revolt did not stay a revolt. Within a week it had merged into the decisive [[Luna-Terra war]]: The Simple Ones defected on 8 Sep and Terra took the map the same day; Kingdom Foxes left on the 18th and Luna collapsed{{cite:community-guild-timeline|8 and 18 Sep 2019 entries}}. Emorians' and Avicia's walkout thus began the three-week sequence that ended Luna's rule entirely.

articles.title: Empire of Sindria
articles.summary: Wynncraft guild founded in March 2019, a founding member of the Council of Canyon Kingdoms and of the community alliances Hestia and Adonis. It fought in Valhalla, Vanir, Cucumber Company and smtn elf, and is one of the few guilds of its generation still holding territory in 2026.
articles.body:
Empire of Sindria [ESI] was created on 18 March 2019{{cite:api-wynncraft-com-v3-guild-empire-20of-20sindria|v3/guild response, retrieved 3 Sep 2026}}. It has belonged to more community alliances than war alliances, and is among the longest-surviving map powers.

## History

### Council of Canyon Kingdoms (2019)

Within six months of its founding, ESI was one of the seven guilds that formed the [[council-of-canyon-kingdoms|Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] on 15 September 2019 out of the victorious [[Terra]] bloc, alongside [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]], [[DiamondDeities]], [[titans-valor|Titans Valor]], [[the-simple-ones|The Simple Ones]], [[Fantasy]] and Phantom Hearts. It stayed until the Council collapsed on 23 November{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}.

### Hestia (2020-2022)

ESI was a founding member of the community alliance [[Hestia]], described by [[paladinsorcerer|PaladinSorcerer]] in December 2020 as 'a community alliance between ANO, ESI, LXA, and PUN'{{cite:thread-278112|post #10, 2 Dec 2020}}. By 6 June 2021 the roster had grown to six guilds with [[Emorians]] and [[HackForums]], in an alliance that had 'been together for about a year now'{{cite:thread-278112-p07|p7 #140, 6 Jun 2021}}.

The guild was off the map during the [[goose-artemis-war|Goose-Artemis war]]: arguing about the [[gavel-reborn|1.20 rework]] in February 2021, ESI's _Eragon_ wrote that 'ESI currently doesn't hold territories'{{cite:thread-286375|post #3, 20 Feb 2021}}.

### Valhalla, Vanir and the 2022 realignment

After [[the-great-collapse|the Great Collapse]] of 11 May 2021 ESI joined [[Valhalla]] as a founding member, followed it into [[Vanir]] on 28 November, and remained until Vanir collapsed on 18 December{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}. In the spring 2022 realignment it joined [[cucumber-company|Cucumber Company]] — appearing as '[ESI] - Empire of Sindria' on the last public alliance roster{{cite:thread-278112-p08|p8 #160, 26 Jun 2022}} — and carried through the rename into [[smtn-elf|smtn elf]] until that alliance's end in June 2023{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}.

### Adonis and after

As Hestia declined, ESI and [[titans-valor|Titans Valor]] founded the community alliance [[Adonis]] around May 2022; [[Avicia]] joined within weeks{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol1|vol. 1, 8 May 2022}}{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol3|vol. 3, 12 Jun 2022}}. Titans Valor's newsletter describes the arrangement in 2023 as 'a community alliance with [AVO] and [ESI] called Adonis', with ESI running item-design competitions and profession-themed games for the whole bloc{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol9|vol. 9, 25 Mar 2023}}. The relationship outlasted the war alliances entirely: ANO's newsletter records a joint ESI anniversary celebration in early 2025, 'a celebration of how long ESI has endured'{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol18|vol. 18, 13 Apr 2025}}, and another cross-guild anniversary collaboration with ESI in 2026{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol21|vol. 21, 18 May 2026}}.

As of September 2026 Empire of Sindria is at level 112 with 122 members, 69,059 recorded wars and 25 territories, under an owner who took the guild in February 2022{{cite:api-wynncraft-com-v3-guild-empire-20of-20sindria|v3/guild response, retrieved 3 Sep 2026}}.

## Alliances

- [[council-of-canyon-kingdoms|Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] — 15 Sep – 23 Nov 2019 (founding member)
- [[Hestia]] — c. mid-2020 – Sep 2022 (community alliance){{cite:thread-278112|post #10, 2 Dec 2020}}
- [[Valhalla]] — 11 May – 28 Nov 2021
- [[Vanir]] — 28 Nov – 18 Dec 2021
- [[cucumber-company|Cucumber Company]] — 1 Apr – 25 Sep 2022{{cite:thread-278112-p08|p8 #160, 26 Jun 2022}}
- [[smtn-elf|smtn elf]] — 25 Sep 2022 – 30 Jun 2023
- [[Adonis]] — May 2022 onward (community alliance; co-founder){{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol1|vol. 1, 8 May 2022}}

articles.title: Ezura
articles.summary: Leader of the guild Validus and founder of Concordia, the first bloc assembled against the Kangronomicon–Nether's Ascent duopoly of 2015. He contested the alliance's disbandment on the forum thread that announced it.

articles.title: Fall of Profession Heaven's neutrality
articles.summary: On 25 May 2026 KongoBoys began a sustained campaign against Profession Heaven — up to 1,700 territory exchanges a week — ending the neutral profession-XP guild's five years of protected status. Ongoing as of September 2026.
articles.body:
## Background

[[Profession Heaven]] had been a protected neutral guild since 25 Jan 2021, when [[Goose]] and [[Artemis]] jointly guaranteed its status and granted it Silent Expanse territory as a public profession-XP guild ([[Profession Heaven neutrality]]){{cite:community-guild-timeline|25 Jan 2021 entry}}. The protection carried through both alliances' successors, and Profession Heaven itself was a member of [[Cucumber Company]] and [[smtn-elf|smtn elf]] — as was KongoBoys, its future attacker{{cite:thread-278112-p08|post #160, TherapueticLiz, 26 Jun 2022}}.

## Course of the war

On 25 May 2026 KongoBoys began a sustained campaign against Profession Heaven, running as high as 1,700 territory exchanges a week — ending more than five years of neutrality{{cite:territory-exchanges|weekly capture volumes, from 25 May 2026}}. Like every conflict of the [[private-diplomacy-era|private-diplomacy era]], the war carried no declaration, no stated cause and no named coalition. The campaign is ongoing as of September 2026{{cite:territory-exchanges|KongoBoys-Profession Heaven exchanges continuing to September 2026}}.

{{war-chart:KongoBoys|Profession Heaven|2026-05-10|2026-09-02}}

{{map:2026-05-25|The map when the campaign began}}

## Aftermath

The attack closed the era's longest-standing diplomatic arrangement — the only guild ever protected by both sides of a map-wide war. Whatever caused the break between the two former smtn elf allies is unrecorded.

articles.title: Fantasy
articles.summary: Wynncraft guild of the Federation era: co-founder of Alliance Alliance and of the Aesir Pact, and the guild that turned on the dominant Federation in mid-2018, exchanging over 220 territories with the bloc before rejoining it weeks before the collapse. Last chronicled in the Council of Canyon Kingdoms in late 2019.
articles.body:
Fantasy [Fux], created on 19 Jul 2017,{{cite:wynncraft-api|Wynncraft API v3/guild, retrieved 2 Sep 2026}} is chiefly remembered for one of the boldest acts of [[federation-era|the Federation era]]: going to war, alone, against the alliance that held the entire map.

## History

### Alliance Alliance and Aesir (early 2018)

Fantasy co-founded [[Alliance Alliance]] on 17 Feb 2018 alongside the five guilds leaving the [[Coalition]], fighting the [[coalition-civil-war|Coalition Civil War]] until [[the-federation|the Federation]] took the map on 20 Mar 2018 and absorbed the AA guilds.{{cite:thread-265297|post #1, the community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ)}} Five days later Fantasy co-created the [[Aesir Pact]] with [[Sins of Seedia]] and IceBlue Team — a pact of sister guilds 'especially dedicated to Gavel', led by Viaire among others.{{cite:thread-227373|post #1, opened 5 Jun 2018}}

### The lone war (mid-2018)

Map analysis places Fantasy's departure from the Federation in the week of 28 May 2018, when off-FFA fighting jumps to sustained war levels. It fought the dominant bloc across the map all summer — over 220 territories were exchanged — before rejoining on 29 Oct 2018.{{cite:territory-exchanges|territory_exchanges map-data analysis}} Oddly, the Aesir Pact evidently survived Fantasy's rebellion against the alliance that contained it;{{cite:thread-227373|post #1, opened 5 Jun 2018}} no source resolves the contradiction. Twelve days after the rejoin the Federation [[the-federation-dies|cascaded apart]],{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}} and the Aesir guilds, its last defenders, quit after 14 hours of constant warring — Aesir died with it.{{cite:thread-236962|post #17, 11 Nov 2018}} The April 2018 leaderboard capture shows Fantasy at 27 territories.{{cite:pre2018-territory-snapshots|Wayback leaderboard capture, 16 Apr 2018}}

### 2019 and after

In 2019 Fantasy fought with [[Terra]] against [[Luna]] (roster approximate){{cite:territory-exchanges|territory_exchanges map-data analysis}} and co-founded the [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] on 15 Sep 2019, staying to its collapse on 23 Nov 2019.{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}} After that the guild disappears from the alliance record entirely.

## Alliances

- [[Alliance Alliance]] — 17 Feb 2018 – 20 Mar 2018 (co-founder)
- [[the-federation|Federation]] — 20 Mar – ~28 May 2018 (exit approximate); 29 Oct – 10 Nov 2018{{cite:territory-exchanges|territory_exchanges map-data analysis}}
- [[Aesir Pact]] — 25 Mar 2018 – 10-11 Nov 2018 (co-founder){{cite:thread-227373|post #1, opened 5 Jun 2018}}
- [[Terra]] — 30 Aug 2019 – 15 Sep 2019 (roster approximate)
- [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] — 15 Sep 2019 – 23 Nov 2019 (co-founder)

articles.title: Fantasy turns on The Federation
articles.summary: Fantasy left the dominant Federation in late May 2018 and fought the map-holding bloc alone all summer, exchanging over 220 territories before rejoining on 29 October 2018 — twelve days before the Federation's death.
articles.body:
## Background

By the spring of 2018 [[The Federation]] held the entire map, having taken it at the end of the [[Coalition Civil War]] on 20 March 2018{{cite:community-guild-timeline|20 Mar 2018 entry}}. [[Fantasy]] entered the bloc that day with the other [[alliance-alliance|Alliance Alliance]] guilds, and five days later co-founded the [[Aesir Pact]]{{cite:community-guild-timeline|25 Mar 2018 entry}}, the Federation's sister-guild pact "especially dedicated to Gavel."{{cite:thread-227373|post #1, 5 Jun 2018}}

## Course of the war

Fantasy's departure was never announced in writing; it appears to have come in the week of 28 May 2018, when Fantasy's fighting against Federation guilds rose from 44 territory exchanges in total through April to sustained war levels of 20–90 exchanges per week{{cite:territory-exchanges|off-FFA fighting at war level from the week of 28 May 2018}}. The lone guild then fought the map-holding bloc across the whole summer — over 220 territories were exchanged with the Federation before the war ended{{cite:territory-exchanges|220+ territories exchanged with Federation guilds, summer 2018}}.

Fantasy was an Aesir Pact founder{{cite:thread-227373|post #1, 5 Jun 2018}}, yet no expulsion from the pact was ever recorded; the sister-guild pact evidently survived Fantasy's war on the very alliance that contained it.

## Aftermath

Fantasy rejoined the Federation on 29 October 2018{{cite:community-guild-timeline|29 Oct 2018 entry}}, twelve days before the alliance [[the-federation-dies|died by internal collapse]] on 10 November 2018{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}.

{{map:2018-05-28|The map when Fantasy left the Federation}}

articles.title: The Federation era
articles.summary: The year 2018 in Wynncraft guild warfare: the Coalition Civil War, the rise of the Federation under Drew1011, its 8-month-and-25-day hold on the entire territory map, and its one-day collapse on 10 November 2018.

infobox.label: Key events
infobox.value: [[coalition-civil-war|Coalition Civil War]], [[the-wipe-of-hackforums|The wipe of HackForums]], [[the-federation-dies|The Federation dies]]

articles.body:
{{map:2018-06-01|The Federation's map at midsummer 2018}}

The Federation era is the first fully recorded period of Wynncraft guild warfare — the continuous territory-exchange log begins on 3 January 2018, weeks before the era's opening crisis{{cite:territory-exchanges|continuous exchange log from 3 Jan 2018}} — and it was dominated end to end by a single alliance.

## The Coalition fractures

On 16–17 February 2018, five guilds — [[HackForums]], [[Paladins United]], House of Sentinels, [[Emorians]] and Kangronomicon — left the map-holding [[Coalition]] over map disputes and formed [[Alliance Alliance]] together with [[Fantasy]] and Necronomicon, declaring war on their former allies{{cite:thread-265297|post #1, community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ), 28 Jul 2020}}. The trigger came on 16 February, when the Coalition published a guild-by-guild division of the province of Wynn; [[Drew1011]] wrote that "within an hour of announcing the map... five guilds left Coalition", which then "attacked the rest of the Coalition, and had the map before the night was over"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 17, composed 11 Jul 2018}}. In response the Coalition remnant merged with the remains of War Syndicate into a new alliance: the [[the-federation|Federation]], founded and led by Drew1011{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}. (The founding credit is not undisputed: Slayne wrote on 14 November 2018, "In a way, you could say that I created Fed because I (along with some others) created Double AA" — a claim to have caused the Federation by co-creating Alliance Alliance{{cite:thread-237070-p03|p3 #45, Slayne, 14 Nov 2018}}. Every other account names Drew1011 the founder.) The [[coalition-civil-war|Coalition Civil War]] ran until 19–20 March 2018, when Alliance Alliance was reduced to a single territory; the Federation had taken the map a month earlier, on 21 February{{cite:territory-exchanges|daily ownership reconstruction, 5 Feb – 10 Apr 2018}}.

## Total war, total control

Three days after forming, the Federation attacked HackForums' 111 territories and [[the-wipe-of-hackforums|wiped them to zero in under 12 hours]] on 19 February 2018 — the end of Hax as a territorial power, a year after its ~350-territory peak{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}. The Federation took Llevigar on 17–18 February, bankrupting Emorians after an attack opened by Snowythewolf of Hall of Fame; then the swamp, the Dark Forest and the Light Forest; then Aldorei overnight, taken by [[iceblue-team|IceBlue Team]]'s night shift. Drew1011 wrote that "at the very latest hours of the 19th, Snowy announced it was time to attack Hax. At the time they held 111 territoires. Less than 10 hours later, they had none."{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 17, composed 30 Aug 2018}} His under-ten-hours figure is shorter than the under-twelve hours of other participant accounts. On 22 February 2018 the leaderboard's largest holders showed only 43 territories{{cite:thread-219744|post #1, 22 Feb 2018}} — guilds neither bloc was fighting, such as Blacklisted, drifted to the top of the table for about a day.

From 21 February the Federation held the entire map for 8 months and 25 days, with a single ~3-day interruption in early March{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}{{cite:territory-exchanges|daily ownership reconstruction, 5 Feb – 10 Apr 2018}}. On 16 April 2018 all 15 territory holders were Federation guilds, 384 territories in total, led by [[Kingdom Foxes]] with 82{{cite:pre2018-territory-snapshots|16 Apr 2018}}. The alliance grew to 37–40 member guilds{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}. Within it formed the [[Aesir Pact]] (25 March 2018) — sister guilds Fantasy, Sins of Seedia and IceBlue Team, joined by [[DiamondDeities]] in July, 'especially dedicated to Gavel'{{cite:thread-227373|post #1, OP as edited 21 Jul 2018}} — while [[Valkyrie]] persisted alongside as a community layer.

### When the map was won

The Federation's takeover came on 21 February 2018, when it held 356 of 383 territories (93%) against Alliance Alliance's 24{{cite:territory-exchanges|356 of 383 territories, 21 Feb 2018}}. That is four days after the 17 February split, close to Drew1011's "Three days after the Civil War had begun, Federation had won the map"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 17, composed 30 Aug 2018}}, and it fits the "8 months and 25 days" of his tribute, a span that counts back from 10 November 2018 to mid-February{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}. During the 1–5 March relapse the Federation fell to 43 territories (11%) on 3 March, with Alliance Alliance back at 308{{cite:territory-exchanges|Federation 43 of 383 territories, 3 Mar 2018}}.

The community timeline dates map control to 20 March{{cite:community-guild-timeline}}, but that date belongs to a different event: on 19–20 March Alliance Alliance fell from 72 territories to one and the Federation reached 99% of the map{{cite:territory-exchanges|Alliance Alliance from 72 territories to one, 19–20 Mar 2018}} — the elimination of the opposing bloc and the end of the war, not the day the map changed hands.

The March interruption followed a mob update that took effect on 1 March 2018, after which Alliance Alliance attacked Gavel "using broken defenses that the vast majority of players were unable to overcome". Tntdestroyd coordinated the first days of the response — Drew1011 wrote that coordination passed to himself on 3 March — and the map was retaken in full "by the 5th". Paladins United was admitted to the Federation on 7 March at Slayne's request, and House of Sentinels left Alliance Alliance on 12 March{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 17, composed 30 Aug 2018}}. Drew1011's November tribute thanks Tntdestroyd "for fighting hard to reclaim the map back in March"{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}.

## How the bloc was run

How the bloc was governed was barely recorded. The alliance was run through a Discord-hosted council of guild leaders deciding by two-thirds majority; Drew1011's tribute thanks AurumKitsune of KingdomPhoenixes "for setting up the discord and coming up with things such as the 2/3 majority voting rule that contributed greatly to its success"{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}. The structure was not designed but inherited — the alliance "copied the exact same structure that Coalition had", Drew1011 wrote — and its name began as a joke about the Coalition's own naming{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 17, composed 30 Aug 2018}}. Drew1011 said he had "tried to not thank co-leaders and only mention the leaders"{{cite:thread-237070-p02|p2 #35, Drew1011, 13 Nov 2018}}; the tribute's roll of credited names thus approximates who sat in that council.

Warfighting was concentrated in a smaller group still. Answering the tribute on 13 November 2018, the member Lego_DW named "the absolute gods of war this alliance created" — himself, 21(n), Goden, _Antho74_, InnerJoker, 0x7cf and snowy — as the people who "really held the alliance together in terms of war power"{{cite:thread-237070|post #18, Lego_DW, 13 Nov 2018}}. Goden, a Kingdom Foxes officer who rose from recruit to guild leader inside the era, is the only one of them recorded elsewhere.

## Fantasy's war

The era's one sustained challenge came from within. Fantasy left the Federation in late May 2018 and fought it across the map all summer — over 220 territories were exchanged with the bloc{{cite:territory-exchanges|Fantasy-Federation exchanges, summer 2018}} — before rejoining on 29 October 2018{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}. The departure appears to date to the week of 28 May, when fighting with the bloc jumped to sustained war levels{{cite:chronicle-map-methodology|Fantasy's departure map-inferred to 28 May 2018}}. Fantasy's earlier movement between the blocs is contested: its Alliance Alliance membership is recorded as ending on 19–20 March 2018, while Drew1011 wrote that its leader defected to the Federation mid-battle on 18 February in a deal he negotiated himself{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 17, composed 30 Aug 2018}} — a stint boundary and a decision, measured differently.

## The collapse

At around 3 AM EST on 10 November 2018, one guild left the Federation — and the alliance [[the-federation-dies|cascaded apart within a day]]{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}. The Hive had left a month earlier, then Odysseia; [[Imperial]]'s exit 'snowballed into a major attack on Fed together with the enemy alliance [Ent]'; Arisen followed; and after 14 hours of constant warring the Aesir guilds quit, ending both the Federation and the Aesir Pact{{cite:thread-236962|post #17, Ascended Kitten, 11 Nov 2018}}. The opposing bloc was named only as [Ent], a tag corresponding to no alliance otherwise recorded. 'What killed Federation was... internal affairs', wrote Drew1011 in his tribute three days later{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}.

## Aftermath

The winter of 2018–19 was an interregnum: per the community timeline, 'all guilds keep to themselves with valk owning most of Gavel'{{cite:thread-265297|post #1, community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ), 28 Jul 2020}}, and Kingdom Foxes and Imperial were the top territory gainers{{cite:territory-exchanges|net territory gains, winter 2018-19}}. In the post-collapse chaos [[SOL]] was created — the alliance against which [[Luna]] would form in February 2019, opening [[the-alliance-wars-of-2019|the alliance wars of 2019]].

articles.title: In-game guild alliances
articles.summary: Wynncraft guilds can register each other as allies inside the game. It is a game-mechanical status — it sets a tax rate between their territories and lets them run guild raids together — and it does not indicate a political alliance.

infobox.label: Effect
infobox.value: Ally tax rate; joint guild raids from 2026

articles.body:
Guilds have been able to set each other as allies in game since version 1.20 of 20 January 2021 (see [[the-diplomacy-update|The Diplomacy update]]){{cite:thread-281822|post #1, 20 Jan 2021}}. The status applies the ally tax rate to the other guild's territories{{cite:wynncraft-wiki-gg-wiki-guild-war|attack-cost formula: allied guilds are charged the ally tax}}, and from 2026 lets allied guilds run guild raids together{{cite:wynncraft-wiki-gg-wiki-version-2-2-1|Official Wynncraft Wiki, 'Version 2.2.1' (12 Jun 2026)}} — which is what it is mainly used for.

Registering an ally requires no political alignment and is neither announced nor explained anywhere outside the game. Guilds registered as in-game allies may be rivals, and may have recently fought each other, so these records cannot be read as blocs, pacts or reconciliations, and none of the wars of [[private-diplomacy-era|the private-diplomacy era]] can be reconstructed from them.

From June 2026 the ally system produced the first records of guild relationships made by software rather than written down by a person: [[Sequoia]]'s open-source client mod began capturing the game's alliance-formed and alliance-revoked chat lines, and from 30 July 2026 snapshotting a guild's ally list to a private backend{{cite:github-com-sequoiawynncraft-sequoia-mod|commit 69fb472, 12 Jun 2026}}. The individual registrations it captured are routine and are not recorded here.

articles.title: Foxton Legacy
articles.summary: Foxton Legacy [Eon] was the guild created on 24 November 2016 to revive the Kingdom of Foxes, which had been disbanded that July. A new name and tag were needed because the Fox name and tag had already been re-registered by outsiders.

infobox.label: Queen
infobox.value: Misty, also styled Pyrias and Teumessi

articles.body:
**Foxton Legacy** [Eon] was the guild through which the [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom of Foxes]] was revived in November 2016, five months after [[lovelusting|LoveLusting]] disbanded it{{cite:community-guild-timeline|2 Jul 2016 entry}}.

## The record

The name Foxton Legacy is known only from [[drew1011|Drew1011]]'s retrospective account, written in February 2018; no forum thread or roster uses either the name or the tag.

## Revival

The decision came on 21 November 2016, when LoveLusting suggested reviving the guild "in a half joking manner"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L590–591, composed 26 Feb 2018}}. Drew1011 brought in Misty (Pyrias), the founder of [[house-of-sentinels|House of Sentinels]], and then [[killerfish|Killerfish]], who agreed to serve as Viceroy{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L593–598}}.

The obstacle was the guild's own name. "After Ari disbanded Fox, a few rogue Hax members recreated it with the same name and tag. Unfortunately this meant we had to create a new name and tag for the guild."{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L599–601}} The re-registration took place on 3 July 2016, the day after the disbandment{{cite:community-guild-timeline|3 Jul 2016 entry}}, and the guild registered that day is the Kingdom Foxes still listed in the Wynncraft API{{cite:api-wynncraft-com-v3-guild-kingdom-20foxes|created field}}.

"So, on November 24th, we created Foxton Legacy [Eon]. Foxton Legacy because Ari's name in the guild lore was Arianna Foxton, and Eon to represent that her legacy would last an Eon."{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L602–603}} The Kingdom of Foxes' handbook separates the two acts: the guild was created on 24 November 2016 and declared as [Eon] on the 25th.{{cite:gdoc-1b8e1nh_ate9h69n|Section X: Historical Timeline, Nov 2016}} Its Guild History dates the establishment to 25 November.{{cite:gdoc-1kajulcrdc0cpf1j|Nov 2016}} The dynastic name outlasted the guild name: the Kingdom of Foxes' recruitment thread still heads its leadership block "The Royal Family | House Foxton"{{cite:thread-89227|post #1}}. Misty took the title Queen of the Foxes, Drew1011 that of King — "a title that no other has obtained" — and Killerfish that of Viceroy{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L604}}.

## Mottoes

The guild banner of the revival period carried the motto "Glory to the Rightful" beneath a quartered fox-and-wing crest.

On 7 February 2017 Drew1011 stepped down as King and LoveLusting was restored{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L652}}. "We chose a new motto, one fitting of the Queen's return, and of Fox's unwillingness to die 'Forever or Nothing.'"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L663–664}}

![Guild banner on a dark navy field: a crowned, laurel-ringed shield bearing a white howling fox on an orange ground, captioned "Kingdom of Foxes" with the motto "Forever or Nothing".](/images/chronicles/storytime/29-proxy.webp)

## The end of the name

Teumessi posted the Foxton Legacy thread on 1 December 2016, and on 3 December a negotiated deal returned the original Kingdom Foxes name and tag from the [[hackforums|HackForums]] members holding them; the guild's first State Council was formed the same day.{{cite:gdoc-1b8e1nh_ate9h69n|Section X: Historical Timeline, Dec 2016}}{{cite:gdoc-1kajulcrdc0cpf1j|Dec 2016}} LoveLusting left the guild on 10 December 2016, giving up the office of Council Designer.{{cite:gdoc-1b8e1nh_ate9h69n|Section X: Historical Timeline, Dec 2016}} Writing in mid-2017, Drew1011 described his own tenure without using the name at all — "From December 2016 to February 2017, I was King of the Foxes"{{cite:the-emperial-truth|Drew1011's Emperator application essay}} — which also gives December rather than November as the start of the revival period, a month later than his 2018 narrative. Both dates are his.
