articles.title: Libertas
articles.summary: A major territorial power of 2016 and HackForums' senior partner in the bloc that held the map: 60 territories on 23 Sep 2016, second only to Hax. Not one of its wars was ever written down.

infobox.label: Leaderboard rank
infobox.value: 2nd, in every dated reading from Aug 2016 to May 2017

articles.body:
Libertas [Lir] was one of the largest guilds on the Wynncraft map in 2016, holding 60 territories on 23 September 2016, second only to [[HackForums]]{{cite:pre2018-territory-snapshots|pre2018-territory-snapshots.json — Wayback Machine capture of the Wynncraft v1 API guild leaderboard, 23 Sep 2016}}.

## History

### Origins

Libertas' founding date was never recorded, and its own thread was not opened until 30 March 2016. [[drew1011|Drew1011]] placed its creation in the autumn of 2015 and traced it to a change of ownership at Holders of LE. When that guild was sold on 22 September 2015 and its acting leader [[yosteric5|yosteric5]] was demoted, a group of members left with him: "Quite a few other members left too. The 'yosteric loyalists' as I like to call them. Most of them retreated to Validus, and then later to Libertas when Yos created it."{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L73–76, composed 22 Feb 2018}} Drew1011 further asserts that Ezura, the leader of Validus, "had given Yosteric the funds to create the guild and considered Libertas one of his best allies"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L247, composed 22 Feb 2018}}. Drew1011 was on the other side of the 2015 dispute, and the funding claim is his alone. Nothing was written about the guild before 2016.

### At its height (2016)

On 23 September 2016 Libertas held 60 territories — nearly a fifth of the ~332-territory map, second only to [[HackForums]]' 146 and ahead of UltimateXeons' 53 — at guild level 59 with 57 members{{cite:pre2018-territory-snapshots|pre2018-territory-snapshots.json — Wayback Machine capture of the Wynncraft v1 API guild leaderboard, 23 Sep 2016}}. That number marked a first-rank power.

On 30 Mar 2016 the opening post of its thread gave "Rank: 17 / Level: 41" and a leadership of three — owner yosteric5, co-owner Amplitude, head chief Master_NinjasHD — with every rank below them empty{{cite:thread-119596|post #3, 30 Mar 2016}}. On 10 Apr 2016 yosteric5 posted "Libertas is now Ranked #15! we hit level 43 today! I would like to think my active war members for all there hard work."{{cite:thread-119596|post #8, 10 Apr 2016}} By the thread's last revision on 6 Nov 2016 the header read "Guild Rank: 2 / Guild Level: 62", and the guild was recruiting "active players that are level 89+ who are willing to war and attack often"{{cite:thread-119596|post #1, as revised 6 Nov 2016}}. Roughly fifty members are named in that revision, among them Beastovrlrd, who would go on to lead the guild Beasts inside the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]]{{cite:thread-119596|post #1, as revised 6 Nov 2016}}.

Applicants who quoted that header preserved it at nine dates between August 2016 and May 2017, and those quotations track the guild where no leaderboard capture survives. It read rank 2 at guild level 51 on 2 August 2016{{cite:thread-119596-p05|post #96, quoting the opening post, 2 Aug 2016}}, level 53 five days later{{cite:thread-119596-p08|post #144, quoting the opening post, 7 Aug 2016}}, level 56 on 14 September{{cite:thread-119596-p13|post #250, quoting the opening post, 14 Sep 2016}}, and level 62 by 6 November{{cite:thread-119596-p20|post #390, quoting the opening post, 6 Nov 2016}}. All nine gave rank 2. The recruitment bar rose with the guild, from "level 75+" on 14 September to "level 89+" by 6 November{{cite:thread-119596-p13|post #250, quoting the opening post, 14 Sep 2016}}{{cite:thread-119596-p20|post #390, quoting the opening post, 6 Nov 2016}}. A quotation taken on 9 May 2017 still reads level 62, but the opening post had not been edited since November, so it dates the header rather than the guild{{cite:thread-119596-p25|post #482, quoting the opening post, 9 May 2017}}.

### Inside the guild

Rank was earned by warring. The published ladder gave Recruiter to a member after "a recruit's first war", Captain "to members who attack often, and contribute", and Chief for "being very active, contributing a lot, and participating in many wars"; the only alternative route ran through "contributing 30k Emeralds", and Co-Owner was hand-picked by the owner{{cite:thread-119596|post #1, as revised 6 Nov 2016}}.

It was enforced. Accepting two applicants in August 2016, the chief etclement told them to "make sure to war a lot, or else you can be kicked for inactivity"{{cite:thread-119596-p10|post #188, etclement, 15 Aug 2016}}; yosteric5 announced a kick the same evening{{cite:thread-119596-p10|post #190, yosteric5, 15 Aug 2016}}. He barred a former member who reapplied — "your were demoted in the guild for a reason not warring, i gave you multiple chances but they were never taken, you will barred entry imto Libertas until i see fit"{{cite:thread-119596-p08|post #158, yosteric5, 9 Aug 2016}} — and turned down another with "We need people who can war."{{cite:thread-119596-p09|post #169, yosteric5, 11 Aug 2016}}

Recruiting was run by the chiefs, not the owner alone. Through August 2016 yosteric5 sent accepted applicants to "a Chief Like @LeoDiesAlot or @Kiieran"{{cite:thread-119596-p09|post #171, yosteric5, 11 Aug 2016}}, and both, with etclement, posted acceptances themselves{{cite:thread-119596-p10|post #187, LeoDiesAlot, 14 Aug 2016}}{{cite:thread-119596-p10|post #188, etclement, 15 Aug 2016}}.

### Alliances and the Hax bloc

Libertas belonged to more alliances than any other guild of its size in the period. Its first was [[ordo-malleus|Ordo Malleus]], which it joined on 1 December 2015 after Drew1011 and yosteric5 "made our amends" and Drew1011 sponsored the application{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L245–247, composed 22 Feb 2018}}. Libertas appears in the twelve-guild Ordo Malleus roster of February 2016{{cite:thread-109350|post #11, 20 Feb 2016}}. It belonged afterwards to the [[seraphim|Seraphim]] community alliance of August 2016{{cite:thread-143392|post #1}}, and to the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]] from May 2017{{cite:thread-188024|post #4, 7 May 2017}}, which had moved it to its "Honored Retired Guilds" list by that August — the guild's last dated appearance{{cite:thread-188024|post #1, as revised Aug 2017}}.

It was also part of the bloc that held the map during [[HackForums]]' dominance, and the earliest account of that bloc makes Libertas its senior partner rather than an independent second power. The June 2016 opening post of The Separatists describes a "rule of two": "This enemy, known only has 'Hack Forums' quickly established their rule through military might... Soon after, another guild, Libertas, joined the surge. The two guilds crushed all opposition and still rule with an iron fist."{{cite:thread-133666|post #1, 26 Jun 2016}} A member of UltimateXeons described his own guild as a third party to the same pact — "our alliance with Hax and Lir (we are UXs)"{{cite:thread-133666|post #13, 27 Jun 2016}} — which another poster called "a mutual land agreement" rather than an alliance{{cite:thread-133666|post #16, 28 Jun 2016}}. "You do realize Hax has not been a one many army in ages?" asked LeoDiesAlot, a Libertas chief, in August 2016. "They work with Lir and Bla in order to hold territories"{{cite:thread-143392|post #12, LeoDiesAlot, 9 Aug 2016}}{{cite:thread-119596-p09|post #171, yosteric5 naming LeoDiesAlot a chief, 11 Aug 2016}} — Bla being Blacklisted, whose own thread listed "We are allied with Libertas (Lir) and Hackforums (Hax)"{{cite:thread-131893|post #1, as revised 15 Sep 2017}}. In March 2017, defending Hax against calls for a territory cap, another asked "are Lir, BLA, UXs somehow exempt?"{{cite:thread-179383|post #7, 1 Mar 2017}}. On 23 September 2016 Hax, Libertas and Blacklisted held 228 territories between them{{cite:pre2018-territory-snapshots|pre2018-territory-snapshots.json — Wayback Machine capture of the Wynncraft v1 API guild leaderboard, 23 Sep 2016}}. The grouping had no name at the time; a Libertas member who asked yosteric5 for "the name of our alliance" in August 2016 was never answered{{cite:thread-119596-p08|post #152, 9 Aug 2016}}, and the label "Hax & Co" arose only later, in 2018 and 2019{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L1086, L1097, composed 30 Aug 2018}}{{cite:thread-252647|post #5, 21 Jul 2019}}.

Drew1011's account of that partnership, written in 2018, frames Libertas as the intended senior partner and dates the pairing to the period after the Astrafteri Affinity decayed: HackForums "stayed in an alliance with Libertas, and divided all of Wynn amongst themselves and a few others such as Blacklisted", and, he adds, "they intended to share the glory with a few allies such as Libertas" before those allies went inactive.{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L512, L520, composed 26 Feb 2018}} That is his reading of the bloc's intentions.

In August 2016 a small guild opened a thread recruiting for a war against Libertas over the territory Nessak{{cite:thread-147267|post #1, 28 Aug 2016}}; the replies were discouraging. A bystander warned that "Libertas is extremely powerful, i wouldnt try them to start off"{{cite:thread-147267|post #2, Zelefant, 28 Aug 2016}}; the other reply came from inside the guild, the Libertas chief Kiieran telling the recruiter to "See if you can somehow do better than the other 50 guilds exactly the same as yours that tried" and that the attempt "gives us something to do"{{cite:thread-147267|post #5, Kiieran, 28 Aug 2016}}{{cite:thread-119596-p09|post #171, yosteric5 naming Kiieran a chief, 11 Aug 2016}}. No other attack on Libertas was ever written down.

### What cannot be known

Not one Libertas war was ever described. Its own thread runs to 517 posts over twenty-six pages, and every one is an application, an acceptance or banter{{cite:thread-119596-p26|post #517 closes the thread; no post in it describes a war}}; the guild is named in other people's threads only as a member of a list or a party to an alliance, never as a belligerent in a recorded action. War data from before January 2018 was never made public{{cite:territory-exchanges|territory_exchanges map-data analysis}}; the campaigns that produced its 60 territories were never recorded.

Its end is equally unrecorded, and it outlasted its own retirement notice. The [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]] had moved Libertas to its "Honored Retired Guilds" list by August 2017{{cite:thread-188024|post #1, as revised Aug 2017}}, but yosteric5 was still inviting applicants on 21 September — "If you are both still interested you guys are invited!"{{cite:thread-119596-p26|post #516, yosteric5, 21 Sep 2017}}. The thread's last post, the following day, reads in full: "RHEEVIVED :D"{{cite:thread-119596-p26|post #517, orange0404, 22 Sep 2017}}. There is no disband notice and nothing after it. By 16 April 2018 it was gone from the map entirely — all fifteen territory holders that day were [[the-federation|Federation]] guilds{{cite:pre2018-territory-snapshots|pre2018-territory-snapshots.json — Wayback Machine capture of the Wynncraft v1 API guild leaderboard, 16 Apr 2018}}. Whether it dissolved on its own, fell with the Hax bloc, or was absorbed elsewhere is unknown. A guild named Libertas with the same tag exists today, created on 23 Jul 2018 with nine members; whether it has any connection to the 2016 power is not known{{cite:wynncraft-api|Wynncraft API v3/guild, retrieved 2 Sep 2026}}.

## Alliances

- [[ordo-malleus|Ordo Malleus]] — joined 1 Dec 2015{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L245–247, composed 22 Feb 2018}}{{cite:thread-109350|post #11, 20 Feb 2016}}
- Unnamed bloc with [[HackForums]] and Blacklisted, with UltimateXeons in the pact in mid-2016 — Jun 2016 – Mar 2017{{cite:thread-133666|post #13, 27 Jun 2016}}{{cite:thread-143392|post #12, 9 Aug 2016}}{{cite:thread-131893|post #1, as revised 15 Sep 2017}}
- [[seraphim|Seraphim]] — Aug 2016 (community alliance){{cite:thread-143392|post #1}}
- [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]] — May 2017{{cite:thread-188024|post #4, 7 May 2017}}; honored retired guild by Aug 2017{{cite:thread-188024|post #1, as revised Aug 2017}}

articles.title: LoveLusting
articles.summary: Queen of the Foxes, founder-figure of Kingdom Foxes and author of the Valkyrie alliance's founding thread in September 2015. She disbanded the guild on 2 July 2016 and returned to its throne on 7 February 2017 after a revival she had proposed.

infobox.label: Guild(s)
infobox.value: [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]] ("Queen of the Foxes", 2015–16 and from Feb 2017)

infobox.label: Dates
infobox.value: Disbanded Kingdom Foxes 2 Jul 2016; restored as Queen 7 Feb 2017

articles.body:
LoveLusting led [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]] (then "Kingdom of Foxes") in the guild's early years, posting on the forums as Queen of the Foxes{{cite:thread-89227|post #1 (OP), which styles her "Her Majesty, Queen @LoveLusting of the Foxes [ Owner // Artist ]"}}. She created the guild on 2 June 2014, six months before guilds existed as a game mechanic, and registered it in game on 22 December 2014{{cite:community-guild-timeline|Jun 2014 and Dec 2014 entries}}. [[drew1011|Drew1011]] calls her "Ari", and her name inside the guild's lore was Arianna Foxton; her Discord display name was "Miss Arianna"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L603 for the guild-lore name; the display name is legible in the accompanying screenshots, composed 26 Feb 2018}}.

## Valkyrie

On 10 September 2015 she authored the founding thread of the [[Valkyrie]] alliance, announcing an alliance formed on 2 June 2015 between Kingdom of Foxes and [[Imperial]]{{cite:thread-89529|post #1 (OP); thread opened 10 Sep 2015}}. The thread stated the alliance was "not established for the purpose of war" but created "with the aim of solidifying and maintaining the already very good social relations between the two guilds", and described its governing body, the "Valkyrie Electorate": the member guilds' leaders deciding foreign affairs and policy by "unanimous agreement in their decision-making process"{{cite:thread-89529|post #1 (OP)}}. Yuno F Gasai of Imperial was the other figure named in the thread{{cite:thread-89529|posts #6 and #10, Sep 2015}}. The thread itself names no individual founder. Drew1011, who joined the alliance in March 2016, described it as having "no true leader" with LoveLusting as its "unofficial leader"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L448, composed 26 Feb 2018}}, and says it was she who proposed that the other guild leaders ask Yuno F Gasai to stand down in the autumn of 2016 — a claim by the person who took the alliance as a result{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L556–557, composed 26 Feb 2018}}.

## The disbandment and revival of Kingdom Foxes

LoveLusting disbanded Kingdom Foxes on 2 July 2016{{cite:community-guild-timeline|Jul 2016 entry}}{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L545, composed 26 Feb 2018}}. The cause was never recorded: Drew1011 declined to relay it — "I was not part of it and have not heard the story from anyone without massive bias… I do not want to give you guys a story based entirely on biased hearsay, so I won't."{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L541–544, composed 26 Feb 2018}} The following day the guild's name and tag were re-registered by other players{{cite:community-guild-timeline|Jul 2016: "3rd Jul, A few [Hax] members recreates Kingdom Foxes [Fox] with the same name and tag"}}, which is why the revival had to take a new name.

She proposed that revival herself on 21 November 2016, in four Discord messages: "drew / marry pyrias / take my crown / reestablish the kingdom" — meant, Drew1011 records, half in jest{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L590–592 and the accompanying screenshot, composed 26 Feb 2018}}.

![LoveLusting's four messages of 21 November 2016 proposing the revival of Kingdom Foxes, from Drew1011's account.](/images/chronicles/storytime/24-image.webp)

The guild was recreated on 24 November 2016 as Foxton Legacy [Eon], named for her lore name, with Misty (Pyrias) as Queen and Drew1011 as King{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L602–604, composed 26 Feb 2018}}. LoveLusting took the role of designer and handled the guild's art, then quit the revival council early over a decision she disagreed with, having supplied the artwork before leaving{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L612–615, composed 26 Feb 2018}}. She drew guild art for others in the alliance too: Drew1011's June 2016 Valkyrie leaving message undertakes to remove "the HoL art that Ari so graciously created for us"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L499 and the accompanying screenshot, composed 26 Feb 2018}}.

After Misty stepped down as Queen on 28 January 2017 and most of the council left with her, Drew1011 asked LoveLusting to return; the exchange in which she agreed is dated 2 February 2017 and ends with her "Transfer of power 8)"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L644–651 and the accompanying screenshots, composed 26 Feb 2018}}.

![The exchange of 2 February 2017 in which LoveLusting agreed to retake the throne of Kingdom Foxes; screenshot from Drew1011's account.](/images/chronicles/storytime/28-image.webp)

She was restored as Queen on 7 February 2017{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L652, composed 26 Feb 2018}}{{cite:forums-wynncraft-com-members-drew1011-2157|Drew1011's Wynncraft forum profile (member 2157): title chain with dates}}. On her return the guild abolished the State Council of the revival period and reinstated its Parliament, numbering it as the seventeenth in continuation of the pre-disbandment sequence, adopted the motto "Forever or Nothing", and rebuilt the guild Discord from scratch{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L663–683, composed 26 Feb 2018}}.

She was a co-owner of Kingdom Foxes, with Drew1011, by 17 October 2017 — "Kingdom Foxes [ Fox ] - Owner LoveLusting/Drew1011" in the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]]'s roster{{cite:thread-202724|post #1, as last edited 17 Oct 2017}} — and in March 2018 she treated an allied guild's attack on Kingdom Foxes' Molten Heights territories as a declaration of war{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L1129–1132, composed 20 Jun 2019}}. Her name recurs at the end of the period: Drew1011's "Federation Tribute" of November 2018 closes with a personal acknowledgment of her{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}.

articles.title: Luna
articles.summary: Luna was a Wynncraft war alliance of 2019, formed on 14 Feb 2019 to counter SOL. It fought Kingdom Foxes across 300+ territories, gained full map control on 17 Jul 2019 after wiping every guild but Avicia, and collapsed in September 2019 after a leadership revolt and the loss of the map to Terra.

articles.title: Luna gains full map control
articles.summary: After fending off an attack on Kingdom Foxes, Luna wiped every guild but Avicia; Avicia joined on 17 Jul 2019 and Luna held the entire map — a control that lasted until Terra took it on 8 Sep 2019.
articles.body:
{{map:2019-07-17|The map under Luna's control}}

In July 2019 [[Luna]] reached its peak. [[Kingdom Foxes]] had joined on 8 Jul, ending [[luna-s-war-on-kingdom-foxes|five months of war]]{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}; Luna then fended off an attack on its newest member and wiped every remaining guild from the map except [[Avicia]]. On 17 Jul 2019 Avicia joined the alliance, and Luna held the entire map{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}{{cite:territory-exchanges|July 2019 wipe of all non-Luna holders}}.

It was the third full-map hold in the recorded era, after the [[coalition|Coalition]]'s dominance from Christmas 2017 and [[the-federation|The Federation]]'s eight months and twenty-five days across 2018{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}. Luna's proved the briefest: [[emorians-and-avicia-revolt|Emorians and Avicia revolted]] on 29 Aug after a leadership dispute, [[Terra]] formed in the chaos on 30 Aug, and on 8 Sep 2019 — after The Simple Ones defected — Terra took the map ([[Luna-Terra war]]){{cite:territory-exchanges|loss of full map control, 8 Sep 2019}}. Luna had held it for 53 days.

At its height the alliance counted roughly ten guilds, including [[Imperial]], [[Emorians]], Blacklisted, BuildCraftia, [[The Simple Ones]], Kingdom Foxes, Caeruleum Order and Avicia{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}.

articles.title: Luna's war on Kingdom Foxes
articles.summary: Luna fought Kingdom Foxes across more than 300 territories from 15 Feb 2019 — its second day of existence — until Fox joined the alliance on 8 Jul 2019, directly after the Treaty of Ternaves. No contemporary document names the war.
articles.body:
## Background

[[Luna]] was formed on 14 Feb 2019 to counter [[sol|SOL]], the war alliance born from the Federation's ashes. Some retellings list [[Kingdom Foxes]] among Luna's founders{{cite:community-guild-timeline|14 Feb 2019 entry}}; in fact Luna was at war with Fox from its second day of existence{{cite:territory-exchanges|Luna-Kingdom Foxes exchanges from 15 Feb 2019}}.

## Course of the war

From 15 Feb 2019 Luna fought Kingdom Foxes across more than 300 territories. [[Imperial]] alone attacked Fox 660 times between 16 Feb and 8 Jul{{cite:territory-exchanges|300+ territories contested; Imperial's 660 attacks on Kingdom Foxes, 16 Feb – 8 Jul 2019}}. No contemporary document so much as names this war. It ran continuously for nearly five months while Fox stood outside every bloc.

{{map:2019-02-15|The map when the war began}}

## Aftermath

The war ended at the negotiating table rather than on the map. On 6 Jul 2019 Fox signed the [[Treaty of Ternaves]] with the Luna members [[The Simple Ones]] and ThisIsMurica, and directly afterwards, on 8 Jul 2019, Kingdom Foxes joined Luna itself{{cite:community-guild-timeline|6 and 8 Jul 2019 entries}}. Within ten days the enlarged alliance had wiped every remaining guild but [[Avicia]] and [[luna-gains-full-map-control|gained full control of the map]]{{cite:community-guild-timeline|9 and 17 Jul 2019 entries}}.

Fox's membership proved short and consequential: it left on 18 Sep 2019 during the [[Luna-Terra war]]{{cite:community-guild-timeline|18 Sep 2019 entry}}, the departure that finished Luna's collapse.

articles.title: Luna-Terra war
articles.summary: The war for the map, 7–19 Sep 2019: over 2,000 exchanges across 322 territories in ten days. The Simple Ones defected from Luna on 8 Sep and Terra took map control the same day; Kingdom Foxes left on the 18th and Luna collapsed.

infobox.label: Outcome
infobox.value: Terra took the map; Luna collapsed

articles.body:
## Background

[[Luna]] had [[luna-gains-full-map-control|held the entire map]] since 17 Jul 2019, but the [[emorians-and-avicia-revolt|revolt of Emorians and Avicia]] on 29 Aug cracked it open, and on 30 Aug [[Terra]] formed in opposition{{cite:community-guild-timeline|17 Jul, 29 and 30 Aug 2019 entries}} — a bloc of roughly a dozen guilds including TheNoLifes, [[Titans Valor]], [[DiamondDeities]], [[Fantasy]] and Paladins United. Terra's roster was never published{{cite:territory-exchanges|Terra's roster reconstructed from guild activity windows}}.

## Course of the war

The decisive fighting ran 7–19 Sep 2019{{cite:community-guild-timeline|7 Sep 2019 entry}}: over 2,000 exchanges across 322 territories in ten days, only about a third of it on the usual free-for-all hotspots — a map-wide war, not churn{{cite:territory-exchanges|2,174 attacks across 322 territories, 37% on FFA hotspots}}. The turning point came within a day: on 8 Sep [[The Simple Ones]] defected from Luna to Terra, and Terra took control of the map that same day{{cite:community-guild-timeline|8 Sep 2019 entry}}.

{{map:2019-09-08|The map as Terra took control}}

Luna fought on for another ten days until [[Kingdom Foxes]] left on 18 Sep, and the alliance collapsed{{cite:community-guild-timeline|18 Sep 2019 entry}}.

## Aftermath

Victory dissolved the victor almost as fast as the vanquished. On 15 Sep, mid-war, Terra's core founded the [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]]{{cite:community-guild-timeline|15 Sep 2019 entry}}; Terra itself [[terra-falls|fell]] on 2 Nov 2019{{cite:thread-265297|post #1, the community guild-timeline image}}, seven weeks after taking the map.

articles.title: Lux Nova
articles.summary: Wynncraft guild created on 9 January 2020, the day after Nitrogen2Oxygen dissolved DiamondDeities; most of DiamondDeities' remaining members regrouped under the new name. It was a founding member of the community alliance Hestia and fought in Valhalla and Vanir.
articles.body:
Lux Nova [LXA] was created on 9 January 2020{{cite:api-wynncraft-com-v3-guild-lux-20nova|v3/guild response, retrieved 3 Sep 2026}}. It succeeded [[DiamondDeities]]: [[nitrogen2oxygen|Nitrogen2Oxygen]] dissolved that guild on 8 January 2020, taking the alliance [[Horologium]] down with it, and most remaining members regrouped as Lux Nova the next day{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}; the connection was never publicly announced.

## History

### Hestia (2020-2022)

Lux Nova was one of the four founding guilds of the community alliance [[Hestia]] — 'Hestia (a community alliance between ANO, ESI, LXA, and PUN)', [[paladinsorcerer|PaladinSorcerer]] wrote on 2 December 2020{{cite:thread-278112|post #10, 2 Dec 2020}} — and still in the six-guild roster of 6 June 2021{{cite:thread-278112-p07|p7 #140, 6 Jun 2021}}. It remained in Hestia into September 2022, outlasting every war alliance it belonged to{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}.

The guild grew steadily through this period, its [[the-forum-megalist|megalist]] entry kept current by a member: level 74 to 75 in February 2021, 77 in March, and 79 by June{{cite:thread-278112-p04|p4 #77, 2 Feb 2021}}{{cite:thread-278112-p06|p6 #117, 9 Mar 2021}}{{cite:thread-278112-p08|p8 #144, 24 Jun 2021}}.

### Valhalla and Vanir (2021)

After [[the-great-collapse|the Great Collapse]] of 11 May 2021, Lux Nova was among the thirteen founding guilds of [[Valhalla]], the bloc that took the map from [[Goose]]'s remnants. It followed Valhalla's members into [[Vanir]] on 28 November and remained until the alliance collapsed on 18 December ([[vanir-collapses|Vanir collapses]]){{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}. No later war-alliance membership is recorded.

As of September 2026 the guild remains at level 91 with 76 members and 12,399 recorded wars, holding no territories; its owner joined four days after the guild was created{{cite:api-wynncraft-com-v3-guild-lux-20nova|v3/guild response, retrieved 3 Sep 2026}}.

## Alliances

- [[Hestia]] — c. mid-2020 – Sep 2022 (community alliance; founding member){{cite:thread-278112|post #10, 2 Dec 2020}}
- [[Valhalla]] — 11 May – 28 Nov 2021
- [[Vanir]] — 28 Nov – 18 Dec 2021

articles.title: motoki317
articles.summary: Author of moto-bot, a long-running Wynncraft utility Discord bot; often confused with the separate Titans Valor guild bot, which he did not write.

infobox.label: Known for
infobox.value: moto-bot, a Wynncraft utility Discord bot (archived Jan 2024)

articles.body:
motoki317 wrote moto-bot, described in its repository as "A discord bot for Wynncraft utility commands, written in Java using JDA"{{cite:github-com-motoki317-moto-bot|repository README}}. It was a community tool rather than a guild one, offering Wynncraft lookups and player tracking, including a daily player-count log to a configured channel{{cite:github-com-motoki317-moto-bot|repository README, feature list}}. The repository carries 576 commits and was archived read-only by its owner on 27 January 2024{{cite:github-com-motoki317-moto-bot|commit count and archive notice of 27 Jan 2024}}; its first version had its own Wynncraft forums thread, 223425{{cite:github-com-motoki317-moto-bot|repository README link to the version-1 forum thread}}.

moto-bot is distinct from titantimes/valor, the Discord bot of [[titans-valor|Titans Valor]] that consumed an alliance-claims feed between April and December 2022 — a separate Python project published under the "titantimes" account, not motoki317's work{{cite:github-com-titantimes-valor|repository description and commit range, Apr–Dec 2022}}. motoki317 is also distinct from motoki1, owner of the guild UltimateXeons in the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]] of 2017{{cite:thread-188024|post #1, member-guild roster, 7 May 2017}}. No guild affiliation is recorded for motoki317.

articles.title: Necronomicon
articles.summary: Necronomicon [Feq] was a Wynncraft guild active from at least 2015 to 2018. It rose from a Kangronomicon subguild to full membership of Ordo Malleus, joined the Coalition, left it during the December 2017 territory division, and was one of the seven guilds of Alliance Alliance in February 2018.
articles.body:
## Ordo Malleus

Necronomicon was one of the twelve guilds of [[ordo-malleus|Ordo Malleus]] by 20 February 2016, listed as "Feq, Necronomicon"{{cite:thread-109350|post #11, Drew1011, 20 Feb 2016}}. [[drew1011|Drew1011]] wrote that it had been a subguild of Kangronomicon "that was later allowed to join Ordo as a full fledged ally", that its leaders Roi and Dan complained "often and loudly" that no territories had been designated to them, and that the problem was settled by donation: ToastedPandas gave its three Ternaves territories and [[drew1011|Drew1011]]'s Holders of LE its three Mining Base territories{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L261–266, composed 22 Feb 2018}}.

## The Coalition

Necronomicon was a member of the [[coalition|Coalition]] by autumn 2017. It held mainland territory when the alliance took the whole Wynn province on 23 November 2017, and it was on the alliance's roster at the declaration of war on 21 December 2017{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L927–941}}. It was also one of five guilds in an abandoned plan, considered for a single night that November, to expel the alliance's smaller guilds and divide Wynn between the larger ones{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L896–902}}.

Drew1011 wrote that Necronomicon left the alliance during the division of the map after the Gavel Invasion "because they felt that they were getting the short end up the stick", and disputed the guild's reasoning: it had taken a single territory in the whole invasion and had nonetheless been allotted the whole of Llevigar, more than twenty territories{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L1009–1011}}. Necronomicon's own account of the dispute was never recorded.

## Alliance Alliance

On 16–17 February 2018 Necronomicon joined [[hackforums|HackForums]], [[paladins-united|Paladins United]], [[house-of-sentinels|House of Sentinels]], [[emorians|Emorians]], Kangronomicon and [[fantasy|Fantasy]] in forming [[alliance-alliance|Alliance Alliance]], opening the [[coalition-civil-war|Coalition Civil War]]{{cite:community-guild-timeline|17 Feb 2018 entry}}{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L1057–1059}}. (The guild's name was also spelled "Necromonicon".) Drew1011 wrote that during the treaty-breaking attacks on [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]] of about February 2018, Necronomicon was the strongest of the guilds assaulting it{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L1032}}.

The guild was not listed among the [[the-federation|Federation]]'s members in November 2018{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}, and what became of it was never recorded.
articles.leadImageCaption: Territory map of 23 November 2017, the day the Coalition first held the whole Wynn mainland.

articles.title: Nefarious Ravens
articles.summary: Wynncraft guild created in March 2020 that declared independence by treaty in 2021, was invited into Vanir and helped collapse it three weeks later, won guild Season 4, and disbanded in March 2023 while a member of smtn elf.

infobox.label: Status
infobox.value: Disbanded, March 2023 (a dormant guild record remains)

articles.body:
Nefarious Ravens' political career began only in 2021 and ran less than two years.

## History

### Independence and Vanir (2021)

Ten days after [[the-great-collapse|the Great Collapse]] of 11 May 2021, Nefarious Ravens signed the [[treaty-of-damask|Treaty of Damask]] with [[the-simple-ones|The Simple Ones]] on 21 May, declaring its independence from the new blocs; the treaty's terms beyond that declaration were never recorded{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}.

That independence lasted about six months. On 1 December 2021 the guild was invited into [[Vanir]], the successor to [[Valhalla]] formed three days earlier — and on 18 December it was one of four guilds whose simultaneous departure collapsed the alliance twenty days after its founding ([[vanir-collapses|Vanir collapses]]). The cause of the departures was never recorded{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}.

### Season 4

Nine days after leaving Vanir, Nefarious Ravens won [[guild-seasons|guild Season 4]], which ran from 27 December 2021 to 28 February 2022, with a season rating of 10,085,533{{cite:wynncraft-wiki-gg-wiki-guild-seasons|season table, Season 4}}. It was the guild's only crown.

### Cucumber Company, smtn elf and disbanding

In the spring 2022 realignment it joined [[cucumber-company|Cucumber Company]], appearing as '[NFR] - Nefarious Ravens' on the fourteen-guild roster posted to [[the-forum-megalist|the megalist]] on 26 June 2022 — the last public alliance roster ever published{{cite:thread-278112-p08|p8 #160, 26 Jun 2022}}. It carried through the alliance's rename into [[smtn-elf|smtn elf]] that autumn{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}.

The guild disbanded in March 2023: '[fuy] joined the map-holding alliance mid-season, while [NFR] has left on account of the guild disbanding.' Its claim was redistributed — most to fuy, with Canyon Waterfall North, Bandit Cave Upper, Burning Airship and three Cinfras territories released to the Light Forest free-for-all, Path to Ozoth's Spire Mid to UTL and Bandit Camp Exit to [[idiot-co|Idiot Co]]{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol9|vol. 9, 25 Mar 2023}}.

A guild record under the same name and tag still exists — level 92, 47,870 recorded wars, seventeen members, no territories, its listed owner last online in July 2023 — apparently a dormant remnant rather than a continuing guild{{cite:api-wynncraft-com-v3-guild-nefarious-20ravens|v3/guild response, retrieved 3 Sep 2026}}.

## Alliances

- Independent by treaty — [[treaty-of-damask|Treaty of Damask]], 21 May 2021
- [[Vanir]] — 1 – 18 Dec 2021 (invited; its departure helped collapse the alliance)
- [[cucumber-company|Cucumber Company]] — 1 Apr – 25 Sep 2022{{cite:thread-278112-p08|p8 #160, 26 Jun 2022}}
- [[smtn-elf|smtn elf]] — 25 Sep 2022 – 9 Mar 2023

articles.title: Nether's Ascent
articles.summary: Nether's Ascent [TNA] was created on 21 December 2014 by Francis12qwasyx and was, with Kangronomicon, one of the two guilds that controlled the territory map in mid-2015. It co-founded Legio Praetoria, was overtaken for first place in autumn 2015, and was still in existence as a Federation member in 2018.

infobox.label: Peak
infobox.value: Ranked first by experience until autumn 2015

infobox.label: Status
infobox.value: Listed as a Federation member guild, Nov 2018

articles.body:
**Nether's Ascent** [TNA] was one of the first Wynncraft guilds and one of the two dominant territorial powers of mid-2015. It was created on 21 December 2014 by Francis12qwasyx, the same day as [[holders-of-le|Holders of LE]] and one day before guild warfare was released{{cite:community-guild-timeline|Dec 2014}}.

## History

In early March 2015 it was one of the four founding guilds of the alliance Legio Praetoria, with KnightOfValor, [[imperial|Imperial]] and [[kangronomicon|Kangronomicon]]; two of the four left on 5 June 2015 and the alliance collapsed roughly a month later{{cite:community-guild-timeline|2015}}. Through the summer of 2015 Nether's Ascent and Kangronomicon between them held the map. [[drew1011|Drew1011]] described the pair as "essentially the Hax of mid 2015"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L32}}, and a June 2016 forum post reached for the same comparison, calling [[hackforums|HackForums]] and [[libertas|Libertas]] a "rule of two" that "many distinguished scholars compare … to the ancient guilds of 'The Nether's Ascent' and 'Kangronomicon'"{{cite:thread-133666|post #1, 26 Jun 2016}}.

The guild was a standing target for smaller guilds trying to make a name. Drew1011 wrote that Holders of LE ran deliberate skirmishes against it in mid-2015, "frequently … able to take and hold about 6-7 territories before they pushed us back", specifically in order to be noticed by Kangronomicon{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L31–33}}. Kangronomicon passed Nether's Ascent in experience to take first place shortly before September 2015{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L105}}.

### The allegation of diverted attacks

Drew1011 recorded a suspicion that Nether's Ascent redirected hostile guilds onto its own ally: "Myself and many others suspect this is because of the terribly kept secret that TNA would often make deals with other guilds where they managed to persuade other guilds to instead attack their Fuq, their ally"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L147}}. He offered no evidence for it, and the question was never settled. The map he reproduces beside the passage shows [[validus|Validus]] and its allies holding most of the province with Kangronomicon absent from it entirely while Nether's Ascent retains its whole eastern block{{cite:drew1011-storytime|territory map reproduced as a screenshot at L145}}; the image is consistent with the claim but was selected by the person making it.

### Later record

Unlike most guilds of its cohort, Nether's Ascent outlived the period. It was still recruiting members away from other guilds in 2016 — an applicant to Libertas in September 2016 wrote "i was in [[validus|Validus]] and now i'am in nether ascent but I'm not satisfied of the guild anymore"{{cite:thread-119596-p15|post #286, Synchr0, 30 Sep 2016}} — and it was a member guild of [[the-federation|the Federation]], listed as "Nethers Ascent [TNA]" in the November 2018 roster{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}. When it joined, what it contributed, and when it ended were never recorded.

## Alliances

- Legio Praetoria — founding member, early Mar 2015{{cite:community-guild-timeline|2015}}
- [[the-federation|The Federation]] — listed in the member roster of Nov 2018{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}

articles.title: Niflheim
articles.summary: Niflheim was a community alliance of 2020-2021 whose four members — Avicia, IceBlue Team, ShadowFall and TheNoLifes — simultaneously belonged to the era's war blocs. It officially dissolved on 18 December 2021, the same day Vanir collapsed.

articles.title: Nitrogen2Oxygen
articles.summary: Emperator of the Emperium of Wynn (2017), elected over Drew1011 by 31 votes to 30; co-leader of DiamondDeities with Icey_Diamond, and the player who disbanded that guild on 8 January 2020, ending Horologium and the alliance wars of 2019.

infobox.label: Known for
infobox.value: Emperator of the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]] (2017); disbanding [[DiamondDeities]] (8 Jan 2020)

articles.body:
Nitrogen2Oxygen's career spans the era's bookends: he led its first grand experiment in mass alliance and ended its last.

## The Emperium of Wynn

In 2017 he was Emperator of the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]], the twelve-guild alliance founded on 21 April 2017, and sat among its Judges{{cite:thread-188024|post #1, 7 May 2017: "Current Emperator - Nitrogen2Oxygen", roster and Judges}}; he still held the office on 5 September 2017{{cite:thread-202724|post #7, Aya, 5 Sep 2017, quoting the opening post}}. The office made him "the main figure head and the leader of the Emperium of Wynn… Their word is law within the alliance"{{cite:thread-202724|post #7, Aya, 5 Sep 2017, quoting the opening post}}.

He was elected to it. The only account of the election is [[drew1011|Drew1011]]'s, who ran against him and lost. Paladin A'renos announced the election on standing down, non-members of the alliance were permitted to run, and three candidates came forward: Nitrogen2Oxygen, Josh (later ElegantDeath) and Drew1011. Josh withdrew and became Drew1011's campaign manager; the campaign opened with a debate run on presidential lines and the vote itself ran for a week.{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L768–787, composed 26 Feb 2018}} Drew1011 recorded the result as "an astoundingly close 30-31, with Nitro as the winner"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L794 and the accompanying screenshot, composed 26 Feb 2018}}.

![The Emperium of Wynn's Emperator election announcement, posted by Paladin A'renos, with the final reaction tallies: 30 for Drew1011, 31 for Nitrogen2Oxygen.](/images/chronicles/storytime/37-image.webp)

When the election happened is unresolved. Drew1011's narrative places it in the autumn of 2017, but Nitrogen2Oxygen is already named Emperator in the alliance's May 2017 roster{{cite:thread-188024|post #1, 7 May 2017}}, so the contest belongs earlier in the year than the narrative implies. Nitrogen2Oxygen ran the poll that made Drew1011 the alliance's Shadow Advisor on 31 August 2017{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L797–798 and the accompanying screenshot, composed 26 Feb 2018}}{{cite:thread-202724|post #7, Aya, 5 Sep 2017, quoting the opening post}}. The Emperium fell on 17 October 2017; by that date the opening post named a different Emperator, Angry_will{{cite:thread-202724|post #1, as last edited 17 Oct 2017}}, and [[drew1011|Drew1011]]'s profile records a one-day Emperator title on 15-16 October 2017{{cite:forums-wynncraft-com-members-drew1011-2157|Drew1011's Wynncraft forum profile (member 2157): title chain with dates}}. How the office passed between the three was never recorded.

## DiamondDeities

He then co-led the guild [[DiamondDeities]] [DDT] with Icey_Diamond{{cite:thread-227373|post #1, leader table, 5 Jun 2018 (ed. 21 Jul 2018)}}, and Drew1011's "Federation Tribute" credited them jointly each as "a most sincere and trusted friend" of the [[the-federation|Federation]]{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}. On the forums he posted under the alias Cloud Man{{cite:thread-236962-p02|p2 #27–#28, 11 Nov 2018 (the post is quoted back as "Nitrogen2Oxygen said")}}.

On 8 January 2020 he disbanded DiamondDeities - by then a Federation and [[aesir-pact|Aesir Pact]] veteran, an apparent [[SOL]] guild, a Treaty of Rodoroc signatory alongside [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]], and a founder of [[Terra]], the [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] and [[Horologium]] (1 December 2019). The disbanding dissolved Horologium the same day and marked the end of [[the-alliance-wars-of-2019|the alliance wars of 2019]]. Most remaining members regrouped as Lux Nova the next day{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records: Community Timeline — DiamondDeities disbanded 8 Jan 2020, Lux Nova regrouping}}. His role within DDT immediately before the disbanding is not known.

articles.summary: Wynncraft guild founded on 2 Jun 2017 by EHTYSCYTHE, with one of the broadest alliance histories on record: the Coalition, Alliance Alliance, the Federation, Terra, co-founder of Artemis, Valkyrie and Hestia member, Goose, Valhalla, Vanir, and smtn elf.

articles.title: PaladinSorcerer
articles.summary: Titans Valor member, known on the forums as "Pally", whose megalist posts of December 2020 and June 2021 are the earliest and fullest written records of the Hestia and Artemis alliances.

infobox.label: Known for
infobox.value: The 2 Dec 2020 [[hestia|Hestia]]/[[artemis|Artemis]] megalist post; the Jun 2021 Hestia roster

articles.body:
PaladinSorcerer posted as "Pally"; his posts carry the forum title "Titans Valor [ANO]/Holders of LE [HoL]"{{cite:thread-278112-wb20210704|author profile block beside posts #8–#10 (badge markup, not post text), capture of 4 Jul 2021}}.

On 2 December 2020 he wrote to [[the-forum-megalist|the megalist]] arguing that [[titans-valor|Titans Valor]] was neither a war guild nor a community guild but "Mixed", citing the guild-run "Spring Fling, Summer Tournament, and Hallowynn Festival which we hosted for the entirety of the wynn community"{{cite:thread-278112|post #8, 2 Dec 2020}}. A second post the same day named both of Titans Valor's alliances: "ANO is apart of the alliances Hestia (a community alliance between ANO, ESI, LXA, and PUN) and Artemis (war alliance) made up of all the current massive land holding guilds on the map"{{cite:thread-278112|post #10, 2 Dec 2020}}. [[iceresistance|IceResistance]] replied within the hour: "umm ANO community guild FIRST / war second"{{cite:thread-278112|post #11, 2 Dec 2020}}.

On 6 June 2021 he posted [[hestia|Hestia]]'s six-guild roster: "you can add Hestia to Titans Valor [ANO], [[emorians|Emorians]] [ERN], Lux Nova [LXA], Empire of Sindria [ESI], [[paladins-united|Paladins United]] [PUN], and [[hackforums|Hackforums]] [Hax]... We're a community alliance and have been together for about a year now."{{cite:thread-278112-p07|p7 #140, 6 Jun 2021}}

His rank inside Titans Valor was never recorded. [[titan-times|Titan Times]] vol. 3 lists PaladinSorcerer among recipients of the guild's Veteran Medal, "granted to distinguished former members of ANO", placing his departure before mid-2022{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol3|vol. 3, 12 Jun 2022}}.

articles.title: PillowPet
articles.summary: PillowPet created Holders of LE on 21 December 2014, in the week guild warfare was introduced, and was still listed among the guild's chiefs in May 2018, nearly three and a half years later.
articles.body:
**PillowPet** created [[holders-of-le|Holders of LE]] [HoL] on 21 December 2014{{cite:community-guild-timeline|Dec 2014}} — one day before guilds and guild warfare were released in [[the-guild-update|the Guild Update]], and among the first guilds in the [[early-guild-era|early guild era]]. The guild's recruitment thread described it as "Founded upon the advent of the official release of guilds"{{cite:thread-217600|post #1, Thundderr, 10 May 2018}}.

In May 2018 "Pillowpet" was among the guild's four chiefs, alongside [[kuroi|Kur0i]], PikaLegend_ and Hawaiian__{{cite:thread-217600|post #1, Thundderr, 10 May 2018}}. Between the two dates lie nearly three and a half years and at least five changes of ownership at the guild{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L19, L67–71, L104–111, L312, L1035}}.

Nothing else about PillowPet is recorded. The name appears nowhere in [[drew1011|Drew1011]]'s account of the guild's 2015 leadership crisis, in any alliance roster, or on any leaderboard. Whether PillowPet led the guild at any point, or in what capacity the 2014 creation was made, was never documented.

articles.title: Pirates of Wynn
articles.summary: Pirates of Wynn [PoW] was a Wynncraft guild of early 2015, reportedly a top-ten guild contesting sixth place with Kangronomicon in January 2015 and dead by late May. Almost nothing else about it was ever recorded.
articles.body:
**Pirates of Wynn** [PoW] was a Wynncraft guild active in the first months of guild warfare, known only from [[drew1011|Drew1011]]'s retrospective account. Drew1011 named it as the first guild he joined: "I joined it in early January 2015, when it was a top 10 guild constantly fighting [[kangronomicon|Kangronomicon]] for the #6 rank."{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L13–14, composed 22 Feb 2018}} He left Wynncraft within about a week and returned in late May 2015 to find "that the guild had died"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L15}}.

Nothing else about the guild was ever recorded. Its creation date, its owner, its members, its alliances and the circumstances of its end are all unknown{{cite:community-guild-timeline|the timeline names no guild called Pirates of Wynn}}. No guild leaderboard from early 2015 survives, and machine-recorded war data begins in January 2018{{cite:territory-exchanges|territory_exchanges map-data analysis}}. The guild belongs to the [[early-guild-era|early guild era]]'s large undocumented remainder.

articles.title: Pretzule
articles.summary: Leader of House of Sentinels from at least April 2017, when the guild turned deliberately toward warring — the pivot that took it into the Coalition's founding circle that October.

articles.title: The private diplomacy era
articles.summary: 2023 to 2026: alliance-making disappeared into private Discords, and the era's alliances — behind the largest wars ever fought — were never named or published. The in-game ally registrations that appeared from June 2026 record a game mechanic used chiefly to permit joint guild raids, not the era's politics.

infobox.label: Named alliances
infobox.value: [[Avocado Aquarium]] (the era's only named war pact)

infobox.label: Major wars
infobox.value: [[the-avocado-split|The Avocado split]], [[avicia-sequoia-war|Avicia–Sequoia war]], [[idiot-co-aquarium-war|Idiot Co–Aquarium war]], [[aequitas-avicia-war|Aequitas–Avicia war]], [[aequitas-sequoia-war|Aequitas–Sequoia war]]

infobox.label: Defining shift
infobox.value: Diplomacy moved to private Discords and never re-emerged in public

articles.body:
{{map:2024-06-01|The map during the Idiot Co–Aquarium war}}

After [[smtn elf]] faded in mid-2023, public diplomacy stopped. No alliance roster was published anywhere after June 2022{{cite:thread-278112-p09|p9 #161, Sg_Voltage, 7 Jul 2022}}, and from 2023 onward alliance-making happened in private guild Discords. [[Titans Valor]]'s founder IceResistance later described the older practice: guilds "had their own channels, their own Discords, their own backrooms where actual conversations happened. Alliances were formed, enemies were negotiated with, all behind closed doors. And it worked." In October 2025 the official Discord's #guild-politics channel was renamed #guild-community{{cite:thread-322643|post #1, IceResistance, 2 Oct 2025}}. The wars of this era were the largest yet fought, but the alliances behind them were never named or published.

## The Avocado Aquarium

The era's one named pact was [[Avocado Aquarium]], the two-guild alliance of [[Avicia]] and [[The Aquarium]] after [[the-avocado-split|they quit smtn elf]] in June 2023. The pair waged a sniping and claim-taking campaign against their former allies into early 2024 and ran shared infrastructure, including the joint subguild Avoquarium [HQs] (created 9 August 2023){{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}. By August 2023 they were each other's 'unwavering ally'{{cite:thread-310286|Avicia guild thread, season post of 19 Aug 2023}}. The era's only other named relationship came in September 2023: 'TNL and AEQ were allied and warring together.'{{cite:thread-280525-p22|p22 #427, kwiebs, 1 Sep 2023}}

## Wars known only from the map

None of the era's major wars was publicly declared:

- [[avicia-sequoia-war|Avicia–Sequoia war]] (Oct–Nov 2023, second round Jan 2024) — Avicia against the young [[Sequoia]] (founded 14 Oct 2022){{cite:api-wynncraft-com-v3-guild-sequoia|creation date 14 Oct 2022, retrieved 2 Sep 2026}}, whose rise continued regardless: it won seven consecutive guild seasons from mid-2024{{cite:wynncraft-wiki-gg-wiki-guild-seasons|season table, Seasons 19-25}}.
- [[idiot-co-aquarium-war|Idiot Co–Aquarium war]] (Apr 2024 – Jan 2025) — the biggest war since 2021, peaking at 5,045 territory exchanges in a week{{cite:territory-exchanges|Idiot Co-Aquarium war, Apr 2024 - Jan 2025: weekly peak 5,045}} and spanning the 'Rekindled World' map rework of 10 August 2024{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}.
- [[the-long-raid|The Long Raid]] (late Jul – early Aug 2024) — a week-long siege of [[Aequitas]]'s Sky-province claim, the era's only battle retold first-hand{{cite:thread-318070|post #1, Defervesco, 9 Aug 2024}}{{cite:youtube-com-watch-v-rlrh14ns6ok|'Wynncraft Warring - The Long Raid', Frank Wynncraft, premiered 4 Aug 2024}}; the attackers were never named.
- [[aequitas-avicia-war|Aequitas–Avicia war]] (3 Nov – 21 Dec 2025) — the largest war ever fought: 15,710 territory exchanges, weekly peak 4,736{{cite:territory-exchanges|Aequitas-Avicia war, 3 Nov - 21 Dec 2025}}.
- On 25 May 2026 KongoBoys began a sustained campaign against [[Profession Heaven]], ending the neutrality it had held since January 2021{{cite:territory-exchanges|KongoBoys-Profession Heaven campaign from 25 May 2026}}.
- [[aequitas-sequoia-war|Aequitas–Sequoia war]] (from Aug 2026, ongoing) — 7,488 territory exchanges in its first week, with Aequitas driven to zero territories{{cite:territory-exchanges|Aequitas-Sequoia war, first week, Aug 2026}}.

## The in-game ally record (2026)

In June 2026 a machine-made record of guild relationships appeared, but not a record of the era's politics. Wynncraft's in-game ally system — present since 2021 — acquired its main practical use when allied guilds gained the ability to run guild raids together{{cite:wynncraft-wiki-gg-wiki-version-2-2-1|Official Wynncraft Wiki, 'Version 2.2.1' (12 Jun 2026)}}, and [[Sequoia]]'s open-source mod began capturing the game's 'formed/revoked an alliance with' broadcasts{{cite:github-com-sequoiawynncraft-sequoia-mod|commit 69fb472, 12 Jun 2026}}, producing the first machine-made records of [[first-machine-recorded-alliances|in-game ally registrations]]{{cite:raw-githubusercontent-com-sequoiawynncraft-sequoia-mod-main-src-test-java-com-seqwawa-|ChatManagerTest alliance-message fixtures}}. They record which guilds were registered as allies and nothing about the politics of the era. From 30 July 2026 the mod auto-snapshots the in-game Diplomacy menu to a private archive{{cite:github-com-sequoiawynncraft-sequoia-mod|commit 8b27368 and Modrinth 1.8.0 changelog, 30 Jul 2026}} (see [[the-diplomacy-update|The Diplomacy update]]).

What became visible is a game-mechanical relationship, used chiefly to permit joint guild raids; it does not indicate political alliance, and guilds registered as in-game allies may be rivals or recent belligerents. The alliances behind the era's wars therefore remain unnamed. Nothing has succeeded [[the-forum-megalist|the megalist]], whose last roster dates from June 2022{{cite:thread-278112-p08|p8 #160, TherapueticLiz, 26 Jun 2022}}.

articles.title: Profession Heaven
articles.summary: A public profession-XP guild founded by Crokee in January 2021 and granted neutral status that same month under the joint protection of Goose and Artemis. Its neutrality outlived both protectors and every successor alliance, ending only in May 2026 when KongoBoys began a sustained campaign against it.

articles.title: Profession Heaven neutrality
articles.summary: On 25 Jan 2021 Profession Heaven was granted neutral status, protected by both Goose and Artemis, and given Silent Expanse territory as a public profession-XP guild — an arrangement that held for over five years.
articles.body:
The grant was made in the middle of the [[Goose-Artemis war]], with both warring alliances protecting [[Profession Heaven]] at once{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}. Its first territory exchange fell on the same day{{cite:territory-exchanges|first Profession Heaven territory exchange, 25 Jan 2021}}.

The arrangement was unique: a guild holding land on a contested map by the joint consent of both sides of a map-wide war.

## A five-year peace

The neutrality outlived its guarantors. When Goose and Artemis collapsed together on 11 May 2021 ([[The Great Collapse]]), protection carried over to their successors. Profession Heaven eventually joined the blocs outright, appearing on [[Cucumber Company]]'s final public roster of 26 Jun 2022{{cite:thread-278112-p08|p8 #160, TherapueticLiz, 26 Jun 2022}} and remaining through the rename into [[smtn-elf|smtn elf]]{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol6|vol. 6, 12 Oct 2022}} until that alliance's end in mid-2023 — while its protected, neutral character as a public XP guild persisted.

The arrangement held until 25 May 2026, when KongoBoys — itself a former Cucumber Company ally — began the sustained campaign that [[fall-of-profession-heaven-s-neutrality|ended the neutrality]] after more than five years{{cite:territory-exchanges|KongoBoys-Profession Heaven campaign from 25 May 2026}}.
articles.leadImageCaption: Map of the Silent Expanse, the province in which Profession Heaven was given territory to operate as a public profession ground fr.

articles.title: Pyrias
articles.summary: Founder of House of Sentinels on 2 July 2016, the guild that became one of the four founding members of the Coalition in October 2017.

articles.title: Sequoia
articles.summary: Wynncraft guild founded on 14 Oct 2022 that rose to win seven consecutive guild seasons from mid-2024. Its open-source mod produced the first machine-captured records of the game's in-game ally system in June 2026. Fought Avicia in 2023-24 and has been at war with Aequitas since August 2026.
articles.body:
Sequoia [SEQ] is a Wynncraft guild created on 14 Oct 2022, owned by [[gazthecat|GaztheCat]].{{cite:api-wynncraft-com-v3-guild-sequoia|creation date and owner, retrieved 2 Sep 2026}} It rose during [[private-diplomacy-era|the private-diplomacy era]], when alliance politics had left the public forums.

## History

### Rise (2022-2024)

Within its first year Sequoia drew the attention of an established power: [[Avicia]] skirmished with it through spring 2023, and [[avicia-sequoia-war|the main eruption came on 30 Oct - 20 Nov 2023]], peaking at 1,454 territory exchanges per week, with a second round in January 2024.{{cite:territory-exchanges|territory_exchanges map-data analysis}} The war did not slow the guild — from mid-2024 Sequoia won seven consecutive guild seasons.{{cite:wynncraft-wiki-gg-wiki-guild-seasons|season winners table}}

![The in-game guild leaderboard for Season 22, which ended 9 February 2025, inside Sequoia's run of seven: Sequoia first on 10,358,368 Season Rating, followed by The Aquarium, Aequitas, Avicia, Empire of TKW, Titans Valor, TruthSworD, Profession Heaven, Empire of Sindria and Black Fangs.](/images/chronicles/media/sequoia-6ed1a500.webp){{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol18|vol. 18, 13 Apr 2025}}

### The machine record (2026)

In June 2026 Sequoia's open-source mod began capturing the game's [[first-machine-recorded-alliances|in-game ally registrations]] from chat, the first such records made by software rather than written down by a person.{{cite:raw-githubusercontent-com-sequoiawynncraft-sequoia-mod-main-src-test-java-com-seqwawa-|ChatManagerTest fixtures, commit 69fb472, 12 Jun 2026}} From 30 Jul 2026 the mod began auto-snapshotting the in-game Diplomacy menu to Sequoia's private backend, a growing machine-readable record of those registrations.{{cite:github-com-sequoiawynncraft-sequoia-mod|commit 8b27368 / Modrinth 1.8.0 changelog, 30 Jul 2026}}{{cite:github-com-sequoiawynncraft-sequoia-mod-blob-main-src-test-java-com-seq|GuildAllianceSnapshotManagerTest}}

### The Aequitas war (2026)

After a one-week clash in August 2025 and spring 2026 skirmishes, [[aequitas-sequoia-war|full war with Aequitas]] erupted in the week of 24 Aug 2026 — 7,488 territory exchanges in its first week, with Aequitas driven to zero territories.{{cite:territory-exchanges|territory_exchanges map-data analysis}}{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}} The war is ongoing.

## Alliances

Sequoia belonged to none of the twenty-two known alliances of 2015-2024; by its era, alliance rosters had moved to private Discords, and no political alliance of Sequoia's was ever recorded.{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}} Its own mod captured in-game ally registrations — a game-mechanical relationship used chiefly to let allied guilds run guild raids together, not evidence of political alignment:{{cite:raw-githubusercontent-com-sequoiawynncraft-sequoia-mod-main-src-test-java-com-seqwawa-|ChatManagerTest fixtures, commit 69fb472, 12 Jun 2026}}

- Silk Road — ally registered, June 2026
- Chiefs Of Corkus — ally registration revoked by GaztheCat, June 2026 (registration date unrecorded)
- Anime Lovers — ally registration revoked by Anime Lovers, June 2026 (registration date unrecorded)
articles.leadImageCaption: Sequoia's guild logo: the guild name in white brush lettering across a drawn canopy of teal and orange redwood trunks.

articles.title: Seraphim
articles.summary: Seraphim was a self-consciously unserious community alliance opened on 8 August 2016 by Dacleos, declaring itself "100% community based" with "no intention of actively providing support for guild wars". Its four recorded members included Libertas, then the second-largest territory holder on the map.
articles.leadImageCaption: The Seraphim Alliance emblem: a gold eight-pointed star within a crescent.

articles.title: Sg_Voltage
articles.summary: Creator and maintainer of the forum megalist, Wynncraft’s community register of guilds and alliances from November 2020, and the player who deleted its alliance section in July 2022.
articles.body:
Sg_Voltage created Wynncraft forums thread 278112, "Read Before Applying To A Guild - All Currently Recruiting Guilds Megalist", on 29 November 2020, and maintained it for the next two years{{cite:thread-278112|thread opened 29 Nov 2020; first replies of 30 Nov 2020}}. The opening post set out the purpose: "I've assembled a list of every* guild which is currently recruiting along with some important stats... My goal is to be able to make sure every guild gets the chance to shine and every player can get the chance to find the guild that's right for them."{{cite:thread-278112|post #1 (OP)}}

The list lived in a Google Sheet edited by the guilds themselves — "send me a message with your Gmail and I'll give you editing permission" — which is why its rosters were lost when the sheet went down{{cite:thread-278112-wb20210704|post #1 (OP), capture of 4 Jul 2021}}. Forum administrator colin350 pinned the thread on 17 January 2021 after Sg_Voltage committed to weekly updates{{cite:thread-278112-p04|p4 #65 and #67, 14–17 Jan 2021}}.

One column of that sheet recorded alliances, and it became the era's register of record: nearly every dated alliance roster of 2020–22 traces to a post asking Sg_Voltage to update it. On 7 July 2022 he ended it, replying to a correction with "For alliance information, it's supposed to be updated by the guilds themselves... I don't care to follow guild drama", then: "You know what, on second thought I'm just going to delete that section. If it's not updated regularly it's not really useful anyways."{{cite:thread-278112-p09|p9 #161, 7 Jul 2022}} No public alliance roster has been published since.

No guild is recorded for Sg_Voltage. In July 2021 his forum profile showed a CHAMPION rank, the custom title "1.18 was the best update, don't @me", and no guild field at all{{cite:thread-278112-wb20210704|author profile block (badge markup, not post text), capture of 4 Jul 2021}} — fitting for the community's neutral registrar, though whether the omission was deliberate is unknown.

articles.title: ShadowFall
articles.summary: Wynncraft guild founded in 2017 that held a leadership seat in Artemis by early 2020, switched sides to Goose in February 2021, and served in Niflheim, Valhalla and Vanir. By 2023 it was a subguild of The Aquarium.
