articles.title: The wipe of HackForums
articles.summary: On 19 February 2018, three days after forming, the Federation attacked HackForums' 111 territories; by 22 February 2018 HackForums held none, ending Hax as a territorial power a year after its peak of roughly 350 territories. It is the event behind the community memory of "the fall of Hax", which is usually misdated to 2017.

infobox.label: Date
infobox.value: 19 Feb 2018; zero territories by 22 Feb 2018{{cite:thread-219744|post #1, 22 Feb 2018}}

infobox.label: Outcome
infobox.value: HackForums reduced from 111 territories to zero; no guild then held more than 43{{cite:thread-219744|post #1, 22 Feb 2018}}

articles.body:
The wipe of HackForums was the operation in which the newly formed [[the-federation|Federation]] took [[HackForums]]' remaining 111 territories. The attack came on 19 February 2018 and wiped Hax's holdings "to 0 in under 12 hours"{{cite:community-guild-timeline|Community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ), via Wynncraft forums thread 265297}}; the guild held zero territories on 22 February 2018{{cite:thread-219744|post #1, 22 Feb 2018}}. It ended Hax's years as a territorial power.

{{map:2018-02-19|The map on the day of the wipe}}

## Background

HackForums was the dominant territorial guild of the mid-2010s. In September 2016 Hax held 146 of roughly 332 held territories — more than double the next guild, [[Libertas]] (60), with UltimateXeons third (53){{cite:pre2018-territory-snapshots|pre2018-territory-snapshots.json — Wayback Machine capture of the Wynncraft v1 API guild leaderboard, 23 Sep 2016}}. Its 2017 peak approached 350 territories{{cite:thread-265297|post #18, 4 Apr 2020}}. It held that map at the head of a bloc, not alone: [[HackForums]], Libertas [Lir] and Blacklisted [BLA], with UltimateXeons [UXs] a party to the pact in mid-2016{{cite:thread-133666|post #13, 27 Jun 2016}}{{cite:thread-143392|post #12, 9 Aug 2016}}{{cite:thread-131893|post #1, as revised 15 Sep 2017}}. Contemporaries had no name for the arrangement, calling it "a mutual land agreement"{{cite:thread-133666|post #16, 28 Jun 2016}}; the label "Hax & Co" was a later community coinage, first recorded in July 2019{{cite:thread-252647|post #5, 21 Jul 2019}}. No exchange-level war data survives from before 2018{{cite:territory-exchanges|territory_exchanges map-data analysis}}.

By early 2018 Hax was a member of the [[Coalition]], and on 16–17 February 2018 it left with the breakaway [[Alliance Alliance]] bloc, starting the [[coalition-civil-war|Coalition Civil War]]{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}. The Federation — formed on 16 February 2018 from the Coalition remnant and War Syndicate's remains — was three days old when it struck{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}.

## Course of the war

On 19 February 2018 the Federation attacked Hax's 111 territories "and wipes them to 0 in under 12 hours"{{cite:community-guild-timeline|Community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ), via Wynncraft forums thread 265297}}. A thread of 22 February 2018, "Haxforums Has Fallen At Last.", announced: "After years of being number 1, HaxForums has lost all its territories. Now its much easier to be on the leaderboard, since the guilds with the most territories have only 43. Everyone celebrate!"{{cite:thread-219744|post #1, 22 Feb 2018}} A moderator closed the thread four minutes and two replies later{{cite:thread-219744|post #3, 22 Feb 2018}}. No fuller account of the fighting survives: the attacking guilds, the order of the territories, and how the 19 February attack relates to the 22 February result were never recorded.

## Aftermath

Hax's land was dispersed rather than inherited: no guild held more than 43 territories immediately afterwards{{cite:thread-219744|post #1, 22 Feb 2018}}. In community memory the event is usually placed a year earlier — one participant called the fall of Hax "probably the biggest event that happened in 2017"{{cite:thread-265297|post #16, 4 Apr 2020}} — but the recollection is about two months out: 2017 was the decline, and the fall itself belongs to February 2018 and to the Federation rather than to the [[Coalition]]{{cite:thread-219744|post #1, 22 Feb 2018}}.

The guild itself survived: it held 33 territories in March 2019{{cite:pre2018-territory-snapshots|pre2018-territory-snapshots.json — Wayback Machine capture of the Wynncraft v1 API guild leaderboard, 3 Mar 2019}}, and it was later a member of [[Valhalla]] (2021){{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}} and the [[Hestia]] community alliance (June 2021){{cite:thread-278112-p07-wb20211128|post #140, 6 Jun 2021}} — but it never again approached its 2016–17 scale.

articles.title: TheDarkSoul
articles.summary: Owner of the war guild HackForums from its creation on 24 December 2014, presiding over its 2016-17 territorial hegemony of up to roughly 350 territories.
articles.body:
TheDarkSoul owned the guild [[HackForums]] [Hax]. The guild's recruitment thread named him in every recovered revision, its header reading "HackForums [Hax] Lvl. 92 - Created 12/24/2014 / Guild Owner: TheDarkSoul"{{cite:thread-109319|post #1 (OP)}}. By the 2019 revision the thread no longer described a war guild at all: "This is a community guild, we do not war."{{cite:thread-109319-wb20190723|post #1 (OP), Wayback Machine capture 23 Jul 2019}} Day-to-day forum-keeping fell to officers such as Mrussell75 and Christinel8{{cite:thread-109319|thread bumps and replies by Mrussell75 and Christinel8}}; TheDarkSoul himself wrote almost nothing in public.

Under his ownership HackForums became the dominant territorial power of the pre-[[Coalition]] era. On 23 September 2016 Hax held 146 of roughly 332 territories, far ahead of any rival{{cite:pre2018-territory-snapshots|pre-2018 territory snapshots: Wynncraft v1 API guild leaderboard, Wayback capture of 23 Sep 2016}}; a March 2017 complaint thread put its holdings at "100+ territories"{{cite:thread-179383|post #6 (Drew1011), 1 Mar 2017; thread opened by Tntdestroyd the same day}}; by May 2017 it held more than 300{{cite:thread-189768|post #1, Hide007, 22 May 2017}}; and in 2020 Lego_DW placed the peak "closer to 350"{{cite:thread-265297|post #18 (Lego_DW), 4 Apr 2020}}. The hegemony ended in the Coalition-era wars of late 2017 and [[the-wipe-of-hackforums|the wipe of HackForums]] in February 2018.

When, or whether, his ownership ended was never recorded.

articles.title: TheNoLifes
articles.summary: One of the oldest guilds on Wynncraft, founded by Chownick in December 2014, days after guilds were introduced. It served in Ordo Malleus, the Emperium of Wynn, the Federation, Terra, the Council of Canyon Kingdoms, Goose, Niflheim and Valhalla — then turned on Valhalla in late 2021 and helped lead Khaos.

infobox.label: Status
infobox.value: Exists but near-dormant (7 members, no territories, Sep 2026)

articles.body:
TheNoLifes [TNL], also styled Del Morto, was founded on 27 December 2014 by [[chownick|Chownick]] — five days after guilds were added to Wynncraft in [[the-guild-update|the Guild Update]] — 'placing it as one of the oldest guilds in existence since the introduction of the guild system in Wynn'{{cite:thread-306694|post #1 (OP), 11 Feb 2023}}. The official API dates its creation to 28 December 2014{{cite:api-wynncraft-com-v3-guild-thenolifes|v3/guild response, retrieved 3 Sep 2026}}; the one-day gap is unexplained.

## History

### Early alliances (2015-2018)

TheNoLifes was among the guilds of [[ordo-malleus|Ordo Malleus]] listed in 2017{{cite:thread-109350|post #1, 'Guilds in Ordo Malleus' list}}, and in the roster of the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]] as 'The No Lifes (TNL) - Owner: chownick'{{cite:thread-188024|post #1, member-guild roster}}. It joined [[the-federation|the Federation]] on 5 May 2018{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}, one of the 37 guilds of [[drew1011|Drew1011]]'s Federation Tribute roster{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, member-guild list, 13 Nov 2018}}. When the Federation broke up, a forum post that day named TNL among the core guilds left exposed by the departures: 'leaving Fox, Hax, Imp, TNL, Ern, and a bunch of minor guilds weak'{{cite:thread-236914|post #1 (Glial), 10 Nov 2018}}.

### The 2019 churn

In [[the-alliance-wars-of-2019|the alliance wars of 2019]] it joined [[Terra]] on 30 August, followed the Terra core into the [[council-of-canyon-kingdoms|Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] on 29 September, and stayed until that alliance collapsed on 23 November{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}.

### Goose, Niflheim and Valhalla (2021)

TNL switched sides during the [[goose-artemis-war|Goose-Artemis war]]: on 1 February 2021 [[the-forum-megalist|the forum megalist]] recorded that 'BNU(IBT), SHY and TNL are all goose now'{{cite:thread-278112-p04|p4 #76, 1 Feb 2021}}. Its membership was still current on 30 March, when [[drasalia|Drasalia]] of ChinaNumberOne drew TNL as one of six Goose guilds and noted its reputation: 'From what my Guild Leader told me, they are the ones that know more about guild politics and all that cool stuff.'{{cite:thread-289196|post #1, 30 Mar 2021}} It joined the community alliance [[Niflheim]] by 7 July 2021{{cite:thread-278112-p08|p8 #146, 7 Jul 2021}} and was a founding member of [[Valhalla]] on 11 May 2021{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}.

### The break with Valhalla

When Valhalla's guilds reorganized as [[Vanir]] on 28 November 2021, TheNoLifes and [[the-mage-legacy|The Mage Legacy]] were excluded, and open war followed in December ([[the-betrayal-of-valhalla|the betrayal of Valhalla]]){{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}. TNL fought in [[Khaos]] from about 1 December 2021 until Khaos was absorbed into [[cucumber-company|Cucumber Company]] in June 2022, and helped lead the alliance{{cite:cameron-oral-history|Cameron oral history (TAq veteran testimony)}}.

### Later years

A recruitment thread of February 2023 presents a revived guild — 'Through time we have encountered challenges and revivals' — under a management team of 'Dons' and 'Consiglieres' with mafia-styled ranks, and names no owner{{cite:thread-306694|post #1 (OP), 11 Feb 2023}}. As of September 2026 the guild stood at level 94 with 33,635 recorded wars but only seven members and no territories, its listed owner last online in November 2024{{cite:api-wynncraft-com-v3-guild-thenolifes|v3/guild response, retrieved 3 Sep 2026}}. When Chownick left the leadership is not recorded.

## Alliances

- [[ordo-malleus|Ordo Malleus]] — listed 2017{{cite:thread-109350|post #1, Ordo Malleus guild list}}
- [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]] — listed 2017{{cite:thread-188024|post #1, member-guild roster}}
- [[the-federation|The Federation]] — 5 May – 10 Nov 2018
- [[Terra]] — 30 Aug – 15 Sep 2019
- [[council-of-canyon-kingdoms|Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] — 29 Sep – 23 Nov 2019
- [[Goose]] — by 1 Feb 2021 – 11 May 2021{{cite:thread-278112-p04|p4 #76, 1 Feb 2021}}
- [[Valhalla]] — 11 May – 28 Nov 2021
- [[Niflheim]] — 7 Jul – 18 Dec 2021 (community alliance){{cite:thread-278112-p08|p8 #146, 7 Jul 2021}}
- [[Khaos]] — c. 1 Dec 2021 – Jun 2022

articles.title: Titan Times
articles.summary: Titans Valor's guild newsletter, volumes 1-21 (May 2022 - May 2026): the most important primary source for alliance history after the forum megalist's deletion, documenting Cucumber Company, smtn elf, Hestia's decline and Adonis before turning inward after 2023.

infobox.label: Writers/editors
infobox.value: bitesizedbee4 ('Bee'), GebutterteWurst ('Geb'), Snazz, Aezuh, C0rupted, Talkair, l1npengtul

articles.body:
Twenty-one volumes were published between 8 May 2022{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol1|vol. 1, 8 May 2022}} and 18 May 2026{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol21|vol. 21, 18 May 2026}} (with a gap between vol. 11 of 25 May 2023{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol11|vol. 11, 25 May 2023}} and vol. 12 of 20 February 2024{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol12|vol. 12, 20 Feb 2024}}), hosted at titansvalor.org/news, with the first thirteen volumes mirrored at titantimes.github.io. After [[the-forum-megalist|the forum megalist]]'s alliance section was deleted in July 2022, Titan Times became the only regularly published, dated account of alliance affairs - the key primary source for the late [[the-realignment-era|realignment era]].

The masthead changed hands twice. The founding writer and editor was bitesizedbee4 ('Bee'), who carried vols. 1 to 10 (8 May 2022 - 23 Apr 2023){{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol1|vol. 1, 8 May 2022}}{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol10|vol. 10, 23 Apr 2023}}; GebutterteWurst ('Geb'), an ANO Councilor, joined as co-editor from vol. 7 (16 Dec 2022){{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol7|vol. 7, 16 Dec 2022}}; Snazz wrote the recent-happenings column; Aezuh handled visuals and publishing and was still being thanked for reviewing and posting the team's work in vol. 20{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol20|vol. 20, 23 Nov 2025}}; a member credited only as Andrew gave technical support in vol. 2{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol2|vol. 2, 23 May 2022}}; and karapandza appeared as a guest writer in vols. 10 and 11. C0rupted introduced himself as 'the new writer' in vol. 12 (Feb 2024){{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol12|vol. 12, 20 Feb 2024}} and remained on the team through vol. 21{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol21|vol. 21, 18 May 2026}}. From vol. 16 (Nov 2024){{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol16|vol. 16, 4 Nov 2024}} Talkair became the lead voice, credited in vol. 20 with 'not only writing but organising Titan Times for 5 whole editions'{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol20|vol. 20, 23 Nov 2025}}, with Lamplesspost writing the main-stage interviews from vol. 17{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol17|vol. 17, 15 Jan 2025}}. Vol. 21 (18 May 2026) announced another change: l1npengtul took over as Editor-in-Chief, alongside Talkair, DragonZftw and C0rupted, promising a quarterly schedule tied to the start of each guild season from vol. 22 onward{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol21|vol. 21, 18 May 2026}}.

Its most important records are concentrated in the first ten volumes: vol. 1 (8 May 2022) dates [[Cucumber Company]]'s formation to guild Season 5 ('our first season being a part of the new Cucumber Company war alliance') and the founding of [[Adonis]] as [[Hestia]] declined{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol1|vol. 1, 8 May 2022}}; vol. 3 (12 Jun 2022) records IceBlue Team's exit, Gang of Fools' arrival and [[Avicia]] joining Adonis{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol3|vol. 3, 12 Jun 2022}}; vol. 6 (12 Oct 2022) preserves the pivotal rename - 'Cucumber was archived. The new alliance name is called Smtn else' - along with Gang of Fools' betrayal and the accession of [[Paladins United]], [[The Simple Ones]] and TerraLune to what became [[smtn elf]]{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol6|vol. 6, 12 Oct 2022}}; vol. 9 (25 Mar 2023) records busted moments joining mid-season and Nefarious Ravens leaving 'on account of the guild disbanding'{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol9|vol. 9, 25 Mar 2023}}; vols. 12-13 (Feb-Mar 2024) record Adonis as still active{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol12|vol. 12, 20 Feb 2024}}{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol13|vol. 13, 22 Mar 2024}}.

After that the newsletter turns inward. Vols. 14-21 (2024-2026) cover guild events, the Spirit and Brilliance cabinets, dungeon and lore criticism, and ANO's internal Ocean Trials war rankings, but name no alliance at all{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol17|vol. 17, 15 Jan 2025}}{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol21|vol. 21, 18 May 2026}} - a silence that matches [[private-diplomacy-era|the private diplomacy era]]. What they do preserve is ANO's own record: the guild reaching level 105 in mid-2024 (vol. 15){{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol15|vol. 15, 5 Aug 2024}}, its season placings, and, in vol. 20 (23 Nov 2025), an interview with guild leader Calluum that is the only public account of ANO's leadership succession{{cite:titansvalor-org-news-vol20|vol. 20, 23 Nov 2025}}.

The newsletter's ecosystem also left machine traces: [[Titans Valor]]'s Discord bot (github.com/titantimes/valor) consumed a shared ANO/AVO alliance-claims feed between April and December 2022{{cite:github-com-titantimes-valor|repository commits, Apr-Dec 2022}}. The bot was not the work of [[motoki317]], who wrote moto-bot (github.com/motoki317/moto-bot), a separate Java Wynncraft utility bot with its own player-tracking commands, archived read-only on 27 January 2024{{cite:github-com-motoki317-moto-bot|repository page}}. Nothing links motoki317 to Titans Valor{{cite:chronicle-records|addendum 2; the motoki317 correction}}.

![Output of the '-guild' command from Titans Valor's Discord bot Valor, reproduced in Titan Times vol. 13 (22 March 2024): a guild overview giving level 103, 109 members, 31 territories and a war count of 60,937, above a table of the members online and their worlds.](/images/chronicles/media/titan-times-59a7fc93.webp){{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol13|vol. 13, 22 Mar 2024}}

articles.title: Tntdestroyd
articles.summary: Tntdestroyd was a Wynncraft war leader of 2017 and 2018: War Leader of the Emperium of Wynn in mid-2017, reportedly War Syndicate's unofficial leader, and a Federation member who left during a vote to expel his guild in March 2018.

infobox.label: Reported roles
infobox.value: Leader of BuildCraftia; unofficial leader of [[war-syndicate|War Syndicate]]

articles.body:
**Tntdestroyd**, known as **Tnt**, was one of the principal warring figures of 2017 and 2018.

## Career

On 1 March 2017 he opened a thread arguing that [[hackforums|HackForums]]' "vast control" of the territory map "has clearly killed the guild system for everyone else and should be forced to relieve there influence and control to a limit"{{cite:thread-179383|post #1, 1 Mar 2017}}. By mid-2017 he was the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]]'s "Current War Leader", a post "in charge of anything war related" including which guilds got which territory{{cite:thread-188024-p05|post #82, 16 Jun 2017, quoting the alliance opening post}}. He was named the alliance's member of the month for April and May 2017 "for his excellent efforts in wars and constant and resilient effort in taking territories for his guild and the alliance"{{cite:thread-188024-p03|post #60, Paladin A'renos, 22 May 2017}}.

![In-game private messages from Tntdestroyd to Drew1011: "ill be a monkeys uncle" / "did i just see a msg saying a community guild just kicked ass .... :0" / "gg". From Drew1011's account, placed in autumn 2017 immediately after Kingdom Foxes took Ternaves.](/images/chronicles/storytime/40-image.webp)

On 26 April 2018, replying to a thread calling for small guilds to organise against the map-holding alliance, he wrote: "Tyrant, message me if you are for real wanting to challenge the opposing alliance. We have already began forming what it is your looking to do now, join us if you like."{{cite:thread-224905|post #3, 26 Apr 2018}} [[drew1011|Drew1011]] calls that project "Centurion"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L1136–1141}}.

In November 2018 Drew1011's tribute on the [[the-federation|Federation]]'s collapse thanked "@Tntdestroyd, for fighting hard to reclaim the map back in March. As much as we've been at odds, I'll always be thankful for your contributions in the time you were with us"{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}.

## The record

Several of Tntdestroyd's roles rest on Drew1011's account alone. It calls him "Tnt, the unofficial leader of [[war-syndicate|War Syndicate]]"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L859}} and the leader of BuildCraftia — whose recorded 2017 owner is ItsAZZA{{cite:thread-188024|post #1}}. The same account says he directed the Federation's counter-effort after the mob update of 1 March 2018 and ceded coordination to Drew1011 on 3 March{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L1096–1100}}, and that he left the alliance on 30 March 2018 before a vote to expel his guild concluded{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L1142–1148}}; Tntdestroyd himself said he left of his own accord, and the episode was already disputed by 2019.

articles.title: Treaty of Damask
articles.summary: Signed 21 May 2021 by Nefarious Ravens and The Simple Ones, ten days after the Great Collapse; under it Nefarious Ravens declared independence.
articles.body:
Nefarious Ravens and [[The Simple Ones]] were its only parties, and the treaty's terms beyond the declaration of independence are unrecorded{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}.

## Context

It was concluded ten days after [[The Great Collapse]] of 11 May 2021, in which [[Goose]] and [[Artemis]] fell on the same day and the map's guilds re-sorted themselves into [[Valhalla]] and [[Khaos]]{{cite:thread-278112-p07|p7 #134-137, 25 May 2021}}. The Simple Ones had joined Valhalla at its founding; the treaty fixed Nefarious Ravens' position outside the new blocs as the [[Valhalla-Khaos war]] began.

## Legacy

Nefarious Ravens' independence lasted half a year. It was invited into [[Vanir]], Valhalla's successor, on 1 Dec 2021 — and was one of the four guilds whose departure [[vanir-collapses|collapsed Vanir]] seventeen days later{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}. It went on to join [[Cucumber Company]] in the 2022 realignment, remaining through the rename into [[smtn-elf|smtn elf]] until the guild disbanded in March 2023{{cite:titantimes-github-io-vol9|vol. 9, 25 Mar 2023}}.

articles.title: Treaty of Rodoroc
articles.summary: A peace treaty between Kingdom Foxes and DiamondDeities, signed earlier and taking effect on 2 March 2019, during the SOL–Luna era.
articles.body:
The Treaty of Rodoroc had been signed earlier{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}; the signing date was never recorded, and no text of the treaty survives.

## Context

The treaty belongs to the fractured landscape after the Federation's fall. DiamondDeities was then part of [[sol|SOL]], the bloc [[Luna]] had been formed to counter two weeks earlier, while [[Kingdom Foxes]] stood alone, fighting [[luna-s-war-on-kingdom-foxes|a five-month war against Luna]]{{cite:territory-exchanges|Luna-Kingdom Foxes war, Feb-Jul 2019}}. The peace appears to have continued an earlier arrangement between the two guilds: a late-2018 deal to share the Molten Heights{{cite:thread-265297|post #1, community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ), 28 Jul 2020}}. Rodoroc, the treaty's namesake, is the dwarven capital of that region.

## Legacy

The peace held: the two guilds went on to fight on the same side in [[Terra]] (September 2019) and the [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] that autumn, before [[diamonddeities-disbanded|DiamondDeities was disbanded]] in January 2020{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}.

articles.title: Treaty of Ternaves
articles.summary: Signed 6 Jul 2019 by Kingdom Foxes, The Simple Ones and ThisIsMurica, splitting the territory of the dissolved Celestial Tigers — and clearing the way for Kingdom Foxes to join Luna two days later.
articles.body:
Nothing else about Celestial Tigers — its history, its size, or the circumstances of its dissolution — was ever recorded.

## Context and consequence

At signing, [[The Simple Ones]] and ThisIsMurica were both members of [[Luna]], while [[Kingdom Foxes]] had been at war with that alliance since its second day of existence ([[luna-s-war-on-kingdom-foxes|Luna's war on Kingdom Foxes]], from 15 Feb 2019){{cite:territory-exchanges|Luna-Kingdom Foxes war from 15 Feb 2019}}. The treaty proved to be the war's off-ramp: directly afterwards, on 8 Jul 2019, Kingdom Foxes joined Luna, ending nearly five months of fighting{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records}}.

The consequences cascaded quickly. Within ten days the enlarged Luna wiped every remaining guild but [[Avicia]] and [[luna-gains-full-map-control|held the entire map]]{{cite:territory-exchanges|July 2019 wipe of all non-Luna holders}} — the peak from which the alliance would collapse two months later.

articles.title: urbymine
articles.summary: Former Chief of Avicia whose one-line forum post of 1 February 2021 recorded the defection of IceBlue Team, ShadowFall and TheNoLifes from Artemis to Goose.
articles.body:
On 1 February 2021 urbymine posted to [[the-forum-megalist|the megalist]]: "Just a smol update that i noticed: BNU(IBT), SHY and TNL are all goose now."{{cite:thread-278112-p04|p4 #76, 1 Feb 2021}} IceBlue Team, [[shadowfall|ShadowFall]] and TheNoLifes had defected from [[artemis|Artemis]] to [[goose|Goose]] — ShadowFall having held an Artemis leadership seat under [[goulartjj|GoulartJJ]] eleven months earlier{{cite:thread-263975-p02|p2 #36, 9 Mar 2020}}. In the same post he suggested the maintainer adopt "a google form system for guilds to request changes/additions to the list"{{cite:thread-278112-p04|p4 #76, 1 Feb 2021}}.

Three weeks later, posting under the forum title "Former Chief of Avicia"{{cite:thread-286375|post #5 author title block (badge markup, not post text), 20 Feb 2021}}, he argued in the thread "The Issue With 1.20 Guild Wars" that the alliance-dominated war system was working as designed: "we just have to accept that wars are a team-based effort, not just within your own guild but in that it requires you to reach out to other guilds to make progress on the map... adds a whole new layer to guildwars in the form of diplomacy... it actively discourages selfish and arrogant guilds"{{cite:thread-286375|post #5, 20 Feb 2021}}. He also correctly diagnosed the mechanic behind the era's complaints about escalating attack costs — "This is probably caused by the pity limit" — while agreeing that resource-poor regions were hard to campaign in{{cite:thread-286375|post #5, 20 Feb 2021}}.

His dates as an [[avicia|Avicia]] Chief are not recorded.

articles.title: Valhalla
articles.summary: Valhalla was the dominant war alliance of mid-to-late 2021, formed on 11 May 2021 by thirteen guilds — including The Aquarium — out of the simultaneous collapse of Goose and Artemis. It took map control within days and held it until its members reorganized as Vanir on 28 November 2021.

articles.title: Valhalla-Khaos war
articles.summary: The war between the two successor blocs of the Great Collapse, begun 11 May 2021 — the day both formed — and fading only in spring 2022. Vanir inherited Valhalla's side mid-war, and the realignment that followed produced Cucumber Company.

infobox.label: Outcome
infobox.value: No recorded peace; fighting faded by mid-July 2022 and the blocs merged into [[Cucumber Company]]

articles.body:
The Valhalla-Khaos war began on 11 May 2021, the day both blocs emerged from [[the-great-collapse|The Great Collapse]]{{cite:community-guild-timeline|11 May 2021 entry}}{{cite:thread-278112-p07|post #134, Dream, 25 May 2021}}, and ran — through renames, betrayals and collapses on the Valhalla side — until the fighting faded to nothing in 2022.

{{map:2021-05-11|The map when the war began}}

## Background

[[Valhalla]] formed from thirteen guilds including [[The Aquarium]]; [[Khaos]] formed the same day, largely from the [[Goose]] bloc's core: [[Aequitas]], Wheres The Finish, Nerfuria, Ultra Violet, Fuzzy Spiders, ChinaNumberOne, Cyphrus Code and Eden, joined days later by Tartarus Wrath{{cite:community-guild-timeline|11 May 2021 rosters}}. Valhalla took map control from Goose's remnants within days{{cite:community-guild-timeline|the May 2021 entry: Valhalla takes map control from Goose}} and dominated the map through 2021 — by September 2021 joining Valhalla was described as 'the meta' for leaderboard guilds{{cite:thread-295680|post #1, IamFye, 25 Sep 2021}}.

## Course of the war

Fighting was sustained — roughly a thousand territory exchanges a week at its peaks — from May 2021 into spring 2022{{cite:territory-exchanges|weekly capture volumes, May 2021 – spring 2022}}.

The Valhalla side changed shape mid-war. In late 2021 The Mage Legacy and TheNoLifes turned on their allies ([[the-federation-dies|not the first bloc]] to die of internal strain): friction was visible from August, and both were excluded when ten Valhalla guilds reorganized as [[Vanir]] on 28 November 2021{{cite:community-guild-timeline|28 Nov 2021 Vanir roster}}. The betrayal erupted into open war in December — 5,359 territory exchanges that month{{cite:territory-exchanges|5,359 territory exchanges, December 2021}} — and TheNoLifes went on to help lead Khaos{{cite:cameron-oral-history|Cameron oral history (TAq veteran testimony)}}. Vanir itself collapsed on 18 December 2021, twenty days after forming, when Emorians, Nefarious Ravens, IceBlue Team and [[Avicia]] left{{cite:community-guild-timeline|18 Dec 2021 entry}}.

Khaos fought on against the ex-Valhalla/Vanir guilds — an opposing coalition known as the Pineapple Pact, a name never written down at the time{{cite:cameron-oral-history|Cameron oral history (TAq veteran testimony)}}. This final phase peaked in January 2022 at 500–800 territory exchanges per week and faded through spring to nothing by mid-July 2022{{cite:territory-exchanges|weekly capture volumes, January–July 2022}}.

## Aftermath

No peace was ever recorded. Khaos was defunct by 26 June 2022; its guilds were absorbed into [[Cucumber Company]]{{cite:thread-278112-p08|post #160, TherapueticLiz, 26 Jun 2022}}, the merged mega-bloc of [[the-realignment-era|the 2022 realignment]] that united the ex-Valhalla and ex-Khaos worlds.

articles.title: Validus
articles.summary: Validus [Val] was a Wynncraft guild of 2015 led by Ezura and the founder of the Concordia alliance, the bloc that came closest to breaking the Kangronomicon and Nether's Ascent duopoly. In August 2015 its chief tangler declared hostilities against Holders of LE over that guild's defection to Kangronomicon.

infobox.label: Active
infobox.value: Jul 2015 – Oct 2015 as a power; inactive by Aug 2016

articles.body:
Validus was a guild, not an alliance: it carried a guild tag, its members described having been "in Validus", and it was Concordia's founding member rather than Concordia itself{{cite:thread-119596-p10|post #196, Pixelated0624, 20 Aug 2016}}{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L133}}.

## History

The guild was led by Ezura, with [[tangler]] as his chief{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L133, L138}}{{cite:forums-wynncraft-com-forums-guilds-72-prefix-id-82-order-post-date-direction-asc|Alliance-prefix thread index}}. Ezura appears in no other source.

Validus first approached [[holders-of-le|Holders of LE]], [[drew1011|Drew1011]]'s guild, on 5 July 2015, when tangler messaged its leadership after seeing it warring against [[kangronomicon|Kangronomicon]]{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L82–84}}. Drew1011 describes months of correspondence about "plans to revolt against Fuq & TNA and bring them down from their role as the two guilds that controlled the map", and writes that in his own judgement nothing came of them: "My forum inbox became filled with talks of strategy and tactics … But no meaningful results ever came about"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L85–92}}. In his 2017 account of the same period he describes the relationship as membership of Validus's alliance: "we joined their alliance, Concordia. Although in the end we left to pursue better opportunities for the guild"{{cite:the-emperial-truth|Drew1011's Emperator application essay, mid-2017}}.

### The break of August 2015

On 14 August 2015 Holders of LE became a Kangronomicon subguild without notifying Validus, and the following day tangler added Drew1011 and [[spham|Spham]] to a forum group chat. His message opened by reproducing a quotation attributed to Ezura reacting to the defection — "it was later revealed that the Ezura … quote was an edited quote that had originated from a completely different subject", Drew1011 wrote{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L96–97}}. The second half declared the consequence, dated on its own byline to 16 August 2015:

> "Drew's betrayal has greatly limited our options … I'm not inclined to try to persuade Ezura to give Drew another chance, and will act on his instructions accordingly. What a waste, now we all get to fight while TNA laughs . . . I give you an hour's notice, an hour more than Drew gave me."{{cite:drew1011-storytime|forum post by tangler, dated 16 Aug 2015, reproduced as a screenshot at L96}}

![The second half of tangler's forum post of 16 August 2015, in which Validus gives Holders of LE "an hour's notice" of hostilities over its defection to Kangronomicon. Reproduced as a screenshot in Drew1011's account of the period.](/images/chronicles/storytime/04-image.webp)

### Concordia and after

Validus founded Concordia, which grew through the autumn of 2015 among guilds opposed to the Kangronomicon and Nether's Ascent duopoly{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L133–144}}. Drew1011 wrote that Validus absorbed a group of members who left Holders of LE after its change of ownership on 22 September 2015 and was "the strongest" of the roughly four guilds in the coordinated Concordia attack on Kangronomicon and [[nethers-ascent|Nether's Ascent]] in October 2015{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L74–76, L124–126}}. In late September or early October 2015 Validus and its ally Travellers held most of the province{{cite:drew1011-storytime|territory map reproduced as a screenshot at L145}}.

Drew1011, a participant on the other side, wrote that opposition to Validus was fuelled by its leader's conduct in game{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L138–142}}. A thread titled "Come Join! The Odeus Anti-Validus Pact" was posted by tangler on 28 November 2015, ran to 24 replies, and was locked, its last poster the Wynncraft moderator Mekyr on 29 November 2015{{cite:forums-wynncraft-com-forums-guilds-72-prefix-id-82-order-post-date-direction-asc|Alliance-prefix thread index}}. What the thread said — and how a Validus chief came to author a pact named against his own guild — is not known.

The guild outlived its alliance. In August 2016 an applicant to [[libertas|Libertas]] wrote "I was in Validus the moment it was founded" and, of his reason for leaving, "My guild (Validus) is really inactive now"{{cite:thread-119596-p10|post #196, Pixelated0624, 20 Aug 2016}}. Its founding date, its size and the circumstances of its end are unrecorded.

## Alliances

- [[concordia|Concordia]] — founder, 2015{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L133–144}}
- [[vesta|Vesta]] — member by 10 Dec 2015 (fourteen-guild roster){{cite:drew1011-storytime|L293–306}}

A self-described community alliance across seven years, it persisted beneath every war bloc from the Federation to the eve of the 2022 realignment.

articles.title: Vanir
articles.summary: Vanir was the short-lived successor to Valhalla, formed on 28 November 2021 by ten of its guilds including The Aquarium. It inherited the war with Khaos and collapsed just twenty days later, on 18 December 2021, when Emorians, Nefarious Ravens, IceBlue Team and Avicia left.

articles.title: Vanir collapses
articles.summary: On 18 Dec 2021 Emorians, Nefarious Ravens, IceBlue Team and Avicia left Vanir and the alliance collapsed, twenty days after forming. Niflheim officially dissolved the same day.

infobox.label: Triggered by
infobox.value: [[Emorians]], Nefarious Ravens, IceBlue Team and [[Avicia]] leaving

articles.body:
[[Vanir]] was formed on 28 Nov 2021 by ten [[Valhalla]] guilds — including [[The Aquarium]] — as a reorganization of the bloc that had dominated the map since May. Guardian of Wynn and Nefarious Ravens were invited on 1 Dec{{cite:community-guild-timeline|28 Nov and 1 Dec 2021 entries}}. It did not survive its first month.

## The collapse

On 18 Dec 2021 [[Emorians]], Nefarious Ravens, IceBlue Team and [[Avicia]] left, and the alliance collapsed — twenty days after forming. Why they left was never recorded. [[Niflheim]], the community alliance that had run alongside the war blocs since 2020, officially dissolved the same day{{cite:community-guild-timeline|18 Dec 2021 entry}}.

{{map:2021-12-18|The map on the day Vanir collapsed}}

## Aftermath

Vanir's fall left the ex-Valhalla world without a named alliance while the [[Valhalla-Khaos war]] still ran. The former members fought on against [[Khaos]] through the winter as a coalition that was never formally named — remembered as the Pineapple Pact{{cite:cameron-oral-history|Cameron oral history (TAq veteran testimony)}} ([[khaos-s-last-war|Khaos's last war]]){{cite:territory-exchanges|the ex-Vanir guilds' continuing war on Khaos, winter 2021–22}}. The realignment that followed in spring 2022 produced [[Cucumber Company]], which reunited most of Vanir's guilds with their former Khaos enemies{{cite:thread-278112-p08|post #160, TherapueticLiz, 26 Jun 2022}}. Vanir proved to be the last formally-announced successor of the Valhalla line.

articles.title: Vesta
articles.summary: Vesta was a fourteen-guild Wynncraft alliance created on 10 December 2015 by 3zPz from the remnants of Concordia. Larger on paper than Ordo Malleus, it fought no recorded campaign and was declared dead a month later. Later retellings misdated its founding to 2016.
articles.body:
3zPz, leader of the guild Historical [UEZ], formed **Vesta** out of what remained of [[concordia|Concordia]] after its defeat by [[ordo-malleus|Ordo Malleus]]{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L289–290}}. It was the larger alliance at the time it formed — fourteen guilds against Ordo's dozen — and it is remembered chiefly for having done nothing.

## The date

Both narrative sources give the year as 2016, and both are wrong. [[drew1011|Drew1011]]'s account opens the chapter "On December 10th, 2016", and the community guild-timeline image circulated on the forums carries the same error — "December 10 2016 — Vesta was created"{{cite:community-guild-timeline|Community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ), via Wynncraft forums thread 265297}}; but Drew1011's own next sentence has the alliance "declared dead exactly one month later on January 10th, 2016"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L289, L311}}. The Wynncraft forums' alliance-prefix thread index settles it: the thread "-*-vesta Alliance-*-" was posted by 3zPz on 10 December 2015, ran to four pages and 70 replies with 9,191 views, was locked, and was last posted in by 3zPz on 19 March 2016{{cite:forums-wynncraft-com-forums-guilds-72-prefix-id-82-order-post-date-direction-asc|Alliance-prefix thread index}}. The surrounding chronology agrees — the alliance was built from Concordia, which ended in November 2015, and Gavel was released on 21 December 2015{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L290, L315}}. A guild member applying to rejoin [[holders-of-le|Holders of LE]] in 2018 recalled independently that that "we were at war with Vesta" before Gavel's release{{cite:thread-217600|post #15, PikaLegend, 2 Feb 2018}}. **Vesta was created on 10 December 2015 and declared dead on 10 January 2016.**

## History

Drew1011, then leading Holders of LE inside Ordo Malleus, wrote that the new alliance was initially treated as a serious threat: "At first we were concerned for the future of the alliance and worried about what would happen if this alliance began to hold organized attacks against us. However, they did nothing. Aside from a few small skirmishes, Vesta barely even existed"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L307–310}}. He recorded it as "officially declared dead exactly one month later on January 10th"{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L311}}. The thread nonetheless remained open and was posted in by its author as late as 19 March 2016{{cite:forums-wynncraft-com-forums-guilds-72-prefix-id-82-order-post-date-direction-asc|Alliance-prefix thread index}}.

The characterisation of Vesta as inert comes from a leader of the rival alliance; no account from Vesta itself survives. No Vesta campaign was ever recorded, though at least one guild remembered being at war with it{{cite:thread-217600|post #15, PikaLegend, 2 Feb 2018}}.

## Membership

Drew1011 reproduced the alliance's "official list" of fourteen guilds{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L293–306}}:

| Guild | Tag |
|---|---|
| Historical | UEZ |
| [[validus|Validus]] | Val |
| Travellers | TVL |
| [[thenolifes|TheNoLifes]] | TNL |
| Super Crafters | SPC |
| Wynn Try Hards | WTH |
| Da Classy Goats | CLG |
| NightStriders | CGO |
| BOOM | BOO |
| Frosted Pants | FPS |
| Omegamine | OMM |
| Silver of Anarchy | SOA |
| [[iceblue-team|IceBlue Team]] | IBT |
| Artifact | UPZ |

The same fourteen names, in the same order, were circulated inside [[ordo-malleus|Ordo Malleus]] at the time. A captain's guide written by [[drew1011|Drew1011]] for [[holders-of-le|Holders of LE]] reproduces the list under the heading "We are at war with Vesta", with the standing order that "Vesta is considered totally hostile, and if any of their land is seen, it should be taken once we have all our designated land."{{cite:gdoc-1sqfxhjwewtphua7|"Holders Of LE — A captain's guide", enemies}}

Three of the fourteen appear again in later history: TheNoLifes and IceBlue Team both resurface years later, and Travellers and Da Classy Goats appear as territory holders on the 2015 territory maps{{cite:drew1011-storytime|territory maps reproduced as screenshots at L129 and L145}}. Vesta predates the machine-recorded alliance logs, which begin in January 2018.

## Legacy

Vesta was the last organised attempt to build a counterweight to [[ordo-malleus|Ordo Malleus]], and its collapse left Ordo unopposed until it broke apart on its own on 9 March 2016{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L454}}. Its founder, 3zPz, had by then passed through three alliances in as many months — [[concordia|Concordia]], Ordo Malleus and Vesta{{cite:drew1011-storytime|L200–201, L234–241, L289–290}}.
articles.leadImageCaption: The Vesta alliance emblem — a hooded figure holding two torches against a starfield.

articles.title: Viaire
articles.summary: Leader of the guild Fantasy and a co-leader of the Aesir Pact; remembered in the Federation Tribute as "perhaps the best mapmaker the alliance had".
articles.body:
Viaire led the guild [[Fantasy]] [Fux] alongside SpaseCow. The pair took Fantasy into the [[aesir-pact|Aesir Pact]], the "sister-ship pact" of four warring community guilds - Fantasy, [[sins-of-seedia|Sins of Seedia]], IceBlue Team and [[DiamondDeities]] - whose other named co-leaders were [[simplyinfinity|simplyinfinity_]], Shy_Phoenix, [[vmark03|Vmark03]], Mpr100, [[nitrogen2oxygen|Nitrogen2Oxygen]] and Icey_Diamond{{cite:thread-227373|post #1, leader table, 5 Jun 2018 (ed. 21 Jul 2018)}}.

Within the [[the-federation|Federation]], [[drew1011|Drew1011]]'s "Federation Tribute" singles Viaire out as "perhaps the best mapmaker the alliance had"{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}} - map-making being the coordination work behind an alliance that at its height held every territory in the game.

Fantasy turned against the Federation in the summer of 2018 ([[fantasy-turns-on-the-federation|Fantasy turns on the Federation]]){{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle alliance and event records: Fantasy turns on the Federation, summer 2018}}; whether Viaire had a personal hand in that decision is not recorded, and no later roles of his are known.

articles.title: Vmark03
articles.summary: Leader of IceBlue Team and a co-leader of the Aesir Pact, remembered in the Federation Tribute as "legitimately one of the nicest people".
articles.body:
Vmark03 led the guild IceBlue Team [IBT] alongside Mpr100. The pair are listed as IBT's leaders in the founding thread of the [[aesir-pact|Aesir Pact]], the four-guild "sister-ship pact" with [[Fantasy]], [[sins-of-seedia|Sins of Seedia]] and [[DiamondDeities]], whose other co-leaders included [[viaire|Viaire]], SpaseCow, [[simplyinfinity|simplyinfinity_]], Shy_Phoenix, [[nitrogen2oxygen|Nitrogen2Oxygen]] and Icey_Diamond{{cite:thread-227373|post #1, leader table, 5 Jun 2018 (ed. 21 Jul 2018)}}. IceBlue Team itself predates the pact in the record: it appears, then under leader orkrider, in the April 2017 roster of the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]]{{cite:thread-188024|post #1, member-guild roster, 7 May 2017}}.

In [[drew1011|Drew1011]]'s "Federation Tribute", which credits him as "ItzVmark03", he is remembered as "legitimately one of the nicest people"{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}. IceBlue Team was one of the three Aesir guilds whose departure after "14 hours of constant warring" on 10 November 2018 was described by a witness as "essentially ending" the [[the-federation|Federation]]{{cite:thread-236962|post #17 (Ascended Kitten), 11 Nov 2018}}; no source attributes that decision to Vmark03 personally.

articles.title: War Syndicate
articles.summary: War Syndicate was the Coalition's principal opponent in the winter of 2017, created on 17 July 2017 and destroyed in the Gavel Invasion of 21-25 December. It never posted on the forums under its own name; nine guilds passed through it under a leader known as Tnt.
articles.body:
**War Syndicate** (WS) was a Wynncraft war bloc of the second half of 2017 and the principal opponent of the [[coalition|Coalition]] in the war that ended the [[early-guild-era|early guild era]]. It never posted on the forums under its own name. Its roster and its leader are known from a retrospective account by [[drew1011|Drew1011]], the founder of the alliance that destroyed it.

## Classification and the state of the record

War Syndicate left no forum record under its own name: no recruitment thread, no roster, no alliance announcement, and no post identifying its leader{{cite:archive-search-method|Wayback CDX sweep of forums.wynncraft.com thread slugs (19,659 URLs)}}{{cite:archive-search-method|guilds.72 creation-date title census, Jul 2017 – Jun 2018 (archive research sweep)}}{{cite:forums-wynncraft-com-forums-guilds-72-prefix-id-82-order-post-date-direction-asc|complete census of Alliance-prefixed threads, page 1}}{{cite:forums-wynncraft-com-forums-guilds-72-page-2-prefix-id-82-order-post-date-directi|complete census of Alliance-prefixed threads, page 2}}, and no [WS] tag in the recruiting megalist{{cite:thread-278112|all 9 pages, guild tag listings}}. One written source classifies it, the Aesir Pact thread of 2018, whose origin story recalls "the peak of the War Syndicate alliance"; it is treated as an alliance rather than a guild on that strength{{cite:thread-227373|post #1, 21 Jul 2018}}. Its membership, leadership and the course of its war all come from a single retrospective account by Drew1011, composed between March and August 2018 from the winning side and corroborated by no contemporaneous source.

## History

War Syndicate was created on 17 July 2017, three months before the Coalition formed{{cite:community-guild-timeline|Community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ), via Wynncraft forums thread 265297}}. The Aesir Pact's origin story, written by [[simplyinfinity|simplyinfinity_]] of Sins of Seedia, recalls [[Fantasy]] and Sins of Seedia becoming friends at the peak of the War Syndicate alliance, both settled in the canyon and fighting invaders, until the Coalition split them — Fantasy joining it, Sins of Seedia warring against it as a rebel guild.{{cite:thread-227373|post #1, 21 Jul 2018}} That places WS's peak before the Coalition's rise and describes a landscape of canyon-holding guilds resisting invasion, but names no WS member.

## Membership

At the declaration of war on 21 December 2017 the roster was eight guilds:{{cite:drew1011-storytime|roster at the declaration of war, part 14, composed 22 Mar 2018}}

| Guild | Tag |
|---|---|
| Beasts | BST |
| BuildCraftia | BCr |
| DogsAmongUs | DAU |
| Sins of Seedia | SDU |
| [[titans-valor|Titans Valor]] | ANO |
| Tranquility | PaT |
| The Divine Swords | DsQ |
| TheOldKeepers | Tok |

A ninth guild had left earlier in 2017: **KingdomPhoenixes [Phx]**, which departed after a dispute over its own leader's brief move to [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]] and went on to co-found the Coalition.{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 13, composed 4 Mar 2018}} At least nine guilds therefore passed through the bloc. TheOldKeepers is otherwise unrecorded.

The bloc is otherwise connected by name to only one guild: Illustratus, which the community timeline says was "created from the remains of WS"{{cite:community-guild-timeline|Community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ), via Wynncraft forums thread 265297}}. Illustratus was created on 19 February 2018, three days after the Federation's founding{{cite:territory-exchanges|territory_exchanges map-data analysis}}, and its own 2019 revival thread makes no mention of War Syndicate{{cite:thread-251505|post #1}}. Illustratus [lus] does appear on the Federation's own member roster{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}.

## Leadership

Drew1011's account names a leader: "Tnt, the unofficial leader of War Syndicate", whom it places at the head of the member guild BuildCraftia.{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 13, composed 4 Mar 2018}} That person was probably, though not certainly, **Tntdestroyd**. Tntdestroyd posted in March 2017 arguing that [[hackforums|HackForums]] "should be limited on territory influence", the politics of a rising war-guild leader in the Hax era{{cite:thread-179383|post #1, 1 Mar 2017}}; he was the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]]'s **War Leader** in mid-2017 and its member of the month for his warring{{cite:thread-188024-p05|p5 #82, 16 Jun 2017, quoting the opening post}}; Drew1011's own public tribute of November 2018 thanks "@Tntdestroyd, for fighting hard to reclaim the map back in March. As much as we've been at odds, I'll always be thankful for your contributions in the time you were with us"{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}; and in April 2018 Tntdestroyd wrote on another alliance's thread that "We have already began forming what it is your looking to do now, join us if you like"{{cite:thread-224905|post #3, 25 Apr 2018}}. Whether Tntdestroyd owned BuildCraftia is not established: the guild's recorded owners are ItsAZZA in 2017{{cite:thread-188024|post #1, opened 7 May 2017, last revised Aug 2017}} and Liliya/Topper29 in 2019.

### A possible continuity with the Emperium

Four of the War Syndicate guilds were [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]] member guilds during 2017 — BuildCraftia (owner ItsAZZA), Sins of Seedia (simplyinfinity_), Titans Valor (IceResistance) and Beasts (Beastovrlrd){{cite:thread-188024|post #1, opened 7 May 2017, last revised Aug 2017}} — Tranquility applied to the Emperium on 12 September 2017{{cite:thread-202724-p02|p2 #26, DemoGhost, 12 Sep 2017}}, and the Emperium's War Leader in mid-2017 was TnTdestroyd{{cite:thread-188024-p05|p5 #82, 16 Jun 2017}}. War Syndicate was created on 17 July 2017 and the Emperium fell on 17 October 2017{{cite:community-guild-timeline|Community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ), via Wynncraft forums thread 265297}}.

That overlap suggests that War Syndicate was substantially the Emperium's warring core reconstituted off the forums, which would also explain its absence from them — its members already had a forum presence under a different name. No connection between the two blocs was ever recorded, and War Syndicate's founding was never described.

## Doctrine

Drew1011 describes a standing rule that War Syndicate did not attack the province of Wynn: "They had a rule where they would not attack the province of Wynn at all, aside from a few free-for-all territories. Thus, they divided Gavel amongst themselves, and we divided Wynn amongst ourselves." He characterises this as "one of, if not the main factor of their downfall", on the grounds that it left the Coalition over a hundred territories to grow on — his judgement.{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 14, composed 22 Mar 2018}} The same account records a pact with [[paladins-united|Paladins United]], "a guild who had made a pact with War Syndicate in order to keep their beloved island" of Corkus.{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 14, composed 22 Mar 2018}}

He also claims a long-running informant inside the bloc, known to the Coalition as "Mr. White", whom he identifies as the leader of the War Syndicate guild "DsO".{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 14, composed 22 Mar 2018}} That tag does not match his own roster, which lists **The Divine Swords [DsQ]**, while the Emperium's roster has a separate guild, **The Divine Souls [DsO]**{{cite:thread-188024|post #1, opened 7 May 2017, last revised Aug 2017}} — two different guilds. Which he meant, and who the informant was, was never established.

## The Gavel Invasion, 21-25 December 2017

The community timeline gives two dates for the war at once — "War is declared on December 21 2017" and "Coa vs WS 12/17/2017" — without saying which is the declaration{{cite:community-guild-timeline|Community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ), via Wynncraft forums thread 265297}}. Drew1011's account settles on the 21st, and offers a reason the date was memorable: it was the third anniversary of Wynncraft's guild release.{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 14, composed 22 Mar 2018}} His account reproduces the Discord exchange that the Coalition treated as the declaration itself.

![The end of a Discord exchange of 21 December 2017 between Drew1011 and the War Syndicate leader, closing with the line "here we come" that the Coalition read as a declaration of war. From Drew1011's storytime account; the screenshot contains one profanity.](/images/chronicles/storytime/49-unknown.webp){{cite:drew1011-storytime|declaration-of-war exchange, screenshots dated 12/21/2017, part 15}}

![Gavel at the start of the invasion, labelled by holding guild: BuildCraftia, The Divine Swords, TheOldKeepers, Tranquility, Beasts, DogsAmongUs, Sins of Seedia and Titans Valor across the province, with a HackForums foothold in the north-east. From Drew1011's storytime account, the first of his numbered war-progress screenshots.](/images/chronicles/storytime/52-Gavel1.webp){{cite:drew1011-storytime|war-progress screenshot "Gavel1", part 15}}

The war ran five days:{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 15, composed 22 Mar and 20 May 2018}}

- **21 December** — the invasion opened. About three hours in, with roughly ten territories taken and wars failing repeatedly, the Coalition voted to offer a ceasefire "until wars became less glitched"; no reply came. By the end of the day 44 Gavel territories had changed hands.
- **22-23 December** — BuildCraftia and Sins of Seedia were the only two guilds that consistently fought back, "with roughly half their guilds barely even attacking back". Sins of Seedia was targeted by as many Coalition guilds as possible until it asked to withdraw to the jungle, which was granted unopposed.
- **23 December** — three guilds left War Syndicate. Drew1011 calls this "the final blow to the alliance".
- **24 December** — the remaining members abandoned Gavel entirely and moved to Wynn, taking territories the Coalition had left behind.
- **25 December** — "By the end of the day, all 349 territories on the map were owned by Coalition guilds or those we had truced with" — "67 days after the planning had begun".

He credits the guild leader Thundderr with "probably somewhere between 100-150 territories" across several guilds — his own estimate, offered before the rule against warring with multiple accounts existed.{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 15, composed 20 May 2018}}

![Gavel after the province was taken, 24-25 December 2017, labelled by holding guild: Paladins United across the Light Realm, Kingdom Foxes through the centre and west, KingdomPhoenixes, HackForums, Hall of Fame, Kasai Shinrai, Imperial and others, with residual BuildCraftia and Titans Valor territories still shown. From Drew1011's storytime account, the twenty-seventh of his war-progress screenshots.](/images/chronicles/storytime/54-Gavel27.webp){{cite:drew1011-storytime|war-progress screenshot "Gavel27", part 15}}

## The end: wipe, merger, or both

The sources have long disagreed on how War Syndicate ended.

The **wipe reading** comes from IceResistance, founder of [[titans-valor|Titans Valor]] — a War Syndicate guild, so a witness from the losing side — writing on 14 April 2020: "wdym Coa never technically 'beat' ws / yes they did. They wiped ws off the map on Christmas day."{{cite:thread-265297-p02|post #34, 14 Apr 2020}}

The **merger reading** comes from Lego_DW, ten days earlier in the same thread: "Coa never technically 'beat' WS rather when AA split from coa, Coa and WS merged to wipe a common enemy, this was a creation of fed."{{cite:thread-265297|post #16, 4 Apr 2020}}

Drew1011's day-by-day account supports IceResistance on the December question and describes the merger as a separate event two months later. He states that after the Coalition split on 16 February 2018 he proposed merging with the War Syndicate remnant himself, messaged BuildCraftia's co-leader without response, and that "Simplyinfinity, the SDU Leader, messaged me and said they would agree to a merger" — the arrangement out of which [[the-federation|the Federation]] was formed.{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 17, composed 11 Jul and 30 Aug 2018}} His own contemporaneous tribute credits simplyinfinity_ in the same terms{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}}. The two readings therefore describe two events two months apart: a December wipe and a February merger. Lego_DW's conclusion — that the Federation was a Coalition–War Syndicate merger — stands; his premise that no wipe occurred does not. The community timeline's own version, "December 24, 2017 — WS merges with Coa to defeat AA", is internally inconsistent, since the same image dates Alliance Alliance's creation to February 2018{{cite:community-guild-timeline|Community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ), via Wynncraft forums thread 265297}}.

## Legacy

On either reading, the Federation of 2018 — the alliance that went on to hold the entire map for most of a year{{cite:thread-237070|post #1, 13 Nov 2018}} — was built partly out of War Syndicate, so the largest power of the [[federation-era|Federation era]] descends in part from a bloc that never posted a single thread. The bloc's leader remained inside that alliance until March 2018, when a vote was opened to expel his guild.{{cite:drew1011-storytime|part 18, composed 20 Jun 2019}}

articles.title: Yugito
articles.summary: Eden’s leader through the Artemis–Goose war, who opened the guild’s forum thread in January 2020 and presided over its Roman-styled Senate; by 2025 the guild lists him as a Dux.
articles.body:
Yugito opened Eden's recruitment thread on 1 January 2020{{cite:thread-260434|post #1 (OP); earliest replies of Jan 2020}} and led the guild through the [[artemis|Artemis]]–[[goose|Goose]] war. Eden was among the anti-Artemis guilds of [[sheepn|Sheepn]]'s "Guild Moderators" thread of December 2020{{cite:thread-279337|posts #1–#20, 18–19 Dec 2020, read with the participants’ forum guild badges}}, and was in Goose by 19 January 2021, when Lev98bug asked [[the-forum-megalist|the megalist]] to add "Eden is in Goose if you could add that :))"{{cite:thread-278112-p04|p4 #72, 19 Jan 2021}}. Lev98bug was a Chief, and Asthae and Rothboy were among the guild's senior figures{{cite:chronicle-records|Chronicle research notes (2020–2026): Eden leadership}}.

Eden set aside the in-game ranks entirely for a Roman apparatus, described in its own thread: an Agora containing every member, a Legion as "our military force", and a Senate of Consuls, Duxes and Senates that "discusses and votes on decisions that largely impact the empire"{{cite:thread-260434|post #1 (OP)}}. Above them sat an Emperor whose only formal power was to veto the Senate, and who could be replaced only when "the current Emperor steps down and hands over their powers"{{cite:thread-260434|post #1 (OP)}}.

Eden was at some point deposed from within. xK6TA, a former member, wrote in an April 2023 guild application to Titans Valor: "I was a part of Eden when it was #1 and slightly after it got couped."{{cite:thread-206094-p97|p97 #1922, 16 Apr 2023, quoting xK6TA’s application}} The coup's actors and date were never recorded, and since Eden never won a guild season it is unclear what "#1" refers to. By January 2025 the guild listed FadeDave as Emperor, Asthae as Consul, and Yugito as one of six Duxes{{cite:thread-260434|post #1 (OP), as revised 19 Jan 2025}}.
